Job Location: Bangalore, Vadodara, Chennai

Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale 
Provide pre-sales support for new business deals and post-sales support for the new projects assigned
Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.
Regional oversight and stewardship of integrity work product metrics for quality, effectiveness, and efficiency in achieving business unit/ manufacturing site objectives.
Work Experience
Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 3 to 8 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas) 
Should have sound knowledge on Oil & Gas upstream and downstream business in the following areas 
- Risk Based Inspection methodologies 
- Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures 
- Inspection Optimization
- Piping Circutization/TML development 
- API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals 
- In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment 
- Knowledge of materials and standards 
- Knowledge of corrosion & welding
- Knowledge of NDTs
-Thickness inspection management and analysis
- Corrosion management and analysis
- Inspection plan development/ optimization.
- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) 
- Ability to lead teams 
- Excellent communication 
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations 
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities 
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site 
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy 
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Project Role: Assoc Lab Project Svcs Mgr

Work Experience: xp- 5+ yrs , Clinical project management+ client/sponsor direct handling exp, life science background.

Work location: Bangalore, Thane, Hyderabad, Kochi, Ahmedabad.

Work Mode: Hybrid

Shift Timings: 5:00 pm -2:00 am(Night Shifts)

Preferred candidate profile
Under general direction, manage all laboratory aspects of assigned clinical trial projects for a Customer or a specific program for a Customer. May have responsibility for a specific Customer, drug program, indication or drug compound. Acts as the main point of contact for the Customer after study award and throughout the entire study lifecycle (startup, maintenance, closeout). Ensures work is conducted in line with standard operating procedures, policies and good practices.
Essential Functions
Study Setup and Planning:
Facilitate seamless study set-up including Protocol and Budget review, leading meetings, develop and implement project plans, milestone, risk, issue and action logs. Partner with Study Setup team to ensure quality database set-up, oversee preparation of protocol specific documentation. Will prepare and present protocol-specific materials at Kick Off and Investigator meetings
May participate in the proposal and business development process including bid defence meetings. Support development of Customer standards
Study Activity Monitoring and Closeout:
Will monitor the Project Management Plan, timelines and deliverables, manage study documentation throughout the Project lifecycle including filing into eTMF, oversee study monitoring and reporting, conduct meetings to meet needs of the Study and Customer requirements
Will manage study scope changes and budget monitor quality of the study and any service-related issues, implementing changes as required. Lessons learnt will be reviewed and shared
Proactive Lines of Communication:
Build and own the Customer relationship, facilitate communication, collaborate with all operational areas within the company
Will serve as an escalation point for study level issues and will coordinate and triage study-specific issues
Coordinates customer survey follow up and ongoing health checks to support Customer relationship building
Meetings, Initiatives and Training Activities:
Will represent the company at Investigator meetings and other internal / external face to face meetings. Will participate in audits and inspections as required
Will provide study training to sites, CRAs and customers
Will establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage on-going project expectations and issues. Will participate in improvement projects as needed
Will assist in training of less experienced staff.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree Life Sciences and/or related field preferred Req
2-3 years of experience in clinical trials/ hospital-funded research, project management or laboratory environment preferred. . Equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Strong interpersonal and customer management skills.
Working understanding of medical and clinical research terminology.
Working knowledge of Project Management processes, the company laboratory processes, and/or equivalent working knowledge of central laboratory operations (kits/supplies, logistics, laboratory operations, specimen storage, data reporting and transfers, site alerts, etc.) preferred.
Demonstrated computer proficiency with Microsoft Office and the company systems, or equivalent experience with similar Centralized Laboratory systems preferred.

Position : Associate Director / Director

Department: Tax Restructuring/Succession Planning Team
Designation: Associate Director / Director (10+ years)
Experience: 10+ years post-qualification
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)
Location: Vadodara (Preferred) | Ahmedabad | Mumbai
Role Overview
We are looking for experienced Chartered Accountants to join its Succession Planning Team. The role involves independently leading succession and estate planning assignments for business families and HNIs, covering the complete process from understanding family objectives to structuring, drafting and implementation.
The candidate should have the ability to understand business strategy, ownership structures and long-term family objectives and design appropriate succession structures beyond conventional tax and legal considerations.

Key Responsibilities
1. Succession & Estate Planning
Lead succession and estate planning assignments for operating businesses, promoter shareholdings, immovable properties, investments, artwork and other family wealth.
Analyse family ownership structures, family dynamics, commercial objectives and long-term goals.
Design succession structures involving private trusts, Wills, family arrangements, family charters, gifts, partition arrangements, holding structures and family governance mechanisms.
Advise on ownership succession, management succession, business continuity and next-generation involvement.
2. Transaction & Corporate Structuring
Consider M&A, business restructuring, business sales and other corporate events while designing succession structures.
Handle succession planning for pre-IPO and IPO-bound businesses, considering DRHP disclosures, promoter contributions, lock-in and holding-period requirements.
Advise on listed company succession matters involving SEBI regulations, promoter and promoter-group requirements, disclosures, transfer restrictions and regulatory approvals.
3. Tax, Legal & Regulatory Advisory
Analyse Indian tax, stamp duty, Companies Act, FEMA, SEBI and succession-law implications.
Handle assignments involving NRIs, non-resident trustees or beneficiaries, foreign trusts, overseas foundations and foreign assets.
Assess overseas taxation, succession laws and inheritance or estate-tax implications, coordinating with specialist teams wherever required.
4. Documentation & Implementation
Draft, review and finalise trust deeds, Wills, family arrangements, shareholder agreements, family charters, partition deeds and other legal documents.
Prepare structure notes, technical opinions and presentations explaining available alternatives, risks and recommended structures.
Lead client and family discussions and translate commercial and family objectives into practical legal and tax structures.
Coordinate with internal specialists and external legal, tax, regulatory and valuation advisers for implementation.
5. Team Management
Supervise junior team members.
Review research, documentation, drafting and technical work.
Ensure quality and timely execution of succession planning assignments.

Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

Conduct product demonstrations for clients, emphasizing features, benefits, and overall solution value.

Minimum 15 years of proven track record in deploying financial solutions and ability to meet targets
The candidate must have a basic accounting and finance background (e.g. Graduated with BAF degree)
Should have interest in business development for software application products/solutions (B2C)
Must be energetic, well-spoken, and eager to generate revenue for the organization
Should be proficient in Hindi and English
Fluency in the regional language is a plus
Should be comfortable working on weekends
(Saturday & Sunday are compulsory working days, with a week off between MondayThursday)
Effective presentation and negotiation skills
The candidate should have proficiency in Tally and MS Office

Benefits
Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance

Monthly R&R awards
Early promotions to outstanding performers

Role: AI Architect.
Location: Ahmedabad, Pune, Indore
Years of Experience: 10-15 years
Notice Period 0-45 Days (Preferred)

Job Description:
A highly skilled and motivated AI Architect for designing, developing, and implementing artificial intelligence (AI) solutions within an organization. The role focuses on leveraging AI & GenAI technologies, machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and predictive analytics to solve complex business problems and drive innovation. The AI Architect bridges the gap between business objectives and technology, ensuring that AI systems align with the organization's strategic goals.

What we're looking for:
Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in AI projects, data science, or a related field.

Skills:
Expertise in AI & GenAI technologies, frameworks, and methodologies (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision).
Proficiency in programming languages like Python or .Net
Strong understanding of cloud technologies (Azure & GCP), APIs, and microservices.
Knowledge of big data processing tools (e.g., Hadoop, Apache Spark).
Hands on experience with tools and platforms used in AI development (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, Ollama, DataBricks etc.).
Proven experience in managing technical projects, preferably in AI, machine learning, or data-driven technologies.
Experience in architecting AI Solutions using on premise and Cloud technologies.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
Experience with agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) for managing technical projects.
Knowledge of AI ethics and regulatory compliance frameworks.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Proficiency with data engineering and cloud architecture principles.

What you'll be doing:
Define and design AI architecture, frameworks, and strategies to meet organizational needs.
Evaluate and select AI tools, platforms, and frameworks to develop innovative solutions.
Supervise or contribute to the development, training, and optimization of Large as well as small language models.
Ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing business processes while ensuring that the solution complies with customers internal policies and guidelines.
Design AI solutions that are scalable, secure, and maintainable over time.
Stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and machine learning to propose innovative solutions.
Strong understanding & knowledge about Microsoft Azure cloud and deploying PaaS & SaaS applications on Azure
Strong architecture background especially in AI Solutions and Cloud technologies.
Collaborate with external vendors and partners to leverage their expertise and solutions.
Project Planning and Execution
Define project scope, goals, and deliverables that align with business objectives.
Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and milestones for AI development and deployment initiatives for the inhouse GenAI platform.
Collaborate with business units for ROI determination and identify KPI’s for measuring ROI for each project.
Manage day-to-day project activities to ensure successful execution and timely delivery.
Anticipate potential risks and challenges in AI projects (e.g., data limitations, algorithm performance issues, regulatory concerns).
Proactively implement risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
Ensure that AI projects comply with data privacy regulations, industry standards, and ethical guidelines.
Promote responsible use of AI technologies across all projects.

Team Collaboration and Coordination
Act as the primary liaison between AI research teams, data scientists, engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.
Facilitate regular meetings and communications between business units and IT to discuss AI project progress, challenges, and opportunities.
Plan and coordinate work between onsite and offshore AI teams.
Foster collaboration among team members and remove obstacles to productivity.

What We Offer:
Competitive Salary
Work Life Balance
Professional Development
Innovative Work Environment.
Recognition and Rewards

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs

Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.

What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.

Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer with deep expertise in designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-scale B2C and B2B digital commerce solutions on the Salesforce platform. Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to commerce architecture decisions.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.
Conduct code reviews, enforce development standards, and mentor junior team members.
Support CI/CD pipelines, release management, and environment deployments.
Collaborate with QA, Product Management, UX, and business teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Required Skills:

6+ years of experience in eCommerce application development with at least 4+ years of Salesforce Commerce implementation experience.
Strong hands-on experience with both:
Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFCC)
Salesforce B2B Commerce
Expertise in SFRA, ISML, Controllers, OCAPI, SCAPI, Jobs Framework, and Commerce APIs.
Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, Salesforce Platform, and Experience Cloud.
Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, REST APIs, JSON, and AJAX.
Experience implementing:
Product Catalogs
Pricing & Promotions
Checkout & Payments
Order Management
Customer & Account Management
Search & Merchandising
Experience integrating Salesforce Commerce platforms with:
SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar ERP systems
Salesforce CRM and Service Cloud
Payment providers such as Adyen, Stripe, PayPal, CyberSource, or Authorize.Net
Tax providers such as Vertex or Avalara
Strong understanding of B2B commerce concepts including corporate accounts, buyer roles, negotiated pricing, procurement workflows, and quote management.
Experience with Git, Bitbucket/GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar DevOps tools.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Salesforce Certifications:
Salesforce B2C Commerce Developer
Salesforce Platform Developer I / II
Salesforce B2B Commerce for Developers
Salesforce Application Architect (preferred)
Experience with Composable Commerce, Headless Commerce, and API-led architectures.
Experience with PWA Kit, Managed Runtime, and modern storefront development.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and leading offshore/onshore development teams.
Exposure to multi-site, multi-brand, multi-country commerce implementations.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.

As an Associate in the Financial Institutions Group Client Support team, you will provide consultative support for business intelligence tools and financial data products. You will manage complex client queries, troubleshoot data-related issues, and help clients maximize the value of our platforms.
You will act as a client advocate, working closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Content, and Industry Research teams to improve the client experience, support data quality initiatives, and contribute to product adoption and revenue growth.


The Team
The Financial Institutions Group team provides specialized support to clients across financial institutions, government organizations, universities, and other market participants. With team members across multiple global locations, the team operates in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
Associates develop strong subject matter expertise in financial institutions, banking regulations, mortgage data, demographic research, asset-level analytics, and market intelligence workflows.


The Impact
In this role, you will help strengthen client relationships by delivering timely, accurate, and consultative support. Your work will contribute to client retention, product usage, operational efficiency, and overall client satisfaction.
You will also help identify product enhancement opportunities, improve internal workflows, and support initiatives that enhance data quality and platform usability.


Responsibilities
Provide advanced client support via phone, email, and chat, resolving complex and data-intensive inquiries.
Conduct investigative client conversations to understand business needs, troubleshoot issues, and recommend effective solutions.
Act as a client advocate by identifying opportunities to improve product usability, data quality, and presentation.
Build customized Excel models, templates, and workflows using multiple datasets, including data not directly available on the platform.
Support clients in using mapping tools for mortgage, demographic, asset-level, and market analysis.
Partner with Product and Technology teams to test new features, enhancements, and platform updates with a focus on the end-user experience.
Lead proactive outreach campaigns related to product enhancements, new datasets, and workflow improvements.
Conduct client webcasts and product demonstrations, showcasing knowledge of FIG products, data, and industry trends.
Create Salesforce reports and analyze support trends to improve workflows, team procedures, and client outcomes.
Lead assigned projects from planning through execution and identify opportunities for process improvement.
Mentor new hires and junior team members through training, knowledge sharing, and best-practice development.
Collaborate with global teams across Sales, Product, Technology, Content, and Industry Research to resolve complex client issues.


What We're Looking For

Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
Strong understanding of finance, capital markets, banking, or the global economy.
Prior experience in client support, financial data, research, product support, or a related role preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and professionally.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams.
Strong working knowledge of MS Excel and common business tools.
Ability to learn and apply tools such as SQL, Salesforce, mapping platforms, and financial data products.
Flexibility to work rotational shifts and weekends based on business requirements.

Description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is currently looking for dynamic personnel in Quality Assurance Team at Insulation Kit Center for the Transformers Business to join their team in Halol, India, where we have two state of the art insulation kit centers. These kit centers are supplying insulation kits for all major large power transformer manufacturers in India as well as Hitachi Factories in HUB APMEA. This team seeks a skilled and motivated individual.
Transformers BU team leverages innovative and diverse technology to transform energy, delivering social, environmental, and economic value and enabling a sustainable energy future for current and future generations. The business's comprehensive portfolio includes power transformers, traction transformers, insulation and components, digital sensors, and transformer services.The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment. He or she must be flexible in accommodating business requirements and experience in working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask & deliver within timelines is essential. The candidate will have excellent communications skills. The job requires travelling to visit customers when needed.


How you'll make an impact
Develops and implements quality assurance strategies and plans to enhance production quality, efficiency, and effectiveness.
Lead QMS and ensure the system established is fulfilling the ISO requirements such as Functional requirements, Audit requirements, regular review of ISO processes and upgrade them for continuous improvement. Provides internal reporting on quality assurance activities, progress, and outcomes to relevant stakeholders.
Utilizes data-driven insights to drive/contribute decision-making and implement necessary process improvements.
Conducts training programs and workshops to promote quality awareness to develop the skills of manufacturing personnel.
Collaborates with manufacturing teams to address customer-specific quality requirements. Assist in analyzing customer feedback and identifying areas for improvement.
Participate in cross functional projects aimed at improving product quality through manufacturing/assembly process improvements.
Participates in development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions to mitigate process risks. Conducts process audits and inspections to verify compliance with process risk mitigation measures.
Conducts comprehensive risk assessments for manufacturing/assembly processes to identify potential risks by performing activities like failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA).
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Involves in PPAP and supplier development activities and lead with cross functional team till supplier onboarding in line with the global Hitachi guidelines.
Incoming quality inspections and maintaining relevant data and records, supporting suppliers for improving their QMS and rejection rates and processes.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background
Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical / Mechanical engineering
Relevant experience 6 to 8 years in quality assurance function at any large transformers manufacturing unit.
Experience in Transformer Insulation Kits manufacturing will be an added advantage
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certified

Job Summary:

G4S Security Systems India Pvt. Ltd. (An Allied Universal Company) is looking for a technically qualified, self-driven, and result-oriented Manager Sales to drive business growth across Extra Low Voltage (ELV) systems and our state-of-the-art Security Risk Operation Center (SROC).

In this role, you will manage large and strategic accounts, leveraging strong local market insights and a deep understanding of client needs to deliver tailored enterprise security solutions.

Roles & Responsibilities
Business Development: Acquire new accounts for ELV and SROC solutions across target sectors including IT/ITeS, BFSI, NBFC, Healthcare, Warehousing, Logistics, Retail, Hospitality, Residential, and Critical Infrastructure within the assigned region.
Account Management: Retain and grow existing strategic accounts by addressing client pain points and delivering customized security solutions.
Sales Strategy & Revenue: Execute and contribute to regional sales plans to consistently achieve sales and revenue targets.
Technical & Pre-Sales Leadership: Apply strong technical knowledge of ELV systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion Detection, etc.) and SROC technologies to drive consultative sales and pre-sales efforts.
Local Market Presence: Leverage regional geographical insights to tailor sales strategies and build a strong on-ground presence for client trust and smooth project execution.
CRM & Forecasting (SFDC): Utilize Salesforce (SFDC) to manage sales pipelines, track opportunities, maintain sales hygiene, and provide accurate sales forecasts and metrics.
Market Intelligence: Monitor local market trends, emerging technologies, and competitor activities.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with technical, pre-sales, and project delivery teams to ensure successful project implementation.
Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements.

Desired Candidate Profile (Qualifications & Skills)
Experience: 7 to 12 years of proven B2B sales experience in ELV systems, SROC, and enterprise-class security solutions with a strong track record of managing large accounts.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Electronics. An MBA in Sales/Marketing is preferred.
Domain & Technical Expertise: In-depth knowledge of ELV systems and modern SROC technologies (AI-enabled surveillance, CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion Detection, etc.).
Tools & Software: Hands-on proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) for pipeline management, along with strong MS Office skills.
Core Competencies: Exceptional communication, negotiation, analytical, and presentation skills with a client-centric mindset.
Personal Attributes: Proactive, strategic thinker who thrives in fast-paced, high-pressure, target-driven environments.

Work Schedule & Travel Requirements
Work Schedule: Full-time role requiring flexibility. Working on the 1st and last Saturday of every month is mandatory.
Work Environment: Combination of office and client site visits.
Travel: Frequent local travel within the assigned city/region, with occasional national travel.

POSITION SUMMARY
Provide massage services to guests using props and/or products. Provide body treatments to guests using body scrubs, wraps, and/or hydrotherapy. Assess guest needs and inquire about contraindications (e.g., allergies, high blood pressure, and pregnancy) before beginning service. Keep up to date with current techniques and modalities related to their field of work. Escort guests to and from treatment rooms. Arrange workstation, treatment room, and/or drapes. Frequently check with guest to promote comfort, safety and security throughout service. Promote and sell spa/salon services including retail offerings related to the Spa. Clean, maintain, and sterilize tools. Maintain cleanliness of workstation and/or treatment room throughout shift, dispose of trash and dirty linens, and secure supplies and equipment at the end of each shift. Monitor and stick to time schedule throughout the day. Handle inappropriate guest behavior by following Marriott International standard operating procedures for Inappropriate conduct for guests and therapists, leading up to and including stopping a treatment or service and informing supervisor/manager. Maintain current skills and licensure in service area as per regional requirements.
Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow all company policies and procedures; make sure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time; grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
License or Certification: State or Regional Massage License

Description:
Role: Business Development Manager / Senior Manager
Industry: Power Trading / Energy Trading
Department: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 8-11 Years
Education: B.E./B.Tech (Preferred) | MBA/PGDM (Preferred)
Location: Delhi / NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Calcutta, Chennai, Ahmedabad

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and result-oriented Business Development Manager / Senior Manager to drive revenue growth in the power trading business. The incumbent will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, acquiring strategic clients, expanding market presence, and achieving revenue and profitability targets across electricity markets. The role requires close collaboration with trading, regulatory, scheduling, risk, and operations teams to maximize commercial outcomes across short-term and long-term power markets.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Revenue Growth
Identify, develop, and close business opportunities across power trading markets, including bilateral contracts, power exchanges, and open access transactions.
Own and deliver revenue, trading volume (MU), and profitability targets for assigned regions, products, or customer segments.
Develop and expand relationships with Industrial & Commercial (C&I) consumers, DISCOMs, captive users, renewable energy developers, and power generators.
Execute growth strategies and market expansion initiatives across multiple geographies.
Originate and close strategic transactions such as:
Long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs)
Bilateral power sale agreements
Group Captive Projects
Renewable Energy (Solar/Wind) Power Transactions
Multi-state C&I energy portfolios
Cross-border power trading opportunities
Prepare annual business plans, quarterly revenue forecasts, and sales pipelines.
Market Intelligence & Commercial Strategy
Monitor power market trends, pricing dynamics, demand-supply scenarios, and regulatory developments.
Identify trading opportunities in:
Day Ahead Market (DAM)
Real Time Market (RTM)
Term Ahead Market (TAM)
Bilateral Trading Markets
Provide actionable market insights to trading and risk management teams.
Client Relationship Management
Build and maintain strategic relationships with utilities, power generators, open access consumers, regulators, and market participants.
Lead commercial negotiations and contract execution.
Enhance customer retention, repeat business, and wallet share from key accounts.
Regulatory & Compliance
Stay updated on regulations issued by CERC, SERCs, and power exchanges.
Identify commercial opportunities emerging from policy and regulatory changes.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory guidelines and internal policies.
Cross-functional Coordination
Work closely with trading, scheduling, operations, finance, and risk management teams for seamless transaction execution.
Support deal structuring, pricing strategy, credit assessments, and working capital optimization.
Track deal profitability, revenue realization, and business performance metrics.
Team Leadership (For Senior Manager Role)
Lead and mentor a team of business development professionals.
Set sales targets, monitor performance, and drive capability development.
Develop succession plans and strengthen team effectiveness.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, or related discipline.
MBA/PGDM preferred.
8-11 years of experience in Power Trading, Energy Markets, Renewable Energy, or related sectors.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience managing a team, revenue portfolio, or business segment.
Required Skills
Strong understanding of Indian Power Markets and Trading Mechanisms.
Knowledge of Open Access, Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), and Electricity Market Operations.
Excellent negotiation, commercial acumen, and relationship management skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to interpret market data and develop strategic recommendations.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and business analytics tools.
Preferred Experience
Hands-on experience with power exchanges such as:
IEX (Indian Energy Exchange)
PXIL (Power Exchange India Limited)
HPX (Hindustan Power Exchange)
Exposure to renewable energy trading, green energy, solar and wind power markets.
Experience in Open Access and Cross-Border Electricity Trading.
Existing network with DISCOMs, industrial consumers, generators, and energy sector stakeholders.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Revenue & Margin Growth
Trading Volume Growth (MU)
New Client Acquisition
Market Share Expansion
Deal Conversion Ratio
Sales Pipeline Strength
Customer Retention & Account Growth
Team Performance & Collections Efficiency
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work in a fast-growing and dynamic power trading environment.
Exposure to evolving electricity markets and renewable energy initiatives.
High-impact role with significant commercial responsibility.
Collaborative work culture with opportunities for career growth and leadership development.

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including operations, quality, warehousing / logistics, enterprise platforms teams, to understand business requirements and identify interfaces & capabilities required for MES implementation.
Design & develop MES applications and modules tailored to the specific needs of cell and module manufacturing processes.
Implement data integration solutions to ensure seamless flow of information between MES, ERP, and other manufacturing systems.
Develop real-time monitoring and reporting functionalities to provide actionable insights and performance metrics to stakeholders.
Customize and configure MES solution to align with the manufacturing workflows and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Integrate PLCs, equipment, automation systems, robotics, and storage with MES to enhance manufacturing automation and data capture capabilities.
Perform system testing, validation, and commissioning of MES applications to ensure reliability, accuracy, and adherence to quality standards.
Manage system upgrades, patches, and integrations while minimizing disruptions to manufacturing operations.
Provide user training and support during MES implementation and ensure smooth adoption by operations teams.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to MES and manufacturing automation to drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Skills and Competencies:

Strong technical proficiency in developing MES applications, including customization, configuration, and development of interfaces for integration with ERP & other systems.
In-depth knowledge of discrete manufacturing processes, ideally in industries such as pharma, automotive, solar, or semiconductor.
Familiarity with manufacturing automation, robotics, and equipment interfacing with MES.
Experience in data integration and real-time monitoring solutions for manufacturing environments.
Knowledge of industry standards and best practices related to MES design and development.
Proficiency in programming languages and software development methodologies related to MES development (e.g., Java, .NET).
Problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues during MES implementation and operation.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and adapt to a dynamic manufacturing environment.
Effective communication & documentation skills to convey technical concepts and project details.
Project management skills to plan and execute MES development projects within specified timelines.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 15 years of experience in MES development for discrete manufacturing industries like pharma, automotive, solar / semiconductor experience preferred.
Previous experience with MES software platforms (e.g., Siemens OpsCenter, Dassault Delmia, Plex Smart Mfg., Honeywell Forge) is highly desired.
Familiarity with manufacturing process modeling and data flow in MES environments.
Knowledge of industry-specific regulations and compliance requirements related to MES implementation is advantageous.
Certifications in MES development or relevant manufacturing automation technologies are a plus.

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.

The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Conduct authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessments to identify security weaknesses.

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Manager - Training

The Manager - Training will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing training programs aimed at enhancing the skills and knowledge of employees within the organization. This role involves conducting training needs assessments, designing training materials, and delivering engaging training sessions. The Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of training programs with company objectives and employee performance metrics. Additionally, the role requires tracking and reporting on training effectiveness and participating in continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Conduct training needs assessments to identify gaps in employee skills and knowledge.
2. Design and develop training programs and materials tailored to various employee groups.
3. Deliver engaging and effective training sessions using various instructional techniques.
4. Collaborate with department heads to ensure training aligns with business goals.
5. Evaluate training effectiveness through surveys, assessments, and performance metrics.
6. Provide coaching and support to employees to reinforce learning outcomes.
7. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development.
8. Manage training budgets and resources efficiently.

Skills and Tools Required:
1. Strong communication and presentation skills.
2. Ability to design and develop training materials and programs.
3. Knowledge of adult learning principles and training methodologies.
4. Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training software.
5. Analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and make data-driven decisions.
6. Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
7. Project management skills to oversee training initiatives and meet deadlines.
8. Familiarity with performance management systems and tools.
9. Innovative thinking to create engaging and effective training solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
2. Proven experience in training and development within the insurance or financial services industry.
3. Certification in training or instructional design is a plus.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Strong knowledge of chemical plant operations, including safety procedures and protocols.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with colleagues.

Familiarity with chemical plant software and instrumentation is desirable.

Must pass a pre-employment physical and drug-alcohol screening.

Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To ensure efficient operation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and breakdown maintenance of mechanical equipment in the cement plant, with specific responsibility for crushers and associated material-handling equipment to minimize downtime and ensure smooth plant operations.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Crusher Operation and Maintenance
Perform preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of crushers, including jaw crushers, hammer crushers, impact crushers, and other crushing equipment, as applicable to the plant.
Monitor crusher performance, vibration, temperature, noise, lubrication, and equipment condition to identify potential faults.
Inspect and maintain crusher components, including hammers, blow bars, liners, jaw plates, bearings, shafts, rotors, and drive assemblies.
Identify and troubleshoot mechanical issues related to crushing equipment and ensure timely rectification of breakdowns.
Monitor wear parts and coordinate their replacement to maintain crushing efficiency and equipment availability.
Assist in maintenance and troubleshooting of crusher feed systems, belt conveyors, vibrating screens, feeders, and associated material-handling systems.
Ensure proper alignment, clearance, lubrication, and assembly of crusher components after maintenance activities.
B. Mechanical Maintenance
Execute scheduled preventive maintenance and equipment inspections as per the maintenance plan.
Maintain and troubleshoot mechanical equipment such as conveyors, gearboxes, motors, pumps, fans, bearings, couplings, and hydraulic systems.
Assist in equipment erection, installation, alignment, dismantling, and commissioning activities.
Identify recurring mechanical failures and support root cause analysis to prevent repeated breakdowns.
Ensure the availability of critical spares and maintain records of maintenance activities, breakdowns, and equipment history.
C. Safety and Compliance
Follow plant safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and applicable PPE requirements.
Ensure safe execution of maintenance activities, particularly during crusher inspection, cleaning, and repair.
Identify unsafe conditions and report equipment abnormalities, hazards, and near misses.
Maintain good housekeeping and ensure compliance with plant safety standards.
D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with production, electrical, instrumentation, and other maintenance teams for planned maintenance and breakdown resolution.
Maintain daily maintenance reports, inspection checklists, and breakdown records.
Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance costs.
2.. Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
Relevant technical qualifications in mechanical maintenance may be considered based on experience and company requirements.
3. Required Technical Skills
Practical knowledge of crusher maintenance, wear parts, bearings, shafts, lubrication, and drive mechanisms.
Understanding of preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and basic troubleshooting techniques.
Knowledge of conveyors, feeders, gearboxes, couplings, and material-handling equipment.
Ability to read mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and maintenance checklists.
Basic knowledge of maintenance planning, spare parts management, and root cause analysis.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and maintenance reporting systems.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with hands-on experience in crusher maintenance within a cement manufacturing plant, particularly limestone/raw material crushing, are preferred. The candidate should possess sound mechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to support preventive and breakdown maintenance activities independently under the guidance of the senior maintenance team.

Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: Thiepkseh SC- West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator

1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with English, Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills

Description:
At Saturday Art Class (SArC), we believe that every child deserves the tools to imagine, express, and grow. Saturday Art Class is a non-profit organization that provides visual arts and social-emotional learning (SEL) education to children from low-income communities in India. By creating safe spaces for students to express themselves, we help them build essential skills to thrive during their formative years.
Join us as we continue to make creativity a right, not a privilege, for every child, everywhere.
Role Overview
The Manager will play a critical role in anchoring the organization\'s work in Meghalaya by serving as a key bridge between the Mumbai-based team and state government stakeholders. The role will ensure seamless coordination across partnerships, training initiatives, curriculum contextualisation, and on-ground implementation. Working closely with government officials, school systems, and internal teams, the Manager will enable effective communication, alignment, and execution, ensuring that program design is responsive to the local context while staying aligned with organizational goals.
Roles and Responsibilities
Government Liaisoning and Partnerships
Act as a key point of coordination with government stakeholders, including DERT, the Directorate of School Education, and the MPower team
Support communication, scheduling, and follow-ups for meetings, reviews, and program updates
Build and maintain strong working relationships with state and district-level stakeholders to ensure alignment and continuity
Prepare briefs, reports, and communication materials for government engagements
Proactively engage with government stakeholders to understand priorities, evolving needs, and policy directions, and translate these into program actions
Ensure timely sharing of updates, data, and reports with government officials to build trust and transparency.
Support the preparation and facilitation of review meetings, presentations, and field visits with government stakeholders.
Track key decisions, approvals, and action points from government interactions, ensuring timely follow-through.
Identify opportunities to deepen the partnership, including scale-up, integration into existing systems, and long-term collaboration.
Training Coordination and Support
Plan and coordinate teacher training programs in collaboration with internal teams and government partners
Manage logistics, communication, and on-ground facilitation support for training sessions.
Track participation, engagement, and feedback from educators to inform ongoing improvements.
Support documentation of training processes and outcomes.
Curriculum Contextualisation
Act as a key bridge between government stakeholders and the internal curriculum team to co-develop a contextually relevant and effective well-being curriculum
Work closely with the curriculum team to adapt and contextualise the visual arts curriculum for Meghalaya
Incorporate local culture, practices, and classroom realities into curriculum design
Facilitate continuous feedback loops between government stakeholders, educators, and the curriculum team
Support pilot implementation of curriculum in schools and gather insights for iteration
Ensure alignment of curriculum with state priorities and education frameworks
Monitoring, Evaluation, and On-Ground Observations
Conduct regular school visits to observe classroom implementation and training impact
Collect qualitative and quantitative data to support monitoring and evaluation efforts
Document classroom practices, student engagement, and educator facilitation
Regularly review program dashboards and extract relevant insights to share with government officials and internal teams
Present key data points and trends to support decision-making, program improvements, and stakeholder updates
Share insights and feedback with internal teams to strengthen program design and delivery.
Program Coordination and Execution
Ensure alignment across partnerships, training, curriculum, and M&E workstreams, proactively identifying and resolving gaps.
Track progress of key program activities, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring accountability across teams.
Support and drive internal coordination between teams to enable smooth and timely on-ground execution.
Flag risks, delays, and dependencies early, and work with relevant stakeholders to problem-solve and course-correct.
Maintain structured trackers and systems for program management, ensuring visibility and transparency across teams.
Contribute to periodic reports, case studies, and program updates for both internal review and external stakeholders.
Support planning and execution of review meetings with government and internal teams, ensuring clear documentation and follow-through on action points.
Qualifications & Experience
5-6 years of experience in program management, operations, communications, consulting, or similar roles
Experience working closely with senior leadership and/or government stakeholders, with the ability to manage both strategic and operational responsibilities
Prior experience in the education or social sector is preferred, especially within government or school-based programs
Experience working in or with government systems, NGOs, or multi-stakeholder environments, particularly in Northeast India, is an added advantage
Demonstrated experience in professional writing, stakeholder communication, and supporting training or capacity-building initiatives, along with the ability to manage field operations and program tracking, documentation, and basic M&E processes.
Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, project management platforms, and communication tools
Based in Shillong, Meghalaya, with a willingness to travel across districts in Meghalaya as required
Working knowledge of Khasi and/or Garo is strongly preferred
Skills and Mindset
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with government stakeholders and represent the organization clearly
High ownership, reliability, and follow-through; able to independently drive workstreams and ensure closure
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, especially in managing multiple priorities and stakeholders
Ability to operate in dynamic, on-ground contexts
