Description:
Job Summary
The Civil Engineer will be responsible for planning, technical assessment, execution monitoring and quality supervision of construction, renovation, repair and infrastructure-development works undertaken by the Organisation. The role will ensure that civil works are completed in accordance with approved designs, specifications, budgets, timelines, safety requirements and organisational procurement and financial procedures. The position will also provide technical documentation and measurement-based verification to support transparent project implementation and payment processing.
Meghalaya


Responsibilities

A. Site Assessment and Technical Planning
Conduct site visits and assess existing infrastructure, site conditions and project requirements.
Prepare technical feasibility reports, layouts, drawings and specifications, as required.
Prepare detailed cost estimates, quantity calculations and Bills of Quantities (BOQs).
Identify material, labour, equipment and resource requirements and highlight technical risks.


B. Project Execution and Site Supervision
Supervise construction, renovation, repair and maintenance works at assigned locations.
Monitor contractors and vendors to ensure work is carried out as per approved drawings, BOQs, specifications and work orders.
Track site progress against approved timelines and budgets and submit periodic updates.
Identify delays, deviations and additional-work requirements and obtain written approval before execution of variations.
Coordinate with project teams, contractors, architects and other technical personnel.


C. Quality Control and Compliance
Inspect construction materials and workmanship at different stages of execution.
Ensure quality of materials and work conforms to approved specifications and applicable engineering standards.
Identify defects and recommend corrective measures within agreed timelines.
Monitor compliance with applicable building regulations, site-safety requirements and relevant standards.


D. Measurement and Contractor Bill Verification
Verify physical measurements and quantities of work completed at site.
Prepare or check Measurement Books (MBs) and item-wise measurement sheets.
Verify running and final contractor bills against actual work completed, approved BOQ and agreed rates.
Provide technical certification of work completed for payment processing, subject to organisational approval.
Document quantity variations, deductions and additional items with supporting justification.


E. Budgeting and Cost Monitoring
Prepare project-wise cost estimates and provide technical inputs for budget preparation.
Monitor expenditure and identify potential cost overruns or savings.
Review technical proposals for additional work and recommend cost-effective alternatives.
Ensure that work is not undertaken beyond the approved scope without prior written authorisation.


F. Procurement and Vendor Coordination
Prepare technical specifications and BOQs for procurement of civil works and materials.
Review vendor quotations for technical compliance and support preparation of technical comparisons.
Participate in technical evaluation of contractors and vendors, as required.
Coordinate with Procurement and Finance teams to ensure complete supporting documentation.


G. Safety, Documentation and Reporting
Monitor site-safety arrangements and report unsafe conditions or incidents promptly.
Maintain site inspection reports, progress records, approved drawings, BOQs and measurement records.
Maintain stage-wise and before-and-after photographs of civil works.
Prepare completion reports and technical completion certificates after verification of work.
Provide technical clarifications and records required for management reviews, audits or donor reporting.


Qualifications and Experience
Graduate degree or diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
Relevant experience in construction, renovation, infrastructure development or civil-work supervision.
Experience in preparing BOQs, cost estimates, technical drawings and measurement books.
Working knowledge of construction materials, quality standards, site supervision and contractor bill verification.
Experience in NGO, development-sector or institutional projects will be an advantage.


Skills and Competencies
Strong technical knowledge of civil construction and renovation works.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOQs and technical specifications.
Good measurement, estimation, costing and analytical skills.
Strong coordination, communication and vendor-management skills.
Ability to prepare clear site reports and maintain accurate documentation.
Proficiency in MS Office; knowledge of AutoCAD and relevant estimation tools will be an advantage.
Ability and willingness to travel to project sites, as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance Area: Timely completion; Expected Result: Civil works completed within approved timelines.
Performance Area: Budget adherence; Expected Result: Actual cost monitored against approved estimate and budget.
Performance Area: Quality; Expected Result: Compliance with approved specifications and timely closure of defects.
Performance Area: Measurement accuracy; Expected Result: Accurate and complete MBs and quantity verification.
Performance Area: Bill verification; Expected Result: Contractor bills technically checked against actual work and approved rates.
Performance Area: Documentation; Expected Result: Timely submission of site reports, photographs and completion records.
Performance Area: Safety and compliance; Expected Result: Prompt reporting and resolution/escalation of site-safety and compliance issues.


Working Relationships
The Civil Engineer will work closely with Project/Programme teams, Administration, Procurement, Finance, contractors, vendors and other stakeholders to ensure effective planning, execution, monitoring and documentation of civil works.


Authority and Accountability
The Civil Engineer is responsible for technical assessment, site supervision, measurement and technical recommendations. The Engineer shall not independently approve budgets, vendor selection, scope variations or payments unless specifically authorised in writing. All procurement, financial and administrative approvals shall follow the Organisations delegated-authority matrix and policies.

Description:
You will be the main point of contact for a small group of 3 to 5 client accounts. You run their client calls, plan and track their monthly work with our specialist teams, check the work before it reaches the client, and make sure every client gets what we promised, on time. You dont do the execution yourself. Our SEO, social media, ads, design, video and tech specialists do. You make sure it happens, and that its right.


What this Role Is
youve handled client accounts at a digital marketing agency, you understand marketing well enough to brief and check the work, and youre very organised.


What this Role Is Not
your background is IT project management, sales only, or SaaS customer support without marketing.


Responsibilities
Own your clients. Be the main contact for your 3 to 5 accounts. Lead the weekly and monthly client calls, and bring in a specialist when something technical needs explaining.
Plan the month. Take each clients agreed monthly plan and turn it into dated tasks, one task per line, on your client dashboard.
Track every day. Know whats happening on every task, spot delays early, and follow up with the team before a date slips.
Check before it goes out. Make sure every deliverable matches what the client asked for and what was agreed, after our team leads have approved the craft.
Report. Send each client a weekly update and a monthly report that explains results clearly.
Handle changes properly. Know the difference between a revision and new work. Log extra requests and get them priced, rather than quietly absorbing them.
Chase client inputs. Get the approvals, access and content you need from the client, early and in writing.
Keep and grow your accounts. Look after renewals, and spot where a client would benefit from more of our services.
Know your numbers. Understand the revenue and cost of your client group, and help keep it healthy.


Requirements
3 to 6 years of experience, with at least 2 years in client servicing or account management at a digital marketing agency
Has handled at least 3 clients at the same time
Understands social media, ads, SEO and content, and design and video well enough to brief and check the work
Very organised: trackers, dashboards or project tools like Asana, ClickUp, Trello or Google Sheets
Calm and clear in difficult client conversations
Excellent written and spoken English


Nice to Have
International clients (UK, US, UAE)
Both B2B and B2C clients
Understands marketing numbers: leads, cost per lead, traffic, engagement
Experience preparing client reports and presentations


Not Needed
Hands-on execution skills. Our specialist teams do the work.


KPIs
Your clients get what we promised, on time
Little work sent back by clients
Your clients renew and grow with us
Problems caught by you before the client notices
Clear, on-time weekly updates and monthly reports


Perks
Own a small, focused group of accounts: no juggling 15 clients
Specialist teams behind you, so you can focus on the client
A clear path to Client Servicing Lead

Description:

You will design social media posts, carousels, ad creatives, decks and brand visuals for our B2B and B2C clients, every day.


Job Type
Full-time


Responsibilities
Social media design. Posts, carousels, stories, reel covers and thumbnails for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
Ad creatives. Static ads for Meta, Google and LinkedIn, plus versions for testing, each changing one thing (the headline, the image or the colour).
Campaign visuals. Launches, offers, events and lead generation campaigns.
Decks and collateral. Presentations, proposals, reports, brochures, banners and website graphics. Print files are done properly (CMYK, bleed, outlined fonts).

Strong visual sense: layout, spacing, typography, colour and hierarchy

A portfolio showing social media and ad designs for real brands
Can design for several brands without making them all look the same
Takes feedback well and meets deadlines

Agency experience
Basic motion graphics or animation
Understands what makes an ad creative perform
Website or landing page visuals
Builds brand templates
Uses AI design tools


Key Performance Indicators
Designs delivered on time
Few errors, and briefs followed accurately
Quick, positive response to feedback
Visual quality improving across client accounts
Tidy files and clean handovers


Working Hours
Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 6 PM, Mohali or Shillong office. Some Saturdays may be working days.

We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Commercial) to support the execution of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Description:
Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.

We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion to drive financial access, literacy, and empowerment initiatives for rural communities and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).

Bank Linkage & Loan Facilitation: Facilitate SHG-bank linkages, streamline loan application processing, and monitor sanctioning, disbursement, and repayment.

Experience: 1-2 years of experience in Rural Development and Poverty Alleviation programs.
1-2 years of experience working in Banks, Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), or Microfinance Institutions (MFIs).
Technical Skills: Proficient in computer applications, with strong knowledge of MS Office and Google Sheets.

Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills

Experience: 2-3 years of experience in recruitment or HR support roles.
Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related fields.
Strong organizational, communication and administrative skills.
Experience in recruitment processes, interview scheduling and candidate coordination.

Job Description

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
The Location for this role is based in Eastern West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Description:
Job Summary
The objective of our advisory risk services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions can be used by our clients to build confidence and trust with their customers, the overall market and when required by regulation or contract.
You will be responsible for executing client related engagements in the areas of governance, risk compliance (GRC), internal audits, process reviews, standard operating procedures, enterprise risk management, revenue assurance.
Key Responsibilities
Execution on client engagement - Ensure quality delivery as per client requirements.
Review of working papers and client folders. Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
Understand business industry issues / trends. Identify areas requiring improvement in the clients business processes to enable preparation of recommendations.
Handling data analytics - Access, ACL etc.
Ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality risk management procedures.
Awareness of internal auditing standards issued by IIA and ICAI.
Demonstrate an application solution-based approach to problem solving technique.
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development.
Develop strong working relationships with client (process owner/functional heads).
Attention to detail and mentor young interns and analysts within the practice.
Contribute to knowledge management sessions within the practice.
Skills and Attributes for Success
Determine that the work delivered is of high quality.
Anticipate and identify engagement related risks and escalate issues as appropriate.
Actively establish client (process owner/functional heads) and internal relationships.
Assist and share knowledge with team members, Seniors and Managers in developing new methodologies and internal initiatives and participate in performing procedures especially focusing on complex, judgmental and/or specialized issues.
Work with the team and the client to create plans for accomplishing engagement objectives and a strategy that complies with professional standards and advise clients to understand and manage their business risks and verify the validity of their business information.
Brief the engagement team on the clients IA environment and industry IA trends.
Maintain relationships with client management to manage expectations of service, including work products, timing, and deliverables. Demonstrate a thorough understanding of compliance, financial, and operational risks along with performing internal control testing, develop internal audit plans, and provide internal audit services on an outsourcing basis. Assess internal controls and SOX framework in order to mitigate risk and apply it to client situations.

Description:
Join JPMorganChase as a Fund Servicing Associate II and be at the forefront of enhancing our operational services in fund accounting and administration. This role offers a unique opportunity for career growth and skill development, as you collaborate with a dynamic team and contribute to impactful solutions. Experience the benefits of being part of a leading financial institution that values innovation and continuous improvement.

As a Fund Servicing Associate ll within JPMorganChase, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our fund servicing operations. Leveraging your broad knowledge of fund accounting and administration, you will provide advice and support to ensure progress within established procedures and policies. Your work will have a significant impact on our department, requiring you to apply your advanced analytical and problem-solving skills to develop solutions for varied and complex issues. Your advanced emotional intelligence will be key in building trusting relationships and influencing better outcomes for our team and clients. Your role will also involve planning and organizing your own work, and potentially that of a team, while continuously seeking opportunities for improvement and innovation in our operating platform.

Job responsibilities
Oversee the maintenance of accurate accounting and securities records for each fund administered, ensuring adherence to all prescribed controls for fund accounting processes.
Investigate and resolve issues where accounting or securities transactions breach the validation tolerances of the JP Morgan system, applying advanced problem-solving skills.
Implement operational procedures to complete tasks accurately and timely.
Partner with various Operations Teams, Technology, Product, Sales, Program Management.
Identify and address vulnerabilities in our fund servicing processes, leveraging your proficiency in continuous improvement to enhance efficiency and resilience.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Demonstrated expertise in fund accounting and administration, with at least five years of experience focusing on maintaining accurate accounting and securities records, evidenced by successful management of related tasks and responsibilities.
Demonstrated proficiency in identifying and resolving issues related to accounting or securities transactions, ensuring compliance with validation tolerances.
Proven ability to implement operational procedures and controls, with a focus on enhancing cybersecurity and anti-fraud measures.
Advanced emotional intelligence skills, with a proven track record of building trusting relationships and influencing better outcomes for teams and clients.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Experience working across multiple business areas and/or functions to deliver results
Demonstrated expertise in financial reporting, fund administration, accounting, and/or custody, with five years of experience preferred, evidenced by successful handling of related tasks and responsibilities.
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond promptly to requests from guests and other departments. Fill cart with supplies and transport cart to assigned area. Enter guest rooms following procedures for gaining access and ensuring vacancy before entering. Replace guest amenities and supplies in rooms. Replace dirty linens and terry with clean items. Make beds and fold terry. Clean bathrooms. Remove trash, dirty linen, and room service items. Check that all appliances are present in the room and in working order. Straighten desk items, furniture, and appliances. Dust, polish, and remove marks from walls and furnishings. Vacuum carpets and performs floor care duties (e.g., in guest rooms and hallway).
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and in excess of 25 pounds with assistance. Ability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related equipment over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for an extended period across an entire work shift. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: No high school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Strong persuasion and presentation skills

Target-oriented and self-driven mindset
Willingness to learn and accept feedback
Good professional presence and email etiquette

Description:
We're a growing Pune-based company seeking a skilled Architectural Designer to join our team. As a key member, you'll create exceptional architectural projects, preparing detailed designs, working drawings, and municipal drawings.

Responsibilities
- Develop accurate and precise project details
- Coordinate with consultants for timely project completion
- Utilize relevant software efficiently (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit)

Requirements
- Proficiency in Architectural Design, Working Drawings, and Municipal Drawings
- Strong understanding of architectural principles and practices
- Excellent coordination and communication skills
- Ability to work independently and in a team

What We Offer
- Opportunity to grow with a dynamic company
- Collaborative and supportive work environment
- Professional development and learning opportunities

Ideal Candidate
- Passionate about architectural design
- Strong work ethic and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills

We're looking for a long-term association with the right candidate. If you're a motivated and talented Architectural Designer, we'd love to hear from you. Join our team and contribute to exceptional projects.

Company Culture
We value innovation, teamwork, and growth. Our company is dedicated to delivering high-quality architectural projects, and we're looking for someone who shares our vision.

Job Description - Kitchen Associate
Were Salad Days, and were on a mission to make healthy eating delicious and convenient! Since 2014, weve been revolutionizing Indias food scene with our meals. Were passionate about helping people integrate healthy, nourishing meals into their daily lives, all while retaining the taste. Salad Days currently operates in Delhi NCR, Bangalore and Mumbai with 29 kitchens in total.

Job Details
Job Title
Kitchen Associate
As a Kitchen Associate, your main responsibility is to support daily kitchen operations. This includes keeping your station clean, following food safety rules, helping with basic prep work, and assisting in food preparation while maintaining good quality. Youll also help with sanitisation and hygiene in the kitchen. Packing and dispatch may be done occasionally, only when required. One meal(Rice + Indian Curry) is provided per shift. Employees working in break shifts will receive 2 meals.
Store Operating Hours
7:00 AM to 3:00 AM
Working Shift Hours
Candidate must be open to working in break shifts, which run in 2 parts:
Morning: 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM || Evening: 7:00 PM to 12:00 AM
Regular Shift Duration
10 hours

Key Responsibilities
Maintain kitchen hygiene and follow food safety rules.
Do mise-en-place prep and ensure quality before cooking.
Assist in cooking and assembling meals as per standards.
Support in packing dispatch only when needed.
Keep your station clean and hygienic.

Requirements
Minimum High school(10th) education with basic understanding of cutting and food preparation.
Physically fit and ready for working in a fast-paced kitchen environment.
Good hygiene, discipline, punctual, clean shaved and willingness to learn.
Must be flexible to do break shifts.
Able to follow instructions and work in a team.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONS
QA/Compliance Engineer
Department: Quality Assurance / Compliance
Reports To: Lead QA Engineer / Head of Compliance
Location: Mumbai Office (On-site)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience Level: Entry Level to Mid-Level (15 years)
Key Deliverables: Edge Device Demo (Quality Validation), STQC Certification Documentation (Initiation & Ownership)
Role Summary
We are looking for a QA / Compliance Engineer to join our Quality & Compliance team in Mumbai. This role has two closely linked deliverables: rigorously testing and validating our edge device demo to ensure it meets functional, performance, and reliability standards, and driving the STQC (Standardisation Testing and Quality Certification) documentation process required for deployment into government, defence, and other regulated sectors.
While our Edge Engineers build and optimize the demo, this role owns the quality gate and compliance pathway verifying the system works as intended under real-world conditions, and ensuring we have the documentation, test evidence, and process rigor needed to pursue formal certification.
Key Responsibilities
Edge Device Demo Quality Validation
Design and execute test plans for the edge device demo, covering functional testing, performance/load testing, regression testing, and edge-case/failure-mode testing.
Validate on-device model behaviour against expected outputs, including accuracy checks, latency benchmarks, and resource utilization (memory, power, thermal) under varying conditions.
Test the demo under real-world constraints relevant to the target domains offline/low-connectivity operation, intermittent power, and varying environmental conditions.
Identify, document, and track defects/issues through to resolution, working closely with Edge Engineers and ML Training Engineers.
Conduct security-oriented testing on the device (basic penetration checks, access control validation, data handling verification) in coordination with the Security team.
Prepare formal test reports and sign-off documentation confirming the demo's readiness for stakeholder presentation or field piloting.
STQC Certification Documentation
Own and drive the initiation of the STQC certification process, including identifying the applicable testing/certification track for the product category.
Compile and maintain the technical documentation package required for STQC submission: system architecture documents, security control descriptions, test plans, test reports, and traceability matrices.
Liaise with STQC-empanelled testing labs and/or compliance consultants to understand requirements, timelines, and submission formats.
Conduct internal gap analysis against STQC requirements and coordinate with Engineering, Security, and Product teams to close identified gaps.
Maintain version-controlled, audit-ready documentation repositories for all certification-related artifacts.
Track certification milestones and provide status updates to leadership on progress toward certification readiness.
General QA & Compliance
Establish and maintain QA processes (test case design, defect management, release sign-off criteria) applicable across edge, backend, and licensing systems as needed.
Support compliance requirements relevant to target sectors healthcare (HIPAA-aligned data handling), defence (classification/handling protocols), and BFSI (RBI/SEBI-aligned data governance) in collaboration with domain and legal/compliance stakeholders.
Contribute to internal audits and readiness assessments ahead of client or regulatory reviews.
Build and maintain documentation standards/templates to streamline future certification and compliance efforts across product lines.
Required Qualifications & Experience
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience: 05 years in QA/testing, compliance, or a related quality-focused engineering role. Strong project/internship experience in software testing or regulatory documentation is welcomed for entry-level candidates.
Understanding of software testing fundamentals: test case design, functional/regression/performance testing, defect lifecycle management.
Strong documentation skills ability to write clear, structured, audit-ready technical and compliance documents.
Basic understanding of hardware/embedded systems testing concepts (useful for edge device validation), or willingness to learn.
Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, or similar).
Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills to manage documentation across multiple parallel workstreams.
Comfortable working with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Security, Product, external certification bodies).
Preferred / Good to Have
Prior exposure to STQC, CE, FCC, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or other product/security certification processes.
Experience testing embedded/edge/IoT systems, including performance and security testing on constrained hardware.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to healthcare (HIPAA), defence data handling protocols, or BFSI compliance (RBI/SEBI guidelines).
Experience with automated testing frameworks or scripting (Python) for building test automation.
Background in quality management systems (QMS) or exposure to structured audit processes.
Prior coordination experience with external testing labs, auditors, or certification bodies.
What We're Looking For (Mindset)
Someone who is rigorous and methodical this role is the quality and compliance gate before systems reach clients or regulators.
Strong written communicator, comfortable producing formal documentation that will be reviewed by external certification bodies.
Patient and process-oriented, since certification pathways (like STQC) involve structured, sometimes lengthy, procedural requirements.
A collaborative bridge-builder who can translate between engineering teams and compliance/regulatory stakeholders.
Work Conditions
Base location: Mumbai office (on-site), with hands-on testing of edge hardware as part of regular responsibilities.
Regular coordination with Edge Engineers, LLM Training Engineers, Security, and external STQC-empanelled labs/consultants.
Occasional travel may be required for lab visits or on-site testing/certification activities, as needed.
Compensation & Benefits
Compensation will be commensurate with experience and benchmarked to industry standards for entry-to-mid-level QA/compliance engineering roles.
Benefits include health insurance and performance-linked incentives (full details shared during the offer stage).
How to Apply
Interested candidates can apply by sharing their updated resume on career@pagariyagroup.com along with details of any relevant experience in software/hardware testing, quality assurance, or regulatory/compliance documentation.
Given the regulated nature of target sectors (health, defence, BFSI), this role requires comfort with structured, audit-driven processes and close attention to documentation accuracy.

Job Title
Job Title: Associate or Senior Editor, Nature Communications (Biomaterials)
Location
Location: Shanghai, Nanjing, Beijing, Pune, New Delhi, Hybrid working model
Job Summary
Nature Communications is the leading multidisciplinary Open Access journal, publishing high-quality scientific research. To help us to build on the success of this journal, we are seeking a scientist with a background in biomaterials, nanozymes, drug delivery, nanoprobes for imaging/ therapy or related areas. The ideal candidate will have a critical eye, a deep understanding of their subject and interests beyond, and the ability to think on their feet.
The Associate/Senior Editor role at Nature Communications is ideal for researchers who love science but feel that a career at the bench isn't enough to sate your desire to learn more about the natural world and for those who enjoy reading papers outside their chosen area of research.
Responsibilities
Handling original research papers and working closely with other editors throughout the editorial process, applying strong publishing workflows systems and operational excellence.
Critically assessing the novelty, significance and scientific quality of manuscripts, demonstrating strong manuscript assessment, critical scientific evaluation and scientific comprehension.
Making timely, well-reasoned editorial decisions based on independent assessment and expert advice, demonstrating strong decision quality.
Communicating decisions and scientific issues clearly and constructively to authors and reviewers, using strong communication and scientific academic writing skills.
Working collaboratively with editors across Nature Communications and the Nature Portfolio, demonstrating collaboration, interpersonal awareness and being resilient when navigating complex editorial situations.
Representing the journal at conferences and research institutions, building relationships with the international scientific community and helping shape the representation of biomaterials within the journal.
Requirements
A PhD (or equivalent) in biomaterials, particularly in areas such as nanozymes, drug delivery, chemical tools for biomedical imaging and therapy.
Some postdoctoral research experience is preferred but not essential. A thorough understanding of the fundamentals of the subject is essential.
A passion for science and a thirst to learn more. You must be able to demonstrate the breadth of your interest in scientific research, both within and beyond your speciality and across the wider field of biomaterials.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills and be fluent in English (written and spoken).
The ability to read and assess the novelty, context and implications of research submitted to the journal from different areas of this discipline.
Be eager to travel and meet scientists worldwide, learn more about them and their research, and help them learn more about us and what we are looking for in the papers we seek to publish.
This role can be in our Shanghai, Nanjing, Beijing, Pune and New Delhi locations (hybrid working available). Qualified internal candidates from other locations will also be considered. The position is offered on a full-time, permanent basis. Editorial experience is not required, although applicants with significant editorial experience are encouraged to apply and will potentially be considered for Senior Editor positions.
To Apply
Applicants should include a CV, and a cover letter explaining their interest in the post and their preferred office of employment.
At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress - and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodation. Find out more about our DEI work.

Description:
About the Role
As a As an Officer - Institutional Lending Operations (5.3), you will support the lending functions within Institutional Lending Operations through accurate and timely loan processing, static data and limit maintenance activities across Loan IQ, OCP, Razor and related platforms. You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to deliver exceptional customer outcomes while ensuring operational excellence, compliance and risk management standards are maintained
Banking is changing and we re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
Role Location: Bengaluru
Role Type: Permanent, Fulltime
What will your day look like
Process lending transactions, static data updates, and limit maintenance activities accurately across Loan IQ, OCP, Razor and related applications.
Verify lending documentation and transaction details, ensuring all activities are completed in accordance with operational procedures and service level agreements.
Deliver exceptional customer service by collaborating with stakeholders across Operations and business teams to resolve enquiries and issues.
Support workflow management, business continuity requirements, and operational control activities while maintaining quality standards.
Identify process improvements, escalate risks appropriately, and contribute to cross-skilling and continuous improvement initiatives.
What will you bring
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
Must Have
Experience in Institutional or Commercial Lending Operations, loan servicing, credit administration, or lending documentation.
Sound knowledge of Loan IQ or similar lending platforms, including loan servicing and facility maintenance activities.
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting service commitments.
Good to Have
Understanding of lending documentation including Letters of Offer and facility documentation.
Strong stakeholder management and customer service skills.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration capabilities.
You re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we d love to hear from you.

Consultant
EY is looking for Consultant.
T he opportunity
As a Consultant you will help the team deliver and contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner.
Your key responsibilities
Your client responsibilities:
o Conduct the engagement in a professional manner and in accordance with
client expectations and as defined by the terms and conditions of the contract.
o Preparation and filing of individual tax return, e-TDS return, drafting of
s ubmiss i ons before tax authorities, representation before the tax authorities,
advising on outbound/ inbound structuring in connection with movement of employees, working knowledge of immigration and provident fund in connection with expatriates, etc
Your people responsibilities:
o Exhibit positive attitude and demonstrate willingness to learn.
o Work constructively with team to evaluate and improve personal and team
performance.
o Contribute and leverage knowledge from individuals, databases and other
sources.
o Provide timely and high-quality services and work products that exceed client
expectations.
Operational Excellence / Day to day responsibilities:
o Participate in executing work within a group by assisting by delivering work
effectiv e ly, and teaming with tax professionals to provide comprehensive tax solutions.
o Ensure that the areas of work assigned are executed in accordance with the
work programme and the firm s methodologies and guidance, and
professional standards.
o Use electronic working papers, efficiently including various software
applications and sources of knowledge in an appropriate manner to conduct
research.
o Acquire and demonstrate competence in technical knowledge, and
compliance process by keeping up to date on trends, developments and technical authorities and apply them to moderately complex situations.
o Analyze and convert data into a tax product (advisory/compliance) and
ensure accuracy and timeliness of the product.
o Where applicable thoroughly check documents and make available for tax
inspections in an appropriate manner.
o Demonstrate professionalism through a positive and cooperative attitude and
by maintaining the confidential and proprietary nature of client relationships and related work products.
o Contribute to the overall success of the team by developing a thorough understanding of our methodologies and tools to enhance service delivery;
keeping team members informed of work status; actively seeking
2
assignments when unassigned; proactively seeking opportunities to provide tax services; challenging traditional procedures used in the past; and
attempting to find new approach
Skills and attributes for success
Good Communication skills (Written Oral)
Profi c ient in MS word, excel, power point
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
Strong Analytical/Numerical ability
Enthusiastic and Self Starter
Team Player
Ability to grasp details
Good time management skills
T o qualify for the role y ou must have
A certified CA
0-1 year of relevant experience
Ideally you ll also have
Good interpersonal skills
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.
What working at EY offers
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excell e nt client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we re using the fin a nce products, expertise and systems we ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.

Description:
Those in internal audit at PwC help build, optimise and deliver end-to-end internal audit services to clients in all industries. This includes IA function setup and transformation, co-sourcing, outsourcing and managed services, using AI and other risk technology and delivery models. IA capabilities are combined with other industry and technical expertise, in areas like cyber, forensics and compliance, to address the full spectrum of risks. This helps organisations to harness the power of IA to help the organisation protect value and navigate disruption, and obtain confidence to take risks to power growth.
You are a reliable, contributing member of a team. In our fast-paced environment, you are expected to adapt, take ownership and consistently deliver quality work that drives value for our clients and success as a team.
Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
Apply a learning mindset and take ownership for your own development.
Appreciate diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
Adopt habits to sustain high performance and develop your potential.
Actively listen, ask questions to check understanding, and clearly express ideas.
Seek, reflect, act on, and give feedback.
Gather information from a range of sources to analyse facts and discern patterns.
Commit to understanding how the business works and building commercial awareness.
Learn and apply professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), uphold the Firms code of conduct and independence requirements.

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service

CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4

20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Job Summary
Independently design, develop and validate CNC programs for a range of metal cutting machine tools. Accountable for CNC program safety, quality, OTD and process efficiency. Be tasked with production support such as machine and process trouble shooting.
Responsibilities
Support NC programmer team.
Gain technical knowledge as part of the work.
Communicate with counterparts to roll out jobs.
Control the handling of CNC programs in the server.
Achieve individual metrics and support team s target.
Select appropriate tools and process for the given situation.
Complete the timecard of the duties performed in duly manner.
Interact with engineering department to process jobs when required.
Meets customer s delivery date and Maintain teams on time delivery.
Flexible in cross region programming by understanding the regional differences.
Embrace the CIP culture, refine the routine tasks and facilitate more effective process in place to improve the deliverables.
Create programs in CAM software (Esprit) by Identifying, understanding the drawing symbols, sections, detail views in the component drawings.
Utilize computer aided design/computer aided manufacturing (CAD/CAM) and related computer technology to develop programs and tool path models.
Flexible in cross machine programming by understanding the programming differences.
Makes or offer suggestions on drawing changes to improve manufacturability.
Needs to be able to read and follow written instructions or procedures
Needs to be proficient creating/designing, editing, maintaining Microsoft Excel files.
Perform individual responsibilities related to portfolios, committees and other areas apart from regular programming.
Other duties as assigned
Requirements
Preferred Experience / Skills
Data analytical skills and engineering knowledge
Strong ethical values
Good communication skills and team oriented
Self-motivated Strong inter-personal skills
Should have experience in working with PC, should able to trouble shoot basic requirements like mapping of drives, access and navigation of different folder
Basic knowledge of shop floor practices
Ability to correct routes: PS0021, SD0800, SF0010, Times etc. in PRMS
Basic knowledge of Programming; either lathe programs or drill programs
Proficiency in Esprit (CAM tool) environment added advantage
Can read technical drawings/drawings of seals and parts
Understands the imperial system (inches)
Required to understand the basics of programming like CNC machine, codes, various languages used
Should be able to identify the GDT symbols, define the process and how it affects the programming
Identify the milling process involved in the part and should also possess knowledge on matching the same
Experience in handling Mazak integrex machines
Proficiency in AutoCAD environment added advantage
HS Diploma / GED and / or 0-2 years relevant experience

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.

Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus
