Description:
Regulatory, Risk & Forensic
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
Position Summary
Level: Consultant or equivalent
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
Work youll do:
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic Operate professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. 
We support clients by delivering Operate services spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. We embed continuous advantage through domain, industry, technology / Gen AI, and transformation skills to perform client business functions that manage risk and deliver value - added outcomes.
The Consultant will be responsible for completing timely and high-quality validation activities, as well as, for identifying issues, validation concerns, and observations, recommending corrective actions, presenting results of validation reviews, interfacing with business partners, and writing reports. Additionally, in this role, you will:
Plan and complete testing within required timeframes and in accordance with established processes and procedures
Applying risk analysis principles, determine the scope, including focus, objectives, and rationale
Develop testing strategies, including procedures and selection of samples, sample size, and rationale 
Prepare working papers, ensure that documentation appropriately supports the testing conclusions, and document process flows and describe major processes within the area being reviewed
Analyze the results of testing and review activities. Analyze exceptions and make recommendations to enhance internal controls
Ensure that testing is accurate, complete, and in accordance with standards and protocols. Communicate test/review results and issues/concerns to leadership, validating and recommending resolutions to issues
Effectively communicate the testing or validation process, status, and results to business and risk partners
Write and/or review reports or presentations that clearly articulate the results/conclusions of testing or validation activities
Effectively communicate with leadership and escalate validation concerns or issues as appropriate

Meet the Team
The Silicon One ASIC delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. With ~2,100 employees across 16 countries, we design the networking hardware for Enterprises and Service Providers of various sizes, the Public Sector, and Non-Profit Organizations across the world. Experience with ATPG and EDA tools like TestMax, Tetramax, Tessent tool sets, PrimeTime
Verification skills include, System Verilog Logic Equivalency checking and validating the Test-timing of the design

Strong verbal skills and ability to thrive in a multifaceted environment
Scripting skills: Tcl, Python/Perl.

Verilog design experience - developing custom DFT logic IP integration; familiarity with functional verification
DFT CAD development - Test Architecture, Methodology and Infrastructure
Test Static Timing Analysis
Post silicon validation using DFT patterns.

Experience integrating Amazon Connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk, or Microsoft Dynamics.
Proficiency in REST APIs, web services, and cloud integrations.
Understanding of contact center reporting, analytics, and monitoring solutions.
AWS certifications are desirable.

Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge
Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN)
Product Structure Management
BOM Management
Workflow Management
Release Management
Document Management
CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills
SQL Queries and Database Fundamentals
PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3 to 8 years of experience in PLM application support.
Experience in global production support environments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
ITIL certification is preferred.
Required Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with global and cross-functional teams.
Customer-focused approach with strong ownership mindset.
Ability to work in rotational shifts and provide production support when required.
Strong documentation and reporting skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter BMIDE knowledge.
Teamcenter Active Workspace exposure.
Aras administration/support experience.
Understanding of manufacturing and engineering business processes.
Exposure to deployment and release management activities.
Experience in performance tuning and application monitoring.

8 - 14 years of experience in Oracle HCM applications, with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll.

Manage incidents, service requests, changes and problem records in line with SLAs / KPIs, including prioritization, risks, escalations and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate with Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Time and Labor, Integrations, Reporting and Finance teams, and lead quarterly release impact assessment and regression testing.

Description:
Designation - Assistant Manager HR (Area HR) - Warehouse
Education - Diploma/Degree , MBA
Age - Up to 38 ( Only Male Candidate )
Experience - 10 to 15 years
Job Description -
1 Talent Acquisition and Onboarding
Manage hiring for all on-roll and contractual roles as per the approved manpower plan.
Coordinate with contractors for daily/weekly manpower availability and ensure the same.
Drive joining formalities, documentation, ID creation, induction and plant orientation.
2. Employee Life Cycle Management (End-to-End)
Maintain employee records, personal files, contract staff muster, shift rosters.
Ensure timely confirmation, transfers, promotions, increments, and separations.
Drive exit formalities, full & final settlement coordination, and attrition control.
3. HR Operations & Payroll Coordination
Ensure accurate inputs for attendance, incentives, weekly off etc.
Verify contractor bills and ensure compliance with MW and Payment of wages & PF/ESIC etc.
Coordinate with the payroll team for timely disbursal and issue resolutions if any.
4. Contract Labour Management
Oversee onboarding, attendance, wage compliance and statutory records for all off-roll employees.
Conduct monthly contractor audits: PF/ESIC challans, wage slips, muster, bonus, leave etc
Ensure CLRA license, RC, and documentation are valid.
5. Statutory Compliance & Audits
Ensure compliance with Factories Act, CLRA, Minimum Wages Act, Bonus Act, Gratuity Act, and other state-specific regulations.
Maintain statutory registers and ensure readiness for inspections.
Support external audits: FSSAI etc
6. Industrial Relations & Discipline
Handle shop floor discipline issues, grievances, counselling, and issue of notices/charge sheets where needed.
Support healthy employee relations in close coordination with the Factory Manager and Area HR Head.
Maintain harmonious relations between staff, operators, contract workforce, and contractors.
7. Training & Capability Building
Identify unit-level training needs (food safety, GMP, safety, HR policy awareness).
Conduct daily/weekly briefing talks or coordinate functional training.
Maintain training records and skill-matrix for operators.
8. Employee Engagement & Welfare
Drive engagement calendar: festivals, R&R, skip-levels, suggestion programs.
Ensure availability of welfare facilities: drinking water, rest area, washrooms, PPE, first-aid, canteen.
Monitor hygiene, safety and morale on the shopfloor.
9. HR MIS, Analytics & Reporting
Prepare and maintain monthly HR dashboards:
Attendance, attrition, overtime, contractor compliance score, open positions, training records, statutory status.
Share daily/weekly MIS with Factory Manager & Area HR Head.
10. Support to Business & Operations
Partner with production, quality and shift leads to ensure manpower efficiency.
Support productivity, food safety and operational performance through timely HR interventions.
Drive culture of discipline, safety, responsibility and performance.

JOB OVERVIEW


We are seeking an experienced Billing Platform Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in both Billing and Revenue capabilities, with extensive experience in subscription billing, usage-based billing, pricing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will drive business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs.
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, architecture, business process design, functional and technical design, application configuration, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts, testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, and stakeholder communication while driving successful project milestones.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a key role in practice development by contributing to solution accelerators, AI-enabled delivery, capability building, pre-sales, client workshops, and thought leadership initiatives. The individual will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, improve business outcomes, and support enterprise growth.


Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the solution architecture and design for enterprise Quote-to-Cash transformations across Billing and Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations. Lead end-to-end Billing Platform solution architecture for large-scale implementation programs.
Manage end-to-end implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution design, configuration, development, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, and hypercare while leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmap.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, develop scalable solution designs, and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices. Excellent client-facing skills and communication (written/verbal) skills
Establish delivery governance, manage project risks and dependencies, review solution quality, ensure compliance with architectural standards, and drive successful milestone execution through proactive stakeholder communication and issue resolution.
Contribute to practice development through pre-sales, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, capability building, mentoring, solution assets, thought leadership, and the development of reusable frameworks that enhance delivery efficiency and support business growth.
Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes.
Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses
Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation.
Understand customer business processes/functional specifications and independently drive technical solutioning to delivery
Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution
Must ensure teams follow the correct procedures, best practices and documentation requirements across project phases
Drive solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Technical Skills:
API, SQL, CSS, HTML, Java Script, JSON and XML
Certifications:
BillingPlatform Partner Essential Certification (L1)
BillingPlatform Partner Pro Certification (L2)
BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Senior Manager - Billing Platform - Finance Solutions, you will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to drive business transformation initiatives, translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. You will engage with executive stakeholders, delivering large-scale digital transformation programs that optimize revenue operations and support enterprise growth.

As a Senior Manager, you will guide cross-functional teams, applying sound judgment and strategic advising to solve complex problems. You will motivate and coach teams, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment that contributes to the firm's success. Your role involves crafting impactful messages, validating outcomes with clients, and navigating challenging situations with composure. We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer with deep expertise in Routers, Switches, Wireless Access Points, Wireless Controllers, and Firewalls to design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, and security of the organizations network fabric across LAN, WAN, wireless, and perimeter security domains, supporting business continuity and enabling seamless connectivity.
Responsibilities

Router Administration & WAN Management
Design, deploy, and manage enterprise routers (Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent) across LAN, WAN, and SD-WAN environments
Configure and maintain dynamic routing protocols including OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP for optimal path selection and redundancy
Manage WAN connectivity including MPLS, leased lines, broadband, and SD-WAN overlays
Implement and maintain QoS policies to prioritize business-critical traffic across WAN links
Perform router hardening, IOS/firmware upgrades, and lifecycle management
Troubleshoot routing issues, packet loss, and latency affecting network performance and application availability
Switch Administration & LAN Management
Deploy, configure, and administer enterprise-grade switches (Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, or equivalent) in access, distribution, and core layers
Design and manage VLAN architecture, trunking (802.1Q), and inter-VLAN routing to support network segmentation
Configure and maintain spanning tree protocols (STP, RSTP, MSTP) to prevent loops and ensure redundancy
Implement link aggregation (LACP/PAGP), port security, and storm control across the switching infrastructure
Perform switch stack management, firmware upgrades, and hardware lifecycle activities
Monitor switch performance, port utilization, and MAC address tables to proactively identify and resolve issues
Wireless Access Point Deployment & Management
Deploy, configure, and manage enterprise Wireless Access Points (Cisco, Aruba, Meraki, or equivalent) across campus, branch, and remote sites
Perform RF site surveys, channel planning, and transmit power optimization to ensure seamless wireless coverage
Configure SSIDs, band steering, roaming policies (802.11r/k/v), and QoS for wireless clients
Monitor AP health, client association metrics, and interference sources to maintain optimal wireless performance
Perform firmware upgrades, configuration audits, and hardware replacement for access point lifecycle management
Support high-density wireless deployments for conference rooms, auditoriums, and open-plan office environments
Wireless Controller Administration
Administer and manage centralized Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC) and cloud-managed wireless platforms (Cisco WLC, Aruba Mobility Controller, or equivalent)
Configure and maintain controller-based policies for mobility, roaming, load balancing, and client exclusion
Manage WLAN profiles, RF groups, mobility groups, and guest access portals across controller clusters
Implement and maintain wireless security policies including WPA3, 802.1X/EAP, certificate-based authentication, and NAC integration
Perform controller software upgrades, redundancy failover testing, and disaster recovery validation
Integrate wireless controllers with AAA platforms (RADIUS/TACACS+) and network management systems for centralized visibility
Firewall & Perimeter Security Administration
Design, implement, and manage enterprise firewalls (Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or equivalent) for perimeter and internal segmentation
Create and maintain firewall rule sets, security zones, NAT policies, and application-layer inspection policies
Manage VPN configurations including site-to-site IPSec VPN and remote access VPN (SSL/TLS) for secure connectivity
Implement and maintain Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) policies, URL filtering, and threat intelligence feeds
Conduct periodic firewall rule base reviews, policy optimization, and compliance audits
Respond to security events flagged by firewall logs, and coordinate with the SOC team for threat investigation and remediation

Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field preferred
Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network administration and engineering
Strong proficiency in routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) and switching technologies (VLANs, STP, LACP)
Proven experience with enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco, Aruba, or Meraki) including controller and AP management
Hands-on expertise with enterprise firewall platforms (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco FTD, or Check Point)
Experience with network security standards including 802.1X, WPA3, IPSec VPN, and SSL/TLS VPN
Familiarity with network automation tools and scripting (Python, Ansible, Netmiko, or NAPALM)
Strong working knowledge of ITIL principles and ITSM practices
Industry certifications preferred: CCNA / CCNP, PCNSE, NSE 4+, Aruba ACMP, or equivalent
Current understanding of industry trends including SD-WAN, SASE, Zero Trust Networking, and cloud networking
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with ability to work under pressure during critical incidents
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams

Knowledge Preferred: The candidate is expected to have strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
•  Strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
•  Strong understanding of OneStream application design, metadata, workflows, security, business rules, reporting and integrations.

•  Good knowledge of Multi-GAAP, multi-entity and multi-currency applications.

•  Ability to lead requirement-gathering and solution-design activities, support testing and deployment, establish best practices, guide team members and client stakeholders, and build prototypes or proof-of-concept applications.


Job Requirements

•  8+ years of overall experience in CPM/EPM, finance transformation, financial systems or related consulting roles.

•  Ability to guide business users during planning, forecasting, month-end, quarter-end or year-end reporting cycles, based on the candidate's area of expertise.
•  Experience leading and mentoring project team members, with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation and documentation skills.

Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva and blackline End to end implementation
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.
Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.
Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Lead SAP PM functional consulting activities across requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to understand maintenance processes, asset management requirements, and operational challenges.
Configure and implement SAP Plant Maintenance functionalities including Technical Objects, Functional Locations, Equipment Masters, Work Centers, Maintenance Notifications, Maintenance Orders, Task Lists, Maintenance Plans, and Measuring Points/Counters.
Design and optimize preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance processes aligned with business objectives.
Analyze business requirements and prepare functional specifications for custom developments, reports, forms, enhancements, interfaces, and workflows.
Perform fit-gap analysis and recommend SAP best practices to improve maintenance efficiency and asset reliability.
Work closely with ABAP, Basis, Data Migration, and Integration teams to implement business requirements.
Configure and support calibration management, refurbishment processes, warranty tracking, and maintenance costing processes.
Manage SAP PM integration with MM, QM, PP, SD, PS, and FICO modules to support end-to-end business processes.
Support inventory and spare parts management through PM-MM integration.
Define authorization requirements and assist in security role testing related to maintenance functions.
Participate in data migration activities involving equipment masters, functional locations, maintenance plans, task lists, and historical maintenance data.
Develop and execute unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and regression testing scenarios.
Prepare configuration documents, functional design documents (FDD), business process documents (BPD), test scripts, and end-user training materials.
Support cutover planning, go-live activities, hypercare support, and production stabilization.
Analyze and resolve production issues, ensuring adherence to SLAs and business continuity requirements.
Collaborate with business users to drive continuous process improvements and system optimization initiatives.
Provide guidance on SAP S/4HANA PM functionalities and Fiori applications related to maintenance operations.
Support implementation of asset management strategies focused on equipment reliability, maintenance compliance, and cost optimization.
Participate in project estimation, effort planning, risk assessment, and change request management.
Mentor junior consultants and provide functional expertise during project execution.
Work directly with client leadership, plant maintenance teams, operations teams, and external stakeholders in a customer-facing consulting role.
Ensure solutions comply with industry standards and maintenance best practices across Manufacturing, Automotive, Pharma, Chemicals, Utilities, Oil & Gas, and Engineering sectors.
Must have hands-on experience in at least one complete end-to-end SAP PM implementation lifecycle covering Blueprint, Realization, Testing, Go-Live, and Hypercare phases.

Preferred candidate profile

Minimum 6+ years of strong SAP PM functional consulting experience.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
Completed at least one full-cycle end-to-end SAP PM implementation project with active involvement across all project phases.
Strong hands-on expertise in SAP PM configuration and business process design.
Experience working on SAP S/4HANA PM implementations, migrations, or transformation projects.
Good understanding of Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and maintenance management best practices.
Proven experience in maintenance planning, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, shutdown management, and asset lifecycle management.
Strong integration knowledge with SAP MM, QM, PP, PS, and FICO modules.
Experience in preparing functional specifications and coordinating with technical teams for developments and enhancements.
Exposure to Fiori applications and SAP S/4HANA innovations in Plant Maintenance.
Ability to independently interact with business stakeholders and translate business requirements into SAP solutions.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in client-facing consulting environments and global delivery models.
SAP PM or SAP S/4HANA Asset Management certification will be an added advantage.
Prior experience in Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical, Automotive, Utilities, Chemicals, EPC, or Oil & Gas industries preferred.
Ability to work from Mumbai, Pune, or Bangalore and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Candidates with implementation plus support/rollout experience will be highly preferred.
Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice periods are preferred.

Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecyclefrom concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore & Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.

Your Role
Roles & Responsibilities
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices & methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking

Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Role Description
About DWS
DWS, publicly listed asset management division of Deutsche Bank, is one of the world's leading investment management organizations with assets under management. DWS provides flexible products and solutions to a wide range of investment opportunities across all asset classes from pooled funds to highly customized portfolios for a wide range of investors and offers individuals and institutions traditional and alternative investments across all major asset classes.
About the team
The Platform Sustainability function is a cross-divisional function, linked to both the investment and product divisions of DWS Group. It coordinates and steers the business implementation of DWSs Sustainability Strategy as well as the sustainability related regulatory requirements in the product and investment areas. Its focus is on the liquid product range of DWS Group and the product-related sustainability activities for alternative investments. Its activities comprise the development of sustainability-related frameworks as well as their integration into engagement processes, ESG integration processes and product-specific investment policies.
The Product Infrastructure & Standards team is part of Platform Sustainability within the Product Division.
The team is responsible for developing the sustainability-related product infrastructure including data management and contributing to product disclosure processes.
In this responsibility, the team plays a key role in designing efficient processes for a technology-driven future. In addition, the team actively contributes to navigating regulatory developments that are shaping the industry. To achieve this, it works closely together with colleagues across the Product Division and other relevant sustainability experts at DWS globally.
Your key responsibilities
As a Product Sustainability Analyst of the Product Sustainabilitys Infrastructure & Standards Team, you will be jointly responsible for
Analysing and conceptualizing the sustainability-related data and process flow from product development to the monitoring of investment guidelines compliance
Coordinating and overseeing the implementation of systematic changes in close collaboration with business and infrastructure teams
Developing a workflow tool for product launches
Automating existing processes related to fund disclosures
Supporting development of sustainability-related product infrastructure with exposure to sustainability specialists and close
collaboration with sustainability investment experts

Role & responsibilities

Act as a proactive business partner with a strong operational mindset.
Build and maintain effective relationships with Capgemini entities delivering contracts (Account Executives, Service Delivery Managers).
Report and analyze key financial KPIs such as WIP/BIA, revenue, and costs.
Analyze budget versus forecast variances across the project portfolio.
Perform monthly closing activities, including result analysis and presentations to Service Delivery Managers, Engagement Managers, Market Unit leadership, and Finance Management.

Explain variances between actuals and forecasts with clear analysis.
Interface with onshore and offshore delivery controlling teams to review and challenge cost containment measures and productivity cost commitments.
Update and maintain financial and reporting tools accurately and timely.
Monitor and control WIP/BIA positions and ensure timely client billing.
Ensure compliance with applicable financial standards and policies.
Support business partners in coordinating with Sales and Analyst teams for new client proposals, ensuring process adherence.
Ensure compliance with internal and external audit requirements.


Preferred candidate profile

Strong understanding of project controlling and its impact on financial statements.
Handson experience with SAP S/4 HANA (minimum 2 years).
Strong proficiency in MS Excel (advanced level including macros, data modeling, and queries), MS Access, and Power BI.
Secondary Skills
Proactive and customeroriented mindset.
Excellent communication skills.
High attention to detail.
Strong analytical and problemsolving abilities.
Ability to work under tight deadlines and stretch targets.
Positive, proactive (cando”) attitude with eagerness to learn.

Description:
Territory Sales Manager (TSM)
About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited
NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and
accounting management system. From our start in late 2018, NoBrokerHood is currently securing 20,000+ societies
under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes
beyond visitor and gate management delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents
and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
We are currently looking to hire an energetic, highly motivated, can-do attitude individual who is willing to join our
team as a Territory Sales Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for acquiring leads and generating revenue
by onboarding new apartment complexes and societies into NoBrokerHood by meeting with prospective clients in
person and explaining the product.
Job Description:-



Minimum 1-5 years of proven sales track record and ability to meet targets.
Lead generation through prospecting referral and web researches
Should have an interest in Business Development (B2C/ B2B) for Software Application Products
/solutions.

Meet prospective clients, execute effective product demonstrations, and emphasize product features and
benefits with a focus on the value of the solution.


Capabilities of selling Hardware IOT devices
Meet with Committee Members of Apartments and Societies,accounting services partners and builders to
understand the scope of business and their expectations.




Prospect, educate, qualify, and generate interest for Sales Opportunities and lead conversions.
Ability to do product demonstrations to higher level authorities
Onboarding new apartments on the NoBrokerHood platform will be a major KRA.
Researching potential leads from the open market, web searches, or digital resources.
Mandatory requirements for this position





Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Should be proficient in English and Regional language (knowing the regional language of the job location
will be a plus).






Should be comfortable working on weekends(Sat & Sun compulsory working), with a week off on Monday.
Effective presentation and negotiation skills.
Hands-on MS Office Excel, Word & PPT, etc.
Ability to handle CRM softwares
A valid drivers license(DL) with a two-wheeler/four-wheeler as this role requires you to be on the field.
Geographical knowledge of the job location is an added advantage.
What we have to offer!

Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes


Flexible working hours
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world


Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.
Uncapped variables based on performance
Benefits





Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Travel Allowance
Monthly R&R awards
Early promotions for the outstanding performers

Job Summary
Cisco's Global Lab Solutions (GLS) team is seeking a highly motivated and skilled Lab Systems Operations Engineer to manage cutting-edge liquid cooling rack infrastructure, operate precision thermal/environmental chambers, and maintain network lab sustainability metrics across our Bangalore engineering facilities. As Cisco accelerates its next-generation Silicon One ASICs, AI/ML compute clusters, and high-density routing platforms, you will work at the forefront of hardware lab innovation - ensuring high-density equipment reliability, optimizing lab Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE), reclaiming stranded power capacity, and driving sustainable operations.


Key Responsibilities
Liquid Cooling Infrastructure: Manage, monitor, and maintain in-rack and row-based Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs), secondary fluid loops, manifold distribution systems, and quick-disconnect (QDC) couplings powering high-density AI/ML compute racks.
Fluid Chemistry Maintenance: Perform routine fluid sampling, pH testing, glycol concentration analysis, biocide/corrosion inhibitor monitoring, and particulate filtration servicing.
Thermal Chamber Operations: Oversee the day-to-day operation, test scheduling, and preventative maintenance of environmental test chambers, executing precision thermal stress profiles (-40 C to +85 C).
Instrumentation Calibration: Deploy and calibrate sensors, thermocouples (T/K-type), RTDs, pressure transducers, and thermal imaging cameras to capture component-level thermal gradients.
Sustainability Telemetry Monitoring: Leverage Smart PDUs, LIMIT portal, and Command Center telemetry to monitor real-time rack power draw (kW), optimize lab PUE, and proactively reclaim stranded electrical and cooling capacity.
Leak Detection Safety Systems: Maintain continuous surveillance over liquid leak detection sensor ropes, optical sensors, automated shut-off solenoid valves, and emergency containment protocols.
Collaborative Engagement: Collaborate with BU Engineering Tech Leads, thermal OEMs (nVent, Motivair, CoolIT), and Workplace Resources (WPR Facilities) on facility integration, chilled water feeds, and lab placement.
Documentation Best Practices: Develop and maintain comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), chemical Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 environmental standards.


Who You Are
Academic education in Mechanical Engineering, Biotechnology / Chemical Engineering, Electrical Electronics, Thermal Engineering, Instrumentation, or related disciplines (B.S./B.E./B.Tech or M.S./M.Tech with a minimum average GPA of 3.5 out of 4 or 8.5 out of 10)
Experience up to 3 years in laboratory operations, thermal/environmental testing, fluid dynamics/cooling systems, data center facilities, or precision analytical operations is desired but not essential
Academic knowledge of Thermodynamics, Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics, Closed-Loop Hydraulics, and Thermal Resistance
Working knowledge or familiarity with liquid cooling systems (Direct-to-Chip cold plates, CDUs, manifolds, dielectric/water-glycol fluids)
Familiarity with environmental test chambers, temperature profiling, thermocouple instrumentation, and data logging
Exposure to lab telemetry platforms (Smart PDUs, DCIM, LIMIT portal) or basic scripting (Python, Shell, MATLAB) is a plus.
Good debugging skills, good problem-solving, and analytical skills
Basic understanding of how laboratory equipment and electro-mechanical hardware operate
Positive energy, motivation to learn, and ability to work as part of a team
High level of work autonomy, disciplined safety adherence, and sense of responsibility
Desire for improvement of current skillset in a fast-paced working environment
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Practice and delivery enablement

Experience with tools such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Fabric, AWS Glue or Redshift, dbt, Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with cloud migration and data modernisation programmes, such as moving from legacy warehouses to a lakehouse.
Exposure to Databricks or hyperscaler partner ecosystems and co-sell motions.

Discovery conversations that lead to a clear, client-validated problem statement and solution direction.
Proposals that are technically sound, competitively priced and delivered on time.
A healthy pipeline and a strong win rate on qualified Data, Analytics and AI deals.
Reusable architectures and accelerators that shorten future pursuits.
Smooth handover to delivery and repeat business from the clients you won.

Description:
Job Summary
The Engagement Manager is accountable for Fractals analytics and AI delivery on a Healthcare account, and owns outcomes from the first problem statement to the eventual retirement of each solution. The role combines client leadership, delivery management and technical judgement: you will be the primary contact for offshore delivery teams across multiple locations, the partner to the onshore farming team, a trusted advisor to Senior Directors and VPs of Client, and the person who makes sure every solution is built to last, run and, when the time comes, be replaced. The role also carries an implied farming mandate: growing Fractals business within the managed portfolio, in conjunction with the onsite ideation team.
Success is measured by client NPS, the innovative solutions created, impact on the KPIs most critical to Client and revenue growth from the account, as well as by how well the value of each solution holds up after go-live. Expect also to be judged on measurable business outcomes such as forecast accuracy, service levels and cycle time, and on execution consistency, stakeholder confidence and year-on-year gains in delivery productivity.


Experience
10+ years.


Location
Bengaluru preferred; Chennai and Pune and Mumbai also considered, in that order.


Team
50+ professionals across multiple locations.


Reports to
Principal Consultant.


Roles and Responsibilities
Lead the Consulting delivery
Lead and manage high-impact consulting projects for Clients in the health systems space, from problem framing through to measurable business outcomes.
Lead delivery across a broad range of analytics and AI use cases that span the end-to-end enterprise lifecycle (innovation to market, market to order, order to cash) and supporting functions such as finance, supply chain, services and sales enablement.
Act as the primary contact for the offshore delivery teams, distributed across multiple locations: align with the client on the delivery plan, give regular status updates and keep the client, the onshore ideation team and the offshore teams working as one. Run an operating model that works across locations and time zones.
Partner closely with the onshore farming on converting new pursuits and road mapping existing engagements.
Oversee project extensions, ensuring accurate and comprehensive estimates for the work outlined.
Own engagement PL, commercial performance and Statements of Work, keeping delivery financially sustainable. Contribute to account-level business planning (including client annual operating plans), forecasting, budgeting and measurement of results.
Assess delivery capabilities to anticipate and mitigate risks, and give the client and Fractal leadership clear insight for effective risk management.
Lead multidisciplinary teams of 50+ professionals, including analytics consultants, BI developers, data engineers, data scientists, full-stack developers and GenAI engineers across multiple work streams, standardizing delivery practices and execution quality.
Establish governance mechanisms, delivery standards and success metrics, and champion Agile and DevOps practices, to improve predictability and stakeholder confidence and to drive year-on-year productivity gains.
Work with capability teams to keep offshore staffing at the right level across locations and resolve staffing issues that affect client deliverables.
Provide thought leadership and mentorship to the team, promoting a culture of learning and innovation. Build reusable methods, solution templates and consultative storytelling skills across the team.
Build forward-looking plans for staffing and upskilling in line with market and client demand, and partner with internal stakeholders to put those plans into action.


Shape and deliver Data AI Solutions, across their full lifecycle
Ideate: Work with Client stakeholders within the managed portfolio to identify and prioritize the business problems most worth solving with analytics and AI. Develop strategic frameworks that tie each one to business growth or operational efficiency. Take part in the sales process to scope client needs and frame the solution and delivery approach. Run proofs of concept and proofs of value to establish worth before scaling.
Design: Work with cross-functional teams to design end-to-end solutions that anticipate future needs, scale, and meet health-data privacy, security and regulatory requirements. Translate business requirements into technical designs that engineering, data science, BI, full-stack and GenAI teams can build from. Settle KPIs and success measures, ownership, adoption, data and model lifecycle, and run cost before build starts.
Build: Create and execute analytics-driven solutions. Apply technical fluency across BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack and GenAI to manage execution and keep technical decisions aligned with the design. Lead by example in analytics delivery, guiding the team from data synthesis and modeling to actionable insights, implications and recommendations.
Operate: Own the handover into operations: monitoring, model and data refresh, support model, and tracking of the value delivered, so solutions keep performing after launch. Validate impact through test-and-control or incrementality measurement, and transition solutions to client teams for sustained use.
Sunset: Define up front when and how a solution will be retired or replaced, and manage the transition, including decommissioning, data retention and handover to successor solutions.


Client relationships establishment, sustenance and strengthening
Manage client relationships to ensure satisfaction and build long-term partnerships.
Advise Senior Directors and VPs across business and technology functions, and occasionally C-suite leaders, with data-driven business relevant insights.
Act as a trusted advisor inside the client organization and grow Fractals footprint within the managed portfolio by engaging stakeholders, identifying likely business problems, building points of view (POVs) and converting them into actionable roadmaps for execution. Shape each proposition end to end, from solution architecture and commercial development to delivery roadmap and go to-market.
Engage with client to institutionalize analytics across the organization, so that solutions are adopted and reused beyond their first use case. Convert proven value into broader, multi-year mandates within the managed portfolio.


Technical Skills
Expertise in building, delivering and operationalizing analytics solutions end to end, from problem definition to production.
Working knowledge of the full scope of work (BI, data engineering, data science, full-stack development and GenAI applications), including cloud data platforms and pipelines, modeling and machine learning, DataOps and MLOps, enough to challenge estimates, spot technical risk and keep delivery aligned with the design.
Familiarity with the client\'s native Microsoft technology stack, including Power BI.

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Job Title: Senior Manager - SAP CO (Controlling) - SAP HANA
Location: [Mumbai ,pune,bangalore]
Department: IT / Finance /
Reports to: Director of ERP Solutions / Head of Finance Systems
Position Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Manager for SAP CO (Controlling) with expertise in SAP S/4 HANA. The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of the SAP Controlling module within our SAP S/4 HANA environment. This role requires both technical and functional expertise in SAP CO, along with strong leadership abilities to manage a team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
SAP CO (Controlling) Implementation & Optimization:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP CO modules (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Drive system enhancements and process optimizations in SAP CO in the context of SAP S/4 HANA, aligning them with business requirements.
Work closely with business users and other SAP functional teams (e.g., FI, MM, SD) to ensure seamless integration and data consistency across modules.

Project Management:
Manage end-to-end SAP CO module projects including planning, requirements gathering, design, testing, and go-live support.
Oversee SAP CO HANA transformation and migration projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and in budget.
Manage and mentor a team of functional consultants and business analysts.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:
Lead and develop a high-performing team of SAP CO professionals.
Provide guidance on troubleshooting, performance tuning, and solution optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system functionality.

System Maintenance & Support:
Ensure the continued smooth operation of the SAP CO module by providing technical support and troubleshooting.
Oversee regular system upgrades, patches, and performance tuning for SAP HANA.
Monitor and ensure data integrity and consistency across financial and controlling modules.

Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance SAP CO processes and tools for greater efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on the latest SAP innovations, particularly SAP S/4 HANA and best practices in CO and finance modules.

Qualifications:
Experience:
8-12 years of hands-on experience with SAP CO, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or senior management role.
Extensive experience with SAP S/4 HANA implementation, migration, or optimization in a Controlling context.
Proven track record in managing SAP CO projects, end-to-end implementations, or system enhancements.

Skills:
Strong expertise in SAP CO configuration (Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Experience with SAP FICO integration (FI, MM, SD, etc.).
In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4 HANA features and capabilities related to CO.
Strong project management skills with a solid understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., SAP certifications, PMP) are a plus.

Additional Skills/Desirable:
Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.
Ability to work effectively with business users and senior leadership.
Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics Cloud, or other reporting tools is a plus.

Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
About us and our teams
Please visit our company website for further information:
https://www.db.com/company/company.html

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

The opportunity:

Were looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles

Your key responsibilities:

Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement teams expectations
Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

Skills and attributes for success:

Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
Experience in either:

a) Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters.

b) MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service
Environment.

c) Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.

What we look for:

A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

What we Offer:

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY:

EY | Building a better working world:

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners.
