Job Description
We are seeking a strategic and professional Senior Executive - HRBP to join our organization in Noida, India. In this pivotal role, you will serve as a trusted business partner to senior leadership and cross-functional teams, driving organizational effectiveness through strategic HR initiatives, employee engagement, and organizational development. You will be responsible for aligning HR strategies with business objectives while ensuring compliance with Indian labor laws and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and employee growth.
Partner with business leaders and department heads to understand organizational needs and develop customized HR strategies that support business goals and drive organizational performance
Manage employee relations matters, including conflict resolution, performance management guidance, and disciplinary actions, while maintaining confidentiality and ensuring fair and consistent application of policies
Lead talent management initiatives including succession planning, high-potential identification, and career development programs to build organizational capability and retain top talent
Design and implement organizational development programs, change management initiatives, and training interventions to enhance employee capabilities and organizational effectiveness
Analyze HR metrics, workforce data, and trends to provide actionable insights and recommendations for improving organizational efficiency and employee engagement
Ensure full compliance with Indian employment laws, labor regulations, and company policies; stay current with regulatory changes and advise leadership on compliance requirements
Collaborate with the recruitment team to develop talent acquisition strategies, define competency frameworks, and support the hiring of key positions
Facilitate communication between HR and business units to ensure consistent messaging, policy implementation, and alignment on people-related initiatives
Contribute to the development and refinement of HR policies, compensation structures, and benefits programs that attract and retain talent
Support employee onboarding, engagement initiatives, and cultural development programs to create a positive and inclusive workplace environment Qualifications
8+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, with a minimum of 5 years in a strategic HRBP or similar business partnership role
Proven expertise in employee relations, talent management, organizational development, and change management
Strong knowledge of Indian employment laws, labor regulations, and compliance requirements
Experience with HR information systems (HRIS), HR analytics tools, and data-driven decision making
Demonstrated ability to analyze HR metrics, workforce trends, and provide strategic recommendations
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to build credibility and influence across all organizational levels
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate complex HR concepts to diverse audiences
Experience in performance management systems, compensation and benefits administration, and recruitment processes
Proficiency in customizing HR solutions to meet organizational needs while maintaining policy consistency
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and work effectively in matrix organizational structures
Preferred experience in multi-site or large organization environments with diverse workforce populations
Preferred experience with HR systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, or similar platforms

Summary
We are currently seeking dedicated and detail-oriented individuals to serve as Off-Role Quality & Process Control Representatives (OPC) for a leading paints manufacturing firm across various locations throughout India. Oversee the quality of raw and packaging materials at vendor sites to ensure they meet established standards.

Demonstrate practical knowledge of quality testing methods, sampling techniques, and documentation processes.
Exhibit strong observational, reporting, and analytical capabilities.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Resource Management Associate
As a Resource Management Associate, you will be part of an industry leading, high performing team of workforce management professionals providing exceptional client service to our stakeholders and helping our employees gain differential experiences that are aligned to their career aspirations.
We provide learning and growth opportunities to build your ability to analyze, innovate, think and act globally. You ll be part of an organization that is focused on optimization, is solution oriented, innovates and provides best in class services to the client serving teams.
The opportunity
EY Global Delivery Services (EY GDS) is a dynamic and global service delivery network of over 50,000 professionals working across borders, to provide innovative and strategic business solutions to EY member firms and EY clients globally. Experience Management plays a vital role in the firm s Next Wave strategy and it s purpose of building a better working world.
We offer a great place to work for every person joining EY. At GDS, you will have the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a truly global environment. You will learn and gain experiences from industry leading WFM professionals and a path breaking leadership team.
We invest in your learning and development. We ll help you develop the technical and soft skills you need. We support your professional development with a combination of learning, networking, experiences, and coaching. As part of a 300+ member team, supporting 4 unique Service Lines, you will always have opportunities to showcase your skills and contribute to the firm s strategic initiatives.
Your key responsibilities
As an Resource Management Associate, you will be responsible for managing staffing demands, monitor the demand intake channels, review demand projections, schedule individuals on projects, optimize employee utilization and bench management.
Some of your key responsibilities include:
Calculate staff requirements based on demand projections.
Create staff schedules to maximize service and minimize cost.
Timely update of resource schedules on the schedule management tool (Retain).
Timely review and resolution of scheduling conflicts.
Proactive review of resource availability/future project demands.
Minimize open, unfulfilled demand.
Mailbox management.
Optimization of resource utilization through effective resource deployment.
Basic reporting and analysis.
Skills and attributes for success
Graduates with 0-1 year of relevant workforce management experience. Non-resource management professionals with 1 year of general work experience in any field of work, that display required skillset competencies can also be hired as Associate in resource management team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel.
Excellent teaming and interpersonal skills.
Positive attitude and ability to excel under tight timelines.
Ideally, you ll also have
Experience on workforce management concepts, resource deployment and scheduling.
What we look for
We are looking for go-getters with a solution oriented and analytical mindset. Someone who is passionate about numbers and has the willingness to learn. The successful candidate will be one who combines computer skills and mathematical ability with a working knowledge of the business and the negotiation skills of a salesman.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.
Understanding of common AI orchestration and development frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of AI production monitoring including model/application performance, latency, token consumption, cost, prompt and response tracing, model failures, retrieval quality, and system availability.
Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, planning and reasoning workflows, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, containerization, Kubernetes, and automated deployment practices.
Understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata management, data governance, and data security concepts.
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, model risk management, data privacy, prompt security, content moderation, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Knowledge of emerging AI interoperability patterns and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is desirable. Any experience with UCP is also a plus.
Familiarity with observability platforms and technologies such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent tools.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, engineering teams, security teams, and senior management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
Ability to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to cross-functional engineering teams without necessarily being responsible for direct people management.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business problems, challenge assumptions, identify technical risks, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
Ability to work across multiple projects and technology domains while maintaining consistency with enterprise architecture principles and standards.

Additional Information
Relevant cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified:Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent certifications.
AI/ML or Generative AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, Databricks, NVIDIA, or other recognized technology providers are advantageous.
Experience working in large enterprise environments, consulting organizations, or complex multi-cloud transformation programs.
Experience defining or contributing to organizational AI architecture standards, Generative AI platforms, AI Centers of Excellence, or enterprise AI governance frameworks would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate should possess a Engineering Graduate with minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience; out of which a minimum of 3+ years’ experience in Telecommunication domain in Metro Railway project or similar transportation system environment. Page1 | 3 • Passenger Information System (PIS) o Configure audio and visual passenger information systems. o Integrate train arrival/departure information. o Ensure real-time announcements and display functionality. • Public Address System (PAS) o Design and configure station and depot PA systems. o Ensure emergency and routine announcements are delivered effectively. o Test audio clarity and coverage. • Master Clock System o Implement synchronized master and slave clock systems. o Ensure synchronization across all stations and operational areas. • Access Control & Intrusion Detection o Implement access control systems. o Configure card readers, biometric devices, and monitoring systems. o Ensure integration with security management systems. • Installation & Site Supervision o Supervise telecom equipment installation at stations, depots, tunnels, and OCC. o Monitor cable tray installation and cable pulling activities. o Ensure installation quality according to approved drawings and method statements. o Verify contractor compliance with safety requirements. • Testing & Commissioning o Prepare Inspection and Test Plans (ITP). o Conduct Site Acceptance Test (SAT). o Perform integrated system testing. o Support Trial Running and revenue operation readiness activities. 6. As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.


The opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.

Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.

Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.

Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.


Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.


To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.


Ideally, you'll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.


What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Discipline
Client Industries

Role Type
Industry Group Enabler
The opportunity - About the GDS Strategy Execution and Operations team role
The GDS Global Industry Group Enablement team plays a pivotal role in supporting onshore industry group leaders and sector operations leadership across all industry groups, sectors, and geographies. The team is responsible for translating strategic priorities set by the Market Board into actionable initiatives. We help operationalize these strategies and drive execution to enhance performance and support the achievement of defined goals and targets.
By working closely with leadership, each MSE ensures alignment, consistency, and impact across global markets, making it a key enabler of success for the broader organization.
As a Industry Group Enabler (Rank 65) you will be expected provide an operational foundation for Industry Group strategic initiatives execution. This role is designed for individuals with strong analytical skills, commercial curiosity, and a disciplined approach to execution.
You will be responsible for ensuring pipeline hygiene, maintaining accurate CRM data, and delivering baseline reporting that supports leadership decision-making. The role also offers exposure to strategic priorities through insight brief preparation, and go-to-market support - positioning you for growth within the team.
Your key responsibilities
Reporting Dashboarding
Deliver daily, weekly, and periodic performance reports on key KPIs.
Develop and maintain standard dashboards and templates using Power BI, Excel, newsletters, and other reporting tools.
Support pipeline reporting and hygiene management, including forecast tracking, account movement updates, and unassigned account reporting.
Prepare baseline reports and first-level analysis on pipeline, revenue, and pursuits to support performance reporting.
Research Insights
Conduct targeted analysis and secondary research on key performance metrics, strategic accounts, industries, and stakeholders.
Generate insights for stakeholders on revenue, margin, pipeline, and NBD performance.
Perform research on clients, executives, and events, and track executive movements to support strategic planning.
Act as a reliable support resource for translating data into insights that inform strategic execution.
Content Coordination
Share sector newsletters and summarize thought leadership content for internal distribution.
Update meeting materials and participate in meetings to capture call notes and action items.
Manage document uploads to SharePoint, Teams channels, and shared drives.
Coordinate with internal teams and represent the market board within GDS for cross-functional collaboration.
Track progress on projects and initiatives, ensuring timely execution and follow-up.
Ad-hoc Executive Support
Respond to requests from the Sector Operations Leader and other market board leaders.
Provide scaled support for core accounts and business development initiatives.
Offer foundational support for leadership meetings, reporting cycles, and communication materials.
Automation Data Hygiene
Develop automated reporting solutions to streamline recurring tasks and improve efficiency.
Maintain data accuracy across internal tools such as ARD and Mercury, ensuring CRM hygiene and integrity.
Support revenue reconciliation and data clean-up to ensure reporting reliability.
Sector Knowledge Commercial Awareness
Build sector knowledge and commercial awareness to strengthen contributions to leadership discussions.
Skills and attributes for success
Proven ability to be a team player with exposure to working with multi-cultural teams and collaborating virtually
Business acumen and commerciality
Builds internal relationships - identifies opportunities and encourages/ influences internal teams to understand and achieve account goals
Exhibits drive and determination - able to overcome internal and external barriers and get results from people
Is above average [to market] in fundamental competencies like Data analysis, Business Research, Writing Presentation, MS Tools, Communication Diction, etc.
Proactively to learn and adapt to advancements in technology relevant to the role.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A Master s degree or bachelors degree with relevant experience
3+ years of relevant work experience
Experience in a large Global organization preferred
Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
Ideally, you ll also have
Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc.
Credible experience working in a fast-moving, client-driven environment
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
A professional with strong interpersonal skills - confidence, maturity ability to build strong client relationships
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success, as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Summary
The Regional Contracts & Supplier Governance Assistant Manager serves as a key enabler of effective contract management, supplier governance, and procurement compliance across the UK&I business. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle, supporting supplier onboarding and governance activities, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
Acting as a central point of coordination between business stakeholders, Procurement, Risk, Finance, and suppliers, the Assistant Manager drives operational excellence through robust governance, process optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that third-party engagements are managed efficiently, risks are mitigated, and supplier relationships deliver sustainable value and strategic business outcomes.
Your key responsibilities
Manage contract and supplier governance mailboxes, providing guidance and coordinating contract requests through to execution.
Draft, review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts while ensuring compliance with procurement and governance requirements.
Oversee contract execution processes, including approvals, DocuSign workflows, and maintenance of executed agreements.
Maintain contract repositories, lifecycle trackers, renewals, and audit-ready documentation.
Support supplier onboarding, vendor enablement, and supplier due diligence activities.
Manage supplier governance programs, MSA renewals, performance reviews, and compliance obligations.
Ensure adherence to risk, compliance, and third-party governance frameworks, escalating issues where required.
Support procurement and sourcing activities, including supplier evaluations and governance approvals.
Prepare management reports, dashboards, and analytics on contracts, suppliers, compliance, and performance metrics.
Coordinate audit reviews, remediation activities, invoice governance, and payment-related issue resolution.
Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, stakeholder training, and continuous enhancement of contract management practices.
Ariba supply chain management life cycle

Demonstrates expertise in leveraging advanced analytics platforms and visualization tools (such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar) to transform raw data into actionable insights.

Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders

Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Description:
Job Summary
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
Your key responsibilities
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:
Workflow execution metrics
OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
Drift detection signals
ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation
Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:
Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
Virtualization platforms Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
Kubernetes cluster concepts pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
Network fundamentals VLANs, DNS, IP management
Storage and compute provisioning concepts
Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:
Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
PowerShell
Bash
Strong written and verbal communication skills able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.
To qualify for the role, you must have experience with
Power BI report and dashboard development 57 years.
Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations 57 years.
ELK stack data analysis Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development 35 years.
SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores 57 years.
KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
Workflow orchestration data analysis Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation 35 years.
PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).
Ideally, you'll also have
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Platform Operations Manager to lead a team responsible for the reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective operation of enterprise machine learning and generative AI platforms. The role combines people leadership, service delivery management, stakeholder engagement, and strong technical oversight across MLOps, LLMOps, model deployment and monitoring, APIs and endpoints, model pipelines, prompt and model configuration, observability, and incident resolution. The Manager will be accountable for meeting agreed SLAs and KPIs, managing operational risk and critical escalations, developing team capability, and driving continuous improvement across production AI services.
Your key responsibilities
Lead, coach, and develop a team of AI/ML Platform Operations Engineers, establishing clear responsibilities, objectives, support coverage, competency plans, and performance expectations.
Own end-to-end service delivery for machine learning and generative AI platforms, ensuring incidents, requests, problems, changes, releases, access activities, and model lifecycle events are managed within agreed SLAs and controls.
Define, monitor, and report KPIs including platform and endpoint availability, inference success rate, response latency, error rate, mean time to detect, mean time to recover, incident recurrence, change success rate, model and prompt deployment success, token usage, cost efficiency, model quality, drift, safety events, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Review operational dashboards, model and service telemetry, support backlogs, demand trends, and risk indicators, and drive recovery plans, corrective actions, automation, and measurable service improvements.
Act as the senior escalation point for critical issues involving model deployments, LLM services, APIs and endpoints, model pipelines, prompt and model configuration, observability, security controls, quotas, latency, scaling, and cloud dependencies.
Provide technical governance for MLOps and LLMOps practices covering experiment tracking, model registration, validation, approval, promotion, deployment, rollback, retirement, prompt versioning, evaluation, and operational monitoring.
Lead major incidents, including business-impact assessment, technical coordination, executive communication, service restoration, root cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking.
Drive problem management for recurring endpoint failures, performance degradation, model-quality regression, drift, unsafe responses, pipeline instability, quota constraints, and cost anomalies.
Oversee production API and endpoint operations covering authentication, authorization, throttling, quotas, retries, timeouts, autoscaling, load management, high availability, private networking, and secrets management.
Ensure effective observability across logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, service-level indicators, model quality, groundedness, safety, hallucination risk, user feedback, token consumption, and cost.
Govern prompt templates, system instructions, model parameters, routing rules, guardrails, content filters, retrieval configuration, tool connections, and environment-specific configuration through approved change controls.
Manage team capacity, shifts and on-call coverage, work allocation, cross-training, succession planning, demand forecasting, and operational readiness for new AI use cases.
Establish and enforce runbooks, SOPs, monitoring and evaluation standards, known-error records, architecture and dependency documentation, escalation paths, and knowledge-management practices.
Provide technical oversight for Python-based automation, API integrations, operational tooling, evaluation workflows, health checks, and incident diagnostics.

The opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Data Platform Engineering Support Manager to lead a team responsible for the reliable, secure, and cost-effective operation of enterprise Databricks and data engineering services. The role combines people leadership, service delivery management, stakeholder engagement, and strong technical oversight across Databricks jobs, notebooks, clusters, pipelines, Python and PySpark workloads, ETL and ELT processing, SQL and data issues, performance optimization, and platform administration. The Manager will be accountable for meeting agreed SLAs and KPIs, managing critical incidents and operational risks, developing team capability, and driving continuous improvement across the data platform support service.
Your key responsibilities
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Platform Engineering Support Engineers, establishing clear responsibilities, objectives, support coverage, competency plans, and performance expectations.
Own end-to-end service delivery for Databricks platform and engineering support, ensuring incidents, requests, problems, changes, releases, and access activities are managed within agreed SLAs and controls.
Define, monitor, and report operational KPIs such as platform availability, job and pipeline success rate, SLA attainment, response and resolution time, backlog ageing, first-time resolution, recurrence rate, change success rate, mean time to recovery, compute utilization, cost efficiency, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Act as the senior escalation point for critical Databricks issues involving jobs, notebooks, Workflows, Lakeflow or Delta Live Tables pipelines, clusters, SQL warehouses, Unity Catalog, permissions, libraries, runtimes, and integrations.
Provide technical oversight for Python, PySpark, Spark, ETL and ELT troubleshooting, data reconciliation, SQL defects, schema changes, data-quality issues, and performance bottlenecks.
Lead major incidents, including business-impact assessment, technical coordination, stakeholder communication, service restoration, root cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking.
Drive problem management for recurring job failures, platform instability, performance degradation, data issues, and operational gaps, ensuring permanent fixes and preventive monitoring.
Oversee Databricks platform administration, including workspace configuration, identity and access, service principals, cluster policies, compute governance, runtimes, libraries, secrets, tokens, Unity Catalog, and secure data access.
Ensure controlled deployment and promotion of notebooks, code, jobs, pipelines, configurations, and platform changes using Git, CI/CD, testing evidence, approvals, rollback plans, and post-implementation validation.
Manage team capacity, shifts and on-call coverage, work allocation, cross-training, succession planning, demand forecasting, and support readiness for project transitions.
Establish and enforce runbooks, SOPs, monitoring standards, reconciliation controls, known-error records, knowledge management, and operational quality reviews.
Partner with data engineering, cloud platform, DevOps, security, database, architecture, FinOps, application, and business teams to resolve issues and improve reliability and cost efficiency.
Manage vendor and product-support engagement, ensuring complete diagnostic evidence, timely follow-up, and effective resolution of Databricks or cloud-platform defects.
Provide regular service reviews and leadership updates covering SLA and KPI performance, risks, major incidents, capacity, cost, technical debt, improvement actions, and planned releases.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong people-management and service-delivery leadership, with experience managing technical support or data engineering teams in business-critical environments.
Deep operational understanding of Databricks jobs, notebooks, Workflows, pipelines, clusters, SQL warehouses, Spark UI, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and production support.
Strong technical knowledge of Python, PySpark, Spark architecture, ETL and ELT patterns, data-quality controls, SQL troubleshooting, and workload performance optimization.
Demonstrated ability to translate SLAs and business expectations into measurable KPIs, operational dashboards, team goals, and structured improvement plans.
Experience leading major incidents, escalations, root cause analysis, problem management, change governance, release management, and senior stakeholder communication.
Strong knowledge of Databricks platform administration, identity and access, cluster policies, compute governance, runtime and library management, secrets, service principals, and Unity Catalog.
Good SQL skills and working knowledge of Oracle and SQL Server for validation, reconciliation, access investigation, query analysis, and issue diagnosis.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
FINTECH - OneStream - Senior Consultant
The opportunity
We re looking for Senior Consultants with expertise in OneStream to join our Technology Consulting practice where we provide a one-stop solution for end-to-end project implementation enabled by expertise in financial transformation using EPM or Fintech products.
Your key responsibilities
Support client needs by delivering OneStream consolidation or Planning modules.
Support client needs by delivering integrating OneStream with multiple source systems.
Merge, Customize and Deploy OneStream as per client business requirements
Experience working with clients throughout various parts of implementation lifecycle
Proactive with Solution oriented mindset, ready to learn new technologies for Client requirements.
Skills and attributes for success
Deliver large/medium OneStream programmes, demonstrate expert core consulting skills.
Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of presales and practice development. for example, presales, internal engagement and / or knowledge management
Demonstrate man management and an ability to conduct and lead consultancy assignments
Should be open to adopt new technologies.
To qualify for the role, you must have
4-7 years of relevant experience in implementation planning and Consolidation modules. Should have 1-3 years in OneStream products.
Develop and maintain solid knowledge on consolidations in OneStream
Should have worked in designing the workflow and metadata design in OneStream
Independently provide system solutions to OneStream issues and enhancements; act as an escalation point to FAST support/Operation team for complex issues
Lead the team in effective handling of Financial Planning / Consolidation month-end close
Act as a techno-functional OneStream solution architect.
Perform functional and technical testing of system projects; bug fixes and enhancements
Should have written OneStream codes/Rules
Participate in prioritizing system issues for development team; Participate in regular calls with development team to keep track of progress
Independently identify areas of improvement and makes recommendations
Ideally, you ll also have
Strong understanding of data close process. Proficient in building and extending metadata functionalities
Maintaining end-to-end accountability and expectations for customer satisfaction and overall delivery excellence
Prioritize deliveries in conjunction with implementation team
Adopt a proactive, logical and organized approach to problem resolution
What we look for
The incumbent should be able to drive OneStream technical and functional assignment.
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 10000 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What working at EY offers
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Summary
We are looking for an SAP Basis Senior Consultant to join the EY GDS - SAP TechOps Team. As part of our EY GDS - SAP TechOps team, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, performance, and availability of the SAP systems across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize system performance to meet business requirements.
Responsibilities
Extensive experience with SAP system installation, configuration and upgrade procedures, including experience with SAP Basis tools and utilities.
Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner in a multi-region environment.
Experience working in a global setting with multi-regional teams, understanding cultural nuances and time zone differences.
Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
What you will do
Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist
Provide senior level support for SAP Basis Activities including system administration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting across SAP landscapes.
Perform System Monitoring, Capacity Planning and Tuning to optimize system performance and ensure high availability and scalability.
Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP infrastructure/Basis solutions.
Develop and maintain technical documentation including system configuration, installation procedures and guidelines.
Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
At least 3 to 5 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
Minimum of 2 years working experience in SAP Basis administration with focus on Level 3 support and Global operations
Skills
Broad knowledge of SAP ERP IT systems, processes and integration with legacy systems.
Good understanding on Roles and Authorization - SAP Security.
Experience with different Cloud platforms (i.e., Azure, AWS, GCP).
Experience in SAP Rise and/or SAP Cloud Solutions
Database (Sybase/SAP - ASE, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL, S4HANA)
Knowledge on SAP Fiori, SAP BusinessObjects, and other SAP technologies and applications
Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools for SAP such as SAP Cloud ALM and SAP Solution Manager
SAP Certification in SAP Basis Administration or SAP HANA Administration

Job Summary
Position Title: ITSM Process Specialist -Senior


Your Key Responsibilities
Process Governance: Ensure Compliance with incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management processes.
SLA Management: Monitor SLA performance, identify imminent breaches and drive corrective actions to closure.
Ticket Hygiene: Ensure accurate categorization, prioritization, documentation, updates and timely ticket closure.
Stakeholder Management: Coordinate with Service managers, delivery teams and customer leadership on process gaps and improvement plans.
Customer Collaboration: Engage proactively with customer stakeholders to review process effectiveness, gather feedback and jointly identify improvement opportunities.
Process Transformation: Challenge existing practices, eliminate inefficiencies and redesign workflows to improve operational effectiveness and SLA performance.
Joint Governance: Conduct periodic process reviews with the customer, agree on improvement actions and track implementation through measurable outcomes.
Best Practice Adoption: Recommend and implement industry best practices, standardisation and automation opportunities in alignment with customer requirements.
Reporting Analysis: Publish daily operational reports, weekly KPI dashboards and Monthly business review (MBR) metrics.
Continuous Improvement: Identify automation opportunities, reduce recurring incidents, improve MTTR and eliminate repetitive tickets.
Audit Compliance: Ensure process adherence, maintain evidence and address audit findings
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong knowledge of ITIL processes, including incident, Problem, Change, request and Knowledge Management
Expertise in ITSM tools, with proficiency in developing dashboards and reports to track SLAs, KPIs, ticket trends and operational performance
Experience in process standardisation, SOP development and ITSM governance across application teams
Proficiency in SLA monitoring, breach prevention performance improvement
Expertise in operational reporting, KPI dashboards and monthly business reviews
Ability to collaborate with customers to identify process gaps and implement improvements
Strong analytical skills to identify recurring incidents, root causes and automation opportunities
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and end-to-end ownership of continuous improvement initiatives


To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
8-10 years of experience in ITSM process governance, service management and process improvement
ITIL4 Foundation Certification; Advance ITIL certifications are an advantage
Proficiency in Excel, Power BI or equivalent reporting and analytics tools.
Hands-on experience with ITSM tools, including ServiceNow for process management and workflow configuration
Proven ability to standardize ITSM processes, develop SOPs and drive process compliance across teams.
Experience in SLA management, operational reporting, KPI dashboards and performance analysis
Strong customer engagement skills to identify process gaps and implement continuous improvement initiatives
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.


Ideally, you ll also have

Technologies and Tools
ITSM Platforms: ServiceNow , Jira Service Management
Knowledge management :Confluence, Sharepoint
Reporting Dashboards: ServiceNow, Performance Analytics, Power BI Advanced Microsoft excel

Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Program / Project Manager at Manager level with proven, hands-on experience leading end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation projects across ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, or related workstreams. The ideal candidate will be well versed in Oracle Unified Method (OUM), Application Implementation Methodology (AIM), Testing and Change Management (TCM), Agile and hybrid delivery models, and the complete project lifecycle. The role requires strong ownership of program governance, integrated planning, financial and resource management, RAID and dependency management, executive status reporting, and client discussions from mobilization through go-live and Hypercare.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation programs from mobilisation, discovery, design, configuration, build, testing, deployment, go-live, Hypercare, and transition to support.
Create and manage integrated program plans covering scope, milestones, workstreams, critical paths, dependencies, resources, budgets, environments, deliverables, and release schedules.
Apply and tailor OUM, AIM, TCM, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches based on project complexity, contractual commitments, and client governance requirements.
Establish program governance, decision rights, escalation paths, stage gates, quality controls, meeting cadence, and reporting standards across functional and technical workstreams.
Own RAID management by identifying, assessing, assigning, tracking, mitigating, escalating, and closing risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies with clear owners and due dates.
Prepare and present weekly and monthly status reports, executive dashboards, steering committee packs, milestone health, effort and budget variance, resource outlook, decision logs, and recovery plans.
Lead client workshops, governance meetings, scope and design discussions, status reviews, risk escalations, steering committees, and executive communications, driving timely decisions and stakeholder alignment.
Manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, change requests, contracts, and deliverable acceptance while protecting project outcomes and commercial commitments.
Coordinate solution design, configuration, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, testing, change management, training, cutover, and business readiness across all workstreams.
Drive fit-to-standard adoption, design governance, traceability, deliverable quality, defect closure, cutover rehearsals, go-live criteria, and production stabilisation.
Prepare, baseline, maintain, and control Microsoft Project Plan (MPP) schedules, including work breakdown structures, task dependencies, milestones, critical paths, resource assignments, progress updates, schedule variance, forecasting, and management reporting.
Manage system integrators, Oracle, third-party vendors, internal teams, and client stakeholders, ensuring accountability for scope, timelines, service levels, and quality.
Job Requirements:
Minimum 10 years of overall experience, including at least 5 years in project or program management and proven hands-on leadership of multiple end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations.
Strong delivery experience across one or more Oracle Fusion domains such as ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, Procurement, Projects, or cross-pillar transformation programs.
Thorough knowledge of OUM, AIM, TCM, Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid project lifecycles.
Demonstrated experience establishing governance, PMO controls, steering committees, stage gates, design authority, change control, delivery cadence, and quality assurance.
Strong command of scope, schedule, budget, effort, forecasting, resource capacity, dependency, critical-path, milestone, and benefits tracking.
Hands-on expertise in RAID logs, issue resolution, risk mitigation, decision logs, assumptions, actions, change requests, recovery plans, and executive escalation management.
Experience managing requirements, design, Conference Room Pilots, configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, defect management, security, training, cutover, go-live, Hypercare, and support transition.
Mandatory real hands-on expertise in Microsoft Project and MPP files, including creating and managing detailed schedules, baselines, dependencies, critical paths, milestones, resources, actuals, remaining work, slippage, variance, and forecasts.
Ability to generate schedule, milestone, resource, cost, and executive status reports directly from MPP and explain schedule health, delays, impacts, and recovery actions to senior stakeholders.
Strong client-facing experience, including leading difficult discussions, negotiating priorities, managing expectations, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving decisions and closure.
Experience managing distributed teams, system integrators, vendors, subcontractors, and business stakeholders across locations and time zones.

Strong leadership, ownership, commercial awareness, and delivery discipline, with the ability to maintain control in complex and high-pressure programs.
Excellent client communication, facilitation, negotiation, conflict resolution, presentation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to translate strategic objectives into executable plans, measurable milestones, clear accountability, and outcome-focused governance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with sound judgement in prioritisation, decisions, risk response, and program recovery.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams while maintaining quality, schedule, budget, compliance, and stakeholder confidence.

Job Title: Sr. Project Manager
Position Summary:
A project manager is responsible for delivering IT projects to schedule, budget and quality. The role requires mastery of the technical knowledge of project management inter-related process stages i.e., initiate, plan, execute, monitoring control and close, and the supporting processes e.g., scope, cost, time, issue, risk, resource, communication, stakeholder management. Proficiency in related processes such as portfolio management, program management, methods and tools and quality assurance are also required. Senior project manager must have excellent stakeholder relationship management skills to successfully lead and manage the project team and project stakeholders, and have expertise recognized and requested by customers.
Essential Functions of the Job:
Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget, and scope
Perform the relevant project management processes - i.e., initiate, plan, execute, monitor and control and close, and the supporting processes e.g., scope, cost, time, issue, risk, resource, communication, stakeholder management
Plan the project based on a defined need - results in detailed scope/budget/schedule baseline
Monitor and control the work to ensure that the project remains on track and in control
Plan for and manage change
Reports on variances to the approved project baseline
Close the project to formalize acceptance of the project result and release project resources
Interface and communicate with project team, management and stakeholders
Manage project work and resources to enable successful and timely completion of the project
Performs gate reviews and quality assurance reviews with all aspects of IT organization and business sponsors
Delivery of projects aligned to overall business and technology strategies and architectures
Work within defined governance processes
Manage external contracts and suppliers where required
Support development of business cases with the customer team including leading on the solutions estimate
Lead the development of the project charter and scope, and ensure delivery of the solution to schedule, budget and scope
Develop objectives, phasing and content of the project to deliver on the business case benefits, budget and timescales
Manage to the objectives and plan by thorough risk, issue and change management across both business and IT parts of the project
Ensures that quality project standards are met as prescribed by IT Services through the effective implementation or use of approved processes, methodologies and deliverables
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:
Monitors and manages project baseline to ensure activities are occurring as planned - scope, budget and schedule - manages variances
Proactively performance monitoring and reporting on project/program scope, time, cost, quality, risks and overall project/program health.
Leading the project/program team, working with global executives, management teams and IT Services Teams to ensure project/program success.
Proactively identify risks and issues on projects - leading team to develop risk management and issues management plans
Identifies potential points of contention for missed deliverables; creates and implements strategy to mitigate shortfalls in timeline and budget
Anticipates problems before they occur; defines the problem or risk; identifies possible causes; works with team to identify solutions; selects and implements most appropriate solution
Develop and manage plans to address project strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats
Ability to balance both the "science" of how to perform project management and the "art" of project management, which is learned through experience and skill training/application
Analytical skills and problem-solving skills needed to manage multiple factors on a project simultaneously
Demonstrate business analytics to manage and meet sponsor and customer needs
Knowledge and Skills Requirements:
Experience of managing IT projects with personal accountability for delivering to time and cost for large, complex projects typically from $100,000 up to $5 M in value and 6 to 18 months in duration
IT Infrastructure Management Knowledge - Networking, Sever Management, End User Computing, Voice VoIP, etc.
Mastery of project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
Track record of customer focus, based on openness, trust, and delivering on promises
Not mandatory but desirable - management skills to manage one or more large, complex projects simultaneously
IT background with experience across the systems development life cycle with experience in all project phases - plan, initiate, elaborate, design, build, test, implement.
Knowledge and use of industry-standard project methods, tools, and techniques e.g., RAIDS, budget, communication
Strong team working skills across matrixed client, supplier, and geographically dispersed virtual teams
Strong communication and interpersonal skills (including negotiation)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills - must be able to communicate fluently in English both verbally and in writing
Leader in the use of IT methodologies, processes, and standards for project management
Experience in working with Global teams - internal resources, contracting resources, suppliers/hardware software vendors
Not mandatory but desirable - experienced in managing to contract; ensuring clients and suppliers alike perform in accordance with original agreement
Supervision Responsibilities:
Direct supervision provided by an experienced program manager or sub-lead; frequency on a weekly or as needed basis
Project manager is expected to act independently to deliver project to schedule, budget and scope; support provided as required and requested, and is self-driven and motivated
The project manager leads project teams consisting of cross functional, global, and virtual groups; assigns responsibility to members; monitors progress; no direct supervision responsibility.
Job Requirements:
Education:
A degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience
Experience:
12 - 18 years of working experience in the IT industry.
5 to 10 years of experience in project management
Other relevant experience in a related technical field (application development, deployment/implementation, and infrastructure)
Work experience in a professional services industry, and in multinational company/global firm is preferred
Certification Requirements:
Project management certification is preferred (PMI/PMP - PMI/CAPM )
Agile certification would be advantageous
Familiarity with ITIL v3 or v4 would be advantageous

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Competency - Client Excellence - Account Excellence
Role Type - Account Operations Coordinator
The opportunity
Senior Associate at CI team supports the Account Manager and the Account Leadership team; Global Client serving Partner, Global Client Executive to develop and manage relevant activities on designated Priority accounts. The Senior Account Coordinator will be expected to provide high quality and insightful support to account teams on Go-to-market activities. The Senior Account Coordinator will build network across the account leadership and within GDS to develop account knowledge to benefit the regional/global Account team and our relationship and business with the client.
Your key responsibilities
Account Management
Own account reporting and ensure relevant stakeholders receive and understand reported data
In liaison with the Client Service Partner and Director, own the account planning process and ensure regular reviews against planned milestones and targets.
Understand the strategic communication and stakeholder engagement requirements to progress the account plan agenda, and work with global teams to respond and deploy
Provide relevant knowledge to Account teams - focus on dissemination of business analysis and research, competitive intelligence and relevant firm thought leadership
To liaise and work with onshore account teams and internal business services groups to scope new support requirements, build processes for the execution of account management tasks, and ensure effective transition of work to the remote GDS support platform
Client Relationship Development
Contribute to complex account and business development needs, including global account planning, go-to-market research and strategy, pursuit or sales support, pitch development, among others
Work with BMC point of contact to plan and execute marketing initiatives that directly drive revenue
Accelerate strategy execution, particularly around prioritized Regions and strategic solutions.
Understand market trends, what is on our clients agenda and how these translate into revenue generating opportunities. Monitor solution revenue to understand success, opportunities, underperformance
Communication
Coordinate with global network of regional account team meetings. Send updated account and sector content and information.
Develop and maintain relationships with service lines, Accounts, Market Segments, Emerging Markets and subsectors to serve as a two-way conduit for connection and communication
Responsible for working to develop high impact relationships and embedding ABD support into the processes of the accounts
Responsible for project management, quality control, review of deliverables, and for embedding the principles of exceptional client service of being connected, responsive and insightful in our support to the account teams and ABD stakeholders
Facilitation of knowledge sharing
Skills and attributes for success
Succinct and structured oral and written communications skills with proven ability to explain complex concepts in a crisp, clear, concise, and graphic-rich style, using appropriate analytics and visualization tools.
Experience in Account Management and preparing sales and pipeline reporting, as well as providing insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients
Experience in Microsoft tools like excel and PPT
To qualify for the role, you must have
Any Graduate
4-8 years experience in Account management and data reporting and analysis
Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
Demonstrated strong written and oral communication skills
Ability to use both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis methodologies, including financial analysis skills, to synthesize information, review data inputs and provide analytic insights
Ideally, you ll also have
Account Management and data reporting skills
Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc.
Credible experience working in a fast-moving, client-driven environment
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
Experience using Procurement portals (i.e., SAP Fieldglass or Ariba)
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
A professional with strong interpersonal skills - confidence, maturity ability to build strong client relationships
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success, as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
