Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Microsoft M365 Delivery Manager - Senior Manager
EY GDS Consulting Digital is seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 Delivery Manager at the Senior Manager level to lead complex, large-scale Microsoft 365 transformation and managed-service engagements. The individual will be accountable for end-to-end delivery, including solution shaping, delivery planning, governance, financial and resource management, quality assurance, risk and dependency management, and client stakeholder engagement. The role requires strong technical and delivery experience across Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, security, compliance, and hybrid environments. The Delivery Manager will provide strategic direction and technical oversight, establish effective delivery controls and operating rhythms, manage globally distributed and multidisciplinary teams, address escalations, and ensure that engagements achieve agreed business outcomes, service quality, timelines, and commercial commitments. The individual will also identify opportunities for continuous improvement, automation, reusable assets, capability development, and account growth while coaching delivery leads, architects, and other team members.
The opportunity
We re looking for resources with capacity that ranges from assisting on in-flight initiatives, up to technical briefings and demonstrations of new technologies across the organization. In senior level roles, leads business solutions, capabilities, and is a strong influencer that engages with client executives and stakeholders. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering.
Your key responsibilities
Engage with clients and senior stakeholders to understand their business objectives, technology landscape, operational challenges, and security requirements, translating them into scalable Microsoft 365 solutions and delivery roadmaps.
Act as the Microsoft 365 subject matter expert and delivery leader, accountable for the successful delivery of complex, enterprise-scale transformation, migration, adoption, and managed-service engagements.
Own end-to-end engagement delivery, including planning, governance, scope, financial performance, resource management, quality, risks, dependencies, milestones, and contractual commitments.
Establish effective delivery governance, operating rhythms, controls, performance measures, and escalation mechanisms to ensure predictable and consistent delivery across multiple workstreams and globally distributed teams.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for solutions across Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Power Platform, security, compliance, and hybrid environments.
Lead solution architecture and design activities for complex Microsoft 365 engagements, ensuring alignment with agreed architecture principles, security requirements, design standards, delivery methodologies, and reusable assets.
Lead major workstreams within large-scale transformation programs, ensuring coordination across architecture, engineering, migration, testing, change management, adoption, service transition, and operations teams.
Own the resolution of critical technical and delivery challenges, acting as the senior escalation point for architects, engineering teams, project managers, clients, and other stakeholders.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders by translating the Microsoft 365 product roadmap, technology trends, and service changes into customer-specific recommendations, risk mitigation plans, adoption opportunities, and measurable business benefits.
Manage engagement economics, including effort estimation, budgeting, forecasting, utilization, delivery productivity, scope control, and margin performance, while balancing quality and client expectations.
Identify and manage delivery risks, architectural dependencies, security and compliance considerations, and service-readiness requirements throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Define and promote Microsoft 365 governance and best practices covering identity, access, security, compliance, information protection, lifecycle management, administration, monitoring, and user adoption.
Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardized delivery methods, reusable tools, accelerators, reference architectures, and lessons learned from previous engagements.
Lead, mentor, and coach architects, technical leads, and delivery team members through performance management, technical communities, knowledge sharing, succession planning, and capability development.
Support workforce planning, staffing, hiring, demand management, and the effective deployment of skills across concurrent engagements and account portfolios.
Contribute to proposals, solution shaping, estimations, client presentations, and account growth by identifying additional opportunities and developing credible delivery approaches.
Work effectively across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models, adapting governance, planning, controls, and reporting to suit the engagements complexity and client environment.
Communicate complex technical and delivery topics clearly to audiences ranging from engineering teams to C-level stakeholders, enabling timely decisions and maintaining alignment across all parties.
Skills and attributes
Strong experience managing complex Microsoft 365 transformation, migration, implementation, adoption, or managed-service engagements.
Good working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Power Platform, security, compliance, and hybrid environments.
Ability to understand Microsoft 365 solutions and technical dependencies sufficiently to support delivery planning, challenge delivery assumptions, manage risks, and facilitate informed decisions. The role is not expected to perform detailed solution architecture or design.
Demonstrated experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of engagements involving architects, engineers, project managers, business analysts, security specialists, change-management teams, and globally distributed delivery teams.
Strong experience managing scope, schedules, budgets, forecasts, resources, utilization, quality, delivery risks, dependencies, contractual commitments, and commercial performance.
Experience establishing delivery governance, operating rhythms, executive reporting, performance measures, issue-resolution processes, and escalation mechanisms.
Practical experience delivering through Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies, with the ability to adapt governance and delivery controls to the engagement context.
Consulting or professional-services experience is strongly preferred, including client engagement, proposal support, effort estimation, delivery planning, and account-growth activities.
Soft Skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage technical, non-technical, and executive stakeholders.
Strong leadership and team-management skills, with the ability to motivate, mentor, and develop globally distributed teams.
Collaborative team player who builds trusted relationships across clients, partners, vendors, and internal functions.
Self-motivated, proactive, and highly accountable, with a strong sense of ownership for delivery outcomes.
Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, including the ability to manage expectations and facilitate decisions.
Excellent presentation and facilitation skills, with the confidence to communicate delivery status, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Ability to remain composed, decisive, and solution-focused in high-pressure and fast-paced delivery environments.
Strong problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and negotiation skills.
Ability to prioritize competing demands and coordinate multiple workstreams effectively.
Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to lead teams through ambiguity, organizational change, and evolving client priorities.
Culturally aware and able to collaborate effectively across geographies, time zones, and diverse working styles.
Results-oriented, with a focus on quality, timely execution, continuous improvement, and measurable business outcomes.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelors or masters degree
A minimum of 14+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm.
Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred
Ideally, you ll also have
Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
What working at EY offers
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Supervising Associate - Strategy Execution Operations
Role brief
Provide end-to-end operational, reporting and data insights, CRM, integrated planning and enablement support to Europe Central MFA and Clients Industries Enablement Leader. The role coordinates business processes, end to end planning support, strengthens CRM adoption and pipeline governance, translates revenue, sales and pipeline data into actionable management insights, supports regional and Business Unit priorities, and drives consistent knowledge-sharing and process documentation across geographically dispersed teams.
Business requirements / key responsibilities
Integrated planning support
Coordinate and support integrated planning cycles, including planning calendars, stakeholder communications, query resolution and consolidation of planning inputs across relevant countries and Business Units.
Contribute to planning discussions by connecting account information and business priorities to support informed target setting and execution follow-through.
Track planning milestones, dependencies, submissions and follow-ups; escalate data gaps or timeline risks and provide clear status updates to stakeholders
Support preparation, validation and maintenance of planning reports and related files, ensuring alignment between agreed planning goals, account priorities and regional reporting requirements.
Take the lead role in Account refresh by communicating and coordinating across various Business Units.
Reporting, analytics business insights
Prepare, review and maintain recurring revenue, sales and pipeline reporting, dashboards and analytical outputs for stakeholders and leadership discussions.
Analyze CRM and Markets data to identify trends, wins, pipeline movements, data-quality issues and business insights; translate findings into clear management-ready updates.
Support KPI management and customized reporting requirements using data extracts and other reporting platforms like essentials and ThoughtSpot, Excel-based analysis and dashboards, while maintaining accuracy and consistency of source data.
Accounts, Markets Operations regional support
Support Markets Operations activities spanning account records, ARD/MDM-related administration, unassigned mapping, account and market-segment updates, and other region-specific operational requirements.
Provide operational and analytical support to Europe Central leadership and Business Units, adapting established practices across BUs and supporting regional priorities as operating models evolve.
Support account-centric and Markets reporting requirements by applying knowledge of GTER, margin, sales, pipeline and related market-performance concepts.
CRM governance, adoption user support
Support CRM adoption, governance, reporting and user enablement across business stakeholders, including functional guidance, access-related support, usage protocols and release awareness.
Maintain and strengthen CRM operating practices by documenting processes, sharing guidance and ensuring users understand relevant tools and protocols.
Sales, pipeline governance data quality
Drive pipeline hygiene and governance activities, including review and follow-up of lapsed, and lapsing opportunities, opportunity qualification, stage/status accuracy and other data-quality exceptions.
Coordinate stakeholder follow-ups and updates to improve pipeline reliability and support timely opportunity maintenance across relevant Business Units and market segments.
Stakeholder workstream management
Act as a key coordination point across business stakeholders, CRM users, regional teams and internal support groups; manage communications, follow-ups, dependencies and issue resolution across workstreams.
Plan and coordinate recurring activities, meetings, documentation and status updates; proactively identify risks, data gaps and process-improvement opportunities and drive actions to closure.
Build strong working relationships with geographically dispersed stakeholders and translate business requirements into practical operational, reporting and enablement deliverables.
Process improvement technology enablement
Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize recurring work through improved templates, structured governance, Power Query/macros, dashboards and other suitable automation or digital approaches.
Support testing, adoption and business-impact assessment of relevant CRM/reporting changes and evolving tools; capture feedback and convert it into process or enablement improvements.
Requirements (including experience, skills and additional qualifications)
Experience and qualifications
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration and Management) with 8 to 12 years of work experience
Experience working with senior stakeholders and geographically dispersed teams, with the ability to manage multiple recurring and ad-hoc priorities.
Mandatory skills attributes
Strong CRM and sales/pipeline management understanding, including opportunity lifecycle, pipeline hygiene, data governance and user support.
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify anomalies and trends, and convert findings into business insights.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics CRM / Mercury-related opportunity processes, Excel and reporting/dashboard environments; strong capability with PowerPoint and business presentations.
Strong stakeholder management, facilitation and written/verbal communication skills; comfortable coordinating across regions, Business Units and senior stakeholder groups.
High ownership and attention to detail, with the ability to operate with minimal supervision, prioritize competing demands and drive workstreams end to end.
Ability to participate in and facilitate meetings, develop presentations, interpret data, generate meaningful business insights, and communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.
Process orientation with a continuous-improvement mindset
Business acumen and adaptability, with the ability to quickly understand evolving operating models, regional priorities and changing customer expectations.
Desired skills
Experience with Power Query, MS office (Power BI, MS Excel, MS PPT and MS Word) or similar analytics and productivity tools.
Change-management and release-adoption experience for CRM, reporting or other enterprise platforms.
Experience developing training materials and facilitating user orientation, refresher or knowledge-transfer sessions.
Exposure to account management, end to end planning, market-performance metrics, market-share analysis or business-development operations.
Role outcomes
Well-coordinated integrated planning cycles supported by complete inputs, validated data, visible milestones and timely follow-up.
Effective coordination across regional and Business Unit stakeholders, with risks, dependencies and follow-ups actively managed.
Reliable Accounts, CRM, revenue, sales and pipeline information for stakeholders and leadership.
Improved consistency of CRM adoption, pipeline governance and data-quality practices.

Supervising Associate
Private Equity Compliance Regulatory Management Support
Discipline
Clients Industries
Role Type
PE CoE - Private Equity Compliance Regulatory Management Support
Business unit specific description - PE CoE (UKI)
The Private Equity Center of Excellence supports the firm in managing independence, compliance and regulatory requirements associated with major UK-headquartered private equity groups and their portfolio entities. The team helps protect the firm by proactively monitoring proposed engagements and business relationships across service lines and supporting compliance with applicable SEC, EU, UK and EY independence requirements.
The Supervising Associate combines hands-on delivery with day-to-day team oversight across assigned PE accounts. The role coordinates regulatory procedures, account structures, research, reporting and stakeholder actions while maintaining high standards of accuracy, timeliness, documentation and professional judgement. The individual works closely with Market Segment Managers, account teams, Partners, senior management and internal risk stakeholders, and provides clear updates, practical guidance and timely escalation of issues.
Your key responsibilities
Lead day-to-day delivery across assigned PE accounts and related workstreams, taking ownership of priorities, timelines, dependencies and outcomes.
Support quarterly Independence Summary Memo procedures, including the initial review of submissions and supporting documentation to confirm required procedures are completed.
Establish and maintain account-level structures, trackers and documentation that enable account teams to meet regulatory and independence requirements.
Reconcile relevant systems and account information to confirm PE group and portfolio structures are accurately reflected.
Monitor press releases, industry announcements and research sources for acquisitions, disposals and other changes affecting focus accounts.
Support public and private company independence procedures for acquisitions and respond to general independence queries relating to PE accounts.
Plan and allocate work across team members, monitor progress and capacity, and ensure agreed deliverables are completed on time.
Perform detailed quality reviews, challenge incomplete or inconsistent outputs and ensure review points are resolved before submission.
Act as a key contact for routine stakeholder matters, communicate status clearly, manage expectations and escalate complex issues or risks promptly.
Facilitate team and stakeholder discussions, convert decisions into clear actions, assign ownership and drive follow-through to closure.
Collate leadership action points and support program and project coordination, management information and workload visibility.
Identify recurring issues, control gaps and improvement opportunities, and lead practical enhancements to processes, trackers, reporting, automation and knowledge materials.
Provide first-level guidance, coaching and constructive feedback to team members, promoting consistent ways of working, knowledge sharing and professional standards.
Skills and attributes for success
Hands-on experience with business, company, and market research platforms such as Bloomberg, LexisNexis, Factiva, Merger Market, Dun Bradstreet (DB), or similar tools.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to analyse synthesize, and clearly present research findings and insights to stakeholders.
Prior exposure to account, client, or master data management systems, along with experience using account or relationship management platforms.
Experience supporting compliance processes, including compliance work papers, due diligence activities, checklists, governance reviews, and policy adherence.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks, SEC guidelines, compliance policies, risk management, or governance-related activities.
Exposure to AML, financial crime or stock market-related domains would be considered as an added advantage.
Experience with SharePoint content management, newsletters, surveys or knowledge repositories.
Experience using automation, artificial intelligence or emerging technologies to improve process efficiency, data quality and business insight.
Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and understand the objectives of different programs and initiatives.
Excellent analytical and reporting skills, including the ability to review, validate and interpret data; develop reports or dashboards; identify trends; and provide practical insights.
Strong presentation and facilitation capability, including leading discussions, preparing clear presentations and communicating insights to business stakeholders.
Ability to work with minimal supervision, prioritize effectively, manage competing demands and adapt to changing business expectations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence working with business leaders and senior stakeholders.
Advanced Microsoft Excel, PowerBI and PowerPoint skills, including pivot tables, lookups, filtering, conditional formatting, validation, charts, and professional slide formatting.
High degree of professionalism, integrity and sound judgement.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A graduate or postgraduate qualification in Business Administration, Finance, Information and Data Science, or a related discipline.
Approximately 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in financial services, professional services, business process management, consulting, research and/or corporate strategy.
Demonstrated experience coordinating projects, reviewing deliverables and working effectively with multiple stakeholders.
Proven ability to analyse information, produce high-quality reports or presentations and communicate clear business insights.
Experience supporting business leaders or leadership groups in a deadline-driven environment.
What we look for
A delivery-focused professional who can balance hands-on execution with team oversight, prioritization, review and stakeholder communication.
A solution-oriented and adaptable thinker who can navigate ambiguity, identify risks or opportunities and make well-reasoned day-to-day decisions.
A collaborative team contributor who builds capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, constructive feedback and consistent quality expectations.
A self-motivated learner with strong interpersonal and cultural awareness, able to build trusted relationships across diverse teams.
Someone who maintains a broad view of account priorities, operational risks and dependencies while ensuring detailed execution remains accurate and timely.

Description:
TechOps - CloudOps - AI/ML Platform Operations Engineer: Senior

The opportunity
We are looking for a seasoned and proactive Senior AI/ML Platform Operations Engineer to operate, support, and continuously improve enterprise machine learning and generative AI platforms. The role will focus on MLOps and LLMOps across model deployment, monitoring, API and endpoint operations, model pipelines, prompt and model configuration, observability, and incident resolution. The engineer will act as a technical escalation point for production AI services and work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, application teams, cloud platform teams, security, DevOps, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective AI capabilities.


Your key responsibilities
Provide day-to-day production and operational support for machine learning, generative AI, and large language model platforms across development, test, staging, and production environments.
Deploy, configure, validate, and support machine learning models, foundation models, embedding models, rerankers, and associated inference services using controlled MLOps and LLMOps practices.
Monitor real-time and batch inference workloads, APIs, endpoints, model pipelines, queues, scheduled jobs, and dependent services, and restore failed or degraded services within agreed SLAs.
Troubleshoot endpoint errors, latency, throttling, token limits, authentication failures, networking issues, dependency conflicts, model-loading errors, memory constraints, and scaling problems.
Operate model training, evaluation, registration, approval, deployment, rollback, and retirement pipelines with traceability across model and environment versions.
Support prompt templates, system instructions, model parameters, routing rules, guardrails, content filters, retrieval configuration, tool connections, and environment-specific configuration.
Implement and maintain observability for model quality, response latency, throughput, error rate, availability, token consumption, cost, drift, data quality, hallucination risk, safety events, and user feedback.
Investigate production incidents using application, model, prompt, API gateway, orchestration, cloud service, infrastructure, and security logs, and coordinate service recovery.
Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents and implement corrective actions, preventive alerts, automated recovery, runbook improvements, and platform engineering enhancements.
Develop and maintain Python utilities, automation scripts, health checks, deployment tooling, test harnesses, evaluation workflows, and operational dashboards.
Support enterprise integrations with OpenAI services, Azure OpenAI where applicable, AWS Bedrock, model gateways, vector stores, API gateways, identity providers, secrets management, and monitoring platforms.
Ensure secure handling of model endpoints, API keys, service identities, secrets, private networking, customer data, prompts, responses, and model artifacts.
Support capacity planning, autoscaling, quota management, rate-limit management, GPU or accelerator utilization, token forecasting, and cost optimization for AI workloads.
Coordinate controlled releases using Git and CI/CD, including testing evidence, model and prompt versioning, approvals, deployment validation, rollback planning, and post-release monitoring.
Manage complex incidents, service requests, problems, and changes, and mentor junior engineers in troubleshooting, platform operations, and operational best practices.
Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, architecture and dependency records, known-error articles, monitoring standards, escalation paths, and support knowledge bases.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong hands-on knowledge of MLOps practices covering experiment tracking, model packaging, model registry, validation, promotion, deployment, monitoring, rollback, and lifecycle governance.
Strong understanding of LLMOps, including foundation model access, prompt and configuration management, evaluation, observability, retrieval-augmented generation, guardrails, endpoint operations, and cost controls.
Experience operating model APIs and endpoints, including authentication, authorization, throttling, load management, autoscaling, latency troubleshooting, retries, timeouts, and high availability.
Strong Python skills for platform automation, API integration, log analysis, operational tooling, testing, and incident diagnosis.

And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY_ Consulting _ Risk Consulting _ Enterprise Risk - Senior 1/2
As part of our Consulting Enterprise Risk team, our clients look for EY s expertise across the consulting solutions and specifically for engagements related to Internal Audit, Process compliance and reviews, SOX 404, Third Party Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance and Enterprise Risk Management.
There really is no average day in this role, since every client will have multi-faceted challenges and a distinct business environment. What it means is that you ll have an opportunity to learn and adapt to our clients cultures and contribute towards developing unique solutions that are tailored to individual engagements. Whichever industry or client you re working with, you ll have plenty of opportunities to expand your business network and transform yourself into a truly global professional.
The opportunity
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies, by improving their processes and leveraging technologies. By plugging into our market-leading global network, youll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional Risk Advisor
Your key responsibilities
Delivery
Manage a team of Staffs (if needed) or independently deliver SOX engagements for multiple processes across client(s)
Participate in process discussions and walkthrough meetings with clients, prepare / review process flows/ narratives and risk control matrices, and identify process gaps and provide recommendations
Conduct, documents and review (if needed) test of design and operating effectiveness, and suggest controls to improve the client s control framework, as per the defined standards and quality benchmark
Drive / Support the Manager in scoping, rationalization, standardization, status update, deficiency and project management
Monitor project progress, manage multiple assignments and related project teams, if needed
Meet quality guidelines within the established turnaround time (or allotted budget) for assigned requests
Client Management
Develop strong working relationships with the client and onshore client teams
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with the client
Demonstrate application and solution-based approach to problem solving
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.
Operational excellence
Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
People related
Display teamwork, integrity and leadership. Work with team members to set goals and responsibilities for specific engagements. Foster teamwork and innovation.
Utilize technology tools to continually learn and innovate, share knowledge with team members and enhance service delivery.
Conduct workshops and technical training sessions for team members. Contribute to the learning development agenda and knowledge harnessing initiatives.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong command on spoken and written English
Analytical, organized and meticulous consulting skills
Strong academic history and professional experience (degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or similar work experience)
Proficient in MS-Office Suite
Team player with strong interpersonal skills
Ability to prioritize deliverables effectively in order to achieve optimum results.
To qualify for the role, you must have
More than 1 year of experience after completion of CA or 3+ years of experience (as B.Com/M.Com, BBA / MBA) in risks controls, with experience mainly in Internal Audit / SOX / internal controls
Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or similar)
Strong command on spoken and written English
Team player with strong interpersonal skills
CIA certification is preferred
Ideally, you ll also have
Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
Opportunities to work with EY Risk -Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to :
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you

Description:
TechOps - CloudOps - Data Governance Data Modelling Support Engineer - Senior

Job Summary
We are looking for a proactive Data Governance Data Modelling Support Engineer to provide production and operational support for enterprise data governance and data modelling platforms. The role will focus on the reliable operation of Collibra and Erwin environments, including workflows, catalog and metadata services, data lineage, access and role issues, model lifecycle support, and controlled model deployments. The engineer will work closely with data governance, architecture, data engineering, security, and business teams to resolve incidents, fulfil service requests, and continuously improve platform support.


Your key responsibilities
Provide day-to-day operational support for Collibra Data Intelligence Platform capabilities, including Data Catalog, metadata ingestion, workflows, lineage, communities, domains, assets, and operating model components.
Investigate and resolve Collibra access, permission, responsibility, role assignment, workflow, synchronization, and configuration issues in line with approved governance controls.
Monitor scheduled metadata ingestion and lineage jobs, troubleshoot failures, validate completeness, and coordinate remediation with source-system and platform teams.
Support onboarding and maintenance of business glossaries, data dictionaries, critical data elements, policies, standards, ownership, stewardship, and certification processes.
Provide operational support for Erwin Data Modeler and related model repositories, including logical and physical models, subject areas, naming standards, versioning, and model publication.
Coordinate model deployment and promotion across environments, perform release validation, maintain audit evidence, and support rollback or recovery when required.
Use SQL and Oracle to validate metadata, investigate data and connectivity issues, reconcile model definitions with database objects, and support root cause analysis.
Manage incidents, service requests, problems, and changes in accordance with ITIL-aligned support processes, service levels, security requirements, and change controls.
Create and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures, known-error records, troubleshooting guides, support dashboards, and knowledge articles.
Collaborate with data owners, data stewards, architects, database administrators, security teams, and application teams to resolve issues and improve governance adoption.
Participate in release activities, periodic platform health checks, disaster recovery exercises, and rotational support coverage for business-critical services.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong hands-on knowledge of Collibra workflows, catalog, metadata management, lineage, operating model concepts, communities, domains, assets, responsibilities, and role-based access.
Hands-on experience with Erwin Data Modeler, enterprise model repositories, logical and physical data modelling, forward and reverse engineering, model comparison, version control, and deployment support.
Good SQL skills for querying, validation, issue diagnosis, reconciliation, and technical impact analysis.
Working knowledge of Oracle databases, schemas, database objects, connectivity, privileges, and common production-support scenarios.
Strong incident troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with a structured approach to problem management and preventive actions.
Understanding of data governance concepts such as ownership, stewardship, business glossary, critical data elements, metadata quality, lineage, access governance, privacy, and regulatory controls.
Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders across distributed teams.
Attention to detail, disciplined documentation, and commitment to service quality and controlled change.


To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree in computer science, information systems, data management, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
5-8 years of experience in data governance platforms, data modelling tools, database support, or enterprise application support, including production-support responsibilities.
Hands-on experience supporting Collibra, including workflows, catalog and metadata operations, lineage, user access, roles, and issue resolution.

Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance

The Associate Agency Development Manager is responsible for driving business growth through the recruitment, development, and management of a team of insurance agents. This role involves identifying potential agents, conducting training sessions, and providing ongoing support to ensure agents meet their sales targets. The successful candidate will be focused on achieving branch sales goals, enhancing agent performance, and maintaining strong relationships with agents to foster a motivated sales environment. Key responsibilities include developing business plans, analyzing market trends, implementing sales strategies, and ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and onboard new agents to build a robust sales team.
- Design and implement training programs to enhance agents sales skills and product knowledge.
- Set performance targets for the team and monitor progress, providing feedback and support as needed.
- Foster growth and maintain motivation among agents through consistent communication and mentorship.
- Analyze sales data and market trends to develop effective sales strategies.
- Collaborate with management to align team goals with organizational objectives.
- Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements in the insurance sector.
- Organize performance assessments and identify areas for improvement for agents.

Skills Required:
- Strong leadership and team-building skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to analyze data and market trends effectively.
- Proficient in sales strategies and customer relationship management.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Proven track record in sales and business development in the insurance sector.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho CRM).
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Data analysis tools for sales tracking and performance monitoring.
- Online training platforms for agent development.
- Communication tools (e.g., email, video conferencing software).

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will supervise and guide your team members closely, ensuring the service sequence is flawless and goes beyond guest expectations. As an F&B Executive, you re not just creating unforgettable dining moments - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
High school diploma or equivalent; proven experience in a similar role.
Excellent communication, grooming, and interpersonal skills
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
Friendly, professional, and guest-focused
Able to work flexible shifts
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Operational Oversight: Support daily outlet operations to ensure smooth service and adherence to brand standards.
Team Leadership: Supervise, train, and motivate staff to deliver exceptional guest experiences and maintain high performance.
Guest Experience Management: Ensure personalized service, handle guest feedback, and resolve issues promptly to enhance satisfaction.
Inventory & Cost Control: Monitor stock levels, manage ordering, and control costs to optimize profitability.
Sales & Revenue Support: Drive upselling initiatives, monitor sales performance, and support revenue targets.
Compliance & Hygiene: Ensure adherence to health, safety, and hygiene regulations across all outlet areas.
Coordination & Communication: Collaborate with kitchen, housekeeping, and other departments for seamless service delivery.
Food Safety Regulations: Ensuring that all food safety standards are met.

Job Description Branch Head (Sales )
Department: Sales & Marketing
Experience: 812 Years

1. Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Branch Head to lead the branch's sales, marketing, admissions, and operational activities. The incumbent will be responsible for achieving branch revenue targets, driving business growth, managing the sales team, developing institutional partnerships, and ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the student lifecycle.
The ideal candidate should have strong leadership capabilities, business acumen, consultative sales experience, and the ability to drive team performance and operational excellence.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities
A. Sales & Business Development
Achieve branch revenue targets and Annual Business Plan (ABP).
Develop and execute regional sales and marketing strategies.
Identify new business opportunities across B2B and B2C segments.
Manage the sales pipeline, monitor conversions, and forecast monthly revenue.
Build strong relationships with schools, principals, coordinators, educational institutions, and corporate clients.
Explore new market segments and drive business growth.

B. Marketing & Lead Generation
Plan and execute marketing activities across the assigned region.
Organize seminars, school campaigns, open seminars, residential township activities, and corporate events.
Participate in relevant promotional activities to increase brand visibility and market share.
Ensure effective merchandising and product displays to drive customer engagement and sales.
Monitor competitor activities and identify market opportunities.

C. Student Lifecycle & Admissions Management
Drive the complete student lifecycle, including prospecting, counselling, admissions, orientation, and post-admission support.
Ensure effective lead management, follow-ups, and admission conversions.
Interact with parents and educational institutions to understand their requirements and provide need-based solutions.
Ensure timely resolution of customer queries and grievances to maximize customer satisfaction.

D. Team Leadership & Performance Management
Lead, motivate, and manage the branch sales and operations teams.
Conduct regular training on product knowledge, sales processes, and service offerings.
Monitor daily sales activities, team productivity, and admission performance.
Build strong collaboration between academic, sales, and operations teams.
Address employee concerns, sales-related conflicts, and pricing issues promptly.
Drive employee engagement and ensure a positive working environment.

E. Branch Operations & Business Governance
Manage end-to-end branch operations and ensure process compliance.
Prepare and review MIS reports, sales dashboards, and business performance reports.
Monitor daily sales activities and admission management processes.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including Product, Marketing, Academic, and Operations teams.
Ensure effective execution of business strategies and operational standards.

3. Required Skills & Competencies
Strong experience in consultative sales and business development.
Excellent leadership, team management, and people management skills.
Strong business acumen and target-oriented approach.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.
Excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills.
Self-motivated, innovative, proactive, and result-oriented.
Strong interpersonal skills and stakeholder management capabilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Knowledge of South Indian regional languages is mandatory.

4. Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA will be an added advantage.
8–12 years of relevant professional experience.
Candidates with experience in Education, Teaching, Training, Insurance, or Pharma industries are preferred.
Prior experience in branch management, sales leadership, business development, and team handling is desirable.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Achievement of monthly and annual revenue targets.
Lead generation and admission conversion ratios.
Branch profitability and business growth.
B2C business development.
Team productivity and individual target achievement.
Customer satisfaction and grievance resolution.
Operational efficiency and process compliance.
Market penetration and competitor tracking.

Ideal Candidate Profile: A strong business leader with proven sales performance, excellent team-handling capabilities, and the ability to independently manage branch-level business operations while driving sustainable revenue growth.

Job Summary
Discipline: GDS Enablement Services Growth & Innovation
Role title: Quantum Senior Associate
The Quantum Senior Associate will play a hands-on delivery role across Quantum Technology initiatives, with stronger ownership for solution design, technical execution, stakeholder communication and delivery quality than an Associate role. The role requires practical experience in quantum-safe security and/or quantum computing, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business and delivery outcomes.
The role is expected to have a primary focus on quantum safety, including post-quantum cryptography readiness, and a secondary focus on quantum computing use cases such as optimization, machine learning and simulation.
Responsibilities
Support the development of quantum safety and quantum computing solutions, prototypes and demonstrations.
Contribute to post-quantum cryptography readiness assessments, including data gathering, analysis and documentation.
Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms and workflows for selected optimization, machine learning and simulation use cases.
Build and maintain software tools, accelerators and proof-of-concept assets using established engineering practices.
Prepare technical documentation, assessment reports and presentation materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including cybersecurity, AI/ML, platform engineering and product teams.
Participate in testing, validation and benchmarking activities to assess solution performance and applicability.
Stay current on developments in quantum computing, post-quantum cryptography and related emerging technologies.
Quantum Specialist Responsibilities
Quantum Cyber / Safety:
Support quantum risk assessments and identify areas that may require future cryptographic modernization.
Assist in prototyping and benchmarking post-quantum cryptography algorithms within applications and services.
Contribute to analysis of quantum-safe and hybrid cryptographic approaches and document findings.
Support development of crypto-inventory and discovery capabilities to identify legacy cryptography dependencies.
Execute testing of hybrid key exchange mechanisms and document performance observations.
Assist with implementation and validation of crypto-agility patterns, certificate updates and key management enhancements.
Contribute to creation and maintenance of migration guides, standards documentation and operational runbooks.
Quantum Compute & Algorithms:
Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms using industry-standard quantum development platforms.
Support experimentation and testing to assess the practicality of quantum use cases.
Build proof-of-concept solutions for optimization, simulation and emerging Quantum + AI use cases.
Perform basic resource estimation and analysis of quantum circuits and algorithm performance.
Compare classical and quantum approaches and document observations and recommendations.
Maintain reproducible experimentation environments using Python, Jupyter notebooks, containers and source control tools.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Foundational understanding of quantum computing concepts, including qubits, gates, quantum circuits and current hardware limitations.
Basic understanding of post-quantum cryptography concepts, key encapsulation mechanisms, digital signatures and emerging standards.
Familiarity with cryptographic concepts such as public-key cryptography, certificates and secure communication protocols.
Experience with at least one quantum development platform such as Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, Azure Quantum or AWS Braket.
Proficiency in Python programming and familiarity with commonly used scientific and data analysis libraries.
Working knowledge of software development fundamentals, including version control and testing practices.
Ability to design and execute experiments, analyse results and communicate findings effectively.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in global, cross-functional teams.
Interest in emerging technologies and willingness to continuously learn new concepts and tools.
Education and Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
25+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:
Software development or engineering
Applied cryptography or cybersecurity
Data science, machine learning or advanced analytics
Quantum computing research or development
High-performance or scientific computing
Experience developing prototypes, proof-of-concepts or technical solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks.
Familiarity with Python and scientific computing libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas or similar tools.
Exposure to quantum computing concepts, quantum software development kits or post-quantum cryptography is preferred but not mandatory.
Understanding of cybersecurity and cryptography fundamentals is desirable.
Experience working in agile, research or innovation-focused environments is advantageous.
Ability to independently complete assigned deliverables while collaborating effectively with senior team members.
Publications, hackathons, certifications, research projects or open-source contributions related to quantum technologies are beneficial but not required.
Willingness to work with global teams and support overlap with US East Coast hours when needed.

Job Summary
Results-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2-3 years of hands-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid-size to enterprise organizations. Description:
Job Description
AVEVA PI Engineer / Consultant Pharmaceutical Client
Job Title

AVEVA PI Engineer / Consultant
Industry Domain

Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences (GxP-regulated Manufacturing)
Experience Required

5-10 years
Employment Type

Full-time
Location

Chennai/Bangalore/Kochi/Coimbatore - Hybrid
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced AVEVA PI (OSIsoft PI) Engineer with expertise in the Life Sciences/Pharmaceutical industry to design, implement, and support enterprise historian solutions. The candidate will be responsible for integrating manufacturing, laboratory, utility, and automation systems with the AVEVA PI System to enable real-time monitoring, data integrity, regulatory compliance, process optimization, and digital transformation initiatives.
The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, GMP regulations, data integrity requirements, and industrial automation systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain PI Data Archive, PI AF (Asset Framework), PI Vision, and PI Interfaces/Connectors to collect, contextualize, and deliver real-time process data.
Build and manage AF templates, element hierarchies, event frames, and analyses to model plant assets and business logic.
Configure and troubleshoot PI interfaces (OPC DA/UA, Modbus, custom interfaces) for data acquisition from PLCs, DCS, SCADA, and historians.
Develop PI Vision displays, dashboards, and PI DataLink/Excel reports for operations, engineering, and management stakeholders.
Write and maintain scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, PI SDK/AF SDK, PI Web API) to automate data workflows, integrations, and system health checks.
Integrate PI System data with other platforms (MES, ERP, SQL/historian databases, cloud data lakes, Aveva Data Hub/Connect).
Monitor system performance, data quality, and tag counts; perform capacity planning and license management.
Support PI System upgrades, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and high-availability (PI Collective) configurations.
Enforce cybersecurity best practices for OT/IT systems, including PI System security (mappings, identities, firewalls).
Document architecture, standards, naming conventions, and data governance processes.
Collaborate with process/controls engineers to identify new tagging, KPI, and analytics requirements.
provide Tier 2/3 support and root-cause analysis for PI System issues.Required Technical Skillset
Strong hands-on experience with AVEVA System Platform (Application Server / Galaxy, Historian, InTouch, Web Client / Operations Control).
Working knowledge of AVEVA MES / AVEVA Batch Management, or exposure to integrating third-party MES/LIMS/ERP with SCADA layer.
Proficiency in OPC UA/DA, Modbus, and native communication drivers for PLC/DCS integration
Experience with scripting (QuickScript/VBScript) and object-oriented Galaxy template design.
Understanding of network/OT architecture, redundancy, cybersecurity hardening (ISA/IEC 62443 awareness a plus), and virtualization (VMware) for industrial systems.
Familiarity with SQL Server/reporting tools for Historian data extraction and dashboarding (AVEVA Insight / Reports is a plus).
Pharmaceutical / Regulatory Domain Expertise (Preferred)
Sound knowledge of GAMP 5 computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) lifecycle and documentation practices.
Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and data integrity (ALCOA+) requirements.
Certifications (Preferred)
AVEVA PI certification
GAMP 5 / CSV training certification.
Soft Skills & Other Requirements
Strong client-facing communication skills; ability to work directly with pharma quality, validation, and automation stakeholders.
Ability to prepare and present technical estimations, proposals, and solution walkthroughs to client/hiring stakeholders.
Strong documentation discipline suited to regulated/validated environments.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills for live plant support scenarios.

INNOV8 | Area Sales Manager Job
Description
About INNOV8
INNOV8 is one of Indias leading coworking and managed office space brands, creating
beautifully designed, premium workspaces that enable people and companies to work,
collaborate, and grow together. With a growing presence across major Indian cities, INNOV8
serves a diverse ecosystem of entrepreneurs, freelancers, startups, and enterprises by offering
flexible workspace solutions tailored to different stages of growth.
Position: Area Sales Manager INNOV8
Reports To: City Head
Employment Type: Full-time
Role Overview
The Area Sales Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth, occupancy, and
market penetration for INNOV8 centers in the assigned region. The role combines new
business acquisition, account management, and channel development, with a strong focus on
building long-term client and broker relationships.
You will work closely with center teams, marketing, and leadership to ensure sustained seat
sales, timely collections, and best-in-class client experience.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Growth
• Develop and implement a growth strategy for the region focused on financial gain,
occupancy improvement, and customer satisfaction.
• Identify, build, and expand new markets across relevant customer segments (startups,
SMEs, enterprises, freelancers).



• Generate a strong pipeline of prospects through cold outreach, referrals, ecosystem
connects, and channel partners.
2. Sales, Revenue & Collections
• Achieve monthly and quarterly seat sales and revenue targets for assigned centers.
• Prepare and present formal proposals, quotes, and commercial offers to prospects.
• Negotiate and close deals with key decision-makers, ensuring mutually beneficial
terms.
• Drive monthly collections based on invoices raised; ensure minimal delays and
revenue leakage.
3. Client Relationship Management & Retention
• Build long-term relationships with new and existing customers to drive repeat and
expansion business.
• Regularly engage with clients to understand their evolving needs and identify
upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
• Focus on renewal, expansion, and churn control for key accounts in the region.
• Ensure timely resolution of client complaints within defined TAT and proactively
address service gaps.
4. Channel & Lead Generation Strategy
• Devise and execute strategies for lead generation through:
o Brokers, channel partners, and IPCs
o Online and direct channels
o Startup and ecosystem collaborations
o Partnerships and alliances in the region
• Build and nurture a strong broker and partner network to ensure steady inflow of
qualified leads.
5. Reporting, Tracking & Governance
• Keep accurate records of sales, revenue, pipeline, collections, and key account
activity.
• Maintain updated data and reports on CRM/trackers as per organizational standards.
• Share regular updates and insights on market trends, competition, and customer
feedback with leadership.
Qualifications & Experience
• Proven experience in sales, preferably in coworking, commercial real estate, flex
spaces, or related sectors.



• Strong communication, negotiation, and deal-closing skills with comfort in handling
CXO/decision-maker conversations.
• Good connections and working relationships with brokers, IPCs, property consultants,
or relevant ecosystem partners.
• Experience in community building, events, or client engagement will be an added
advantage.
•
Bachelors degree in any field is preferred; MBA or equivalent in Sales/Marketing is
a plus.
Key Skills & Competencies
• Strong sales ownership and target orientation
• Relationship-building and stakeholder management
• Market understanding of coworking / office space / real estate ecosystem
• Analytical approach to revenue, pricing, and occupancy
• High level of responsiveness, follow-through, and execution discipline
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.

Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.

Conduct investigations and gather evidence related to theft/fraud or lost items, noise complaints, assault complaints, food poisoning complaints, and other guest complaints and incidents. Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for the daily shift operations of Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club and, if applicable, Laundry. Directs and works with employees to verify property guestrooms, public space and employee areas are clean and well maintained. Completes inspections and holds people accountable for corrective action. Position assists in ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the housekeeping or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Housekeeping Operations and Budgets
- Verifies guest room status is communicated to the Front Desk in a timely and efficient manner.
- Inspects guestrooms on a daily basis.
- Obtains list of rooms to be cleaned immediately and list of prospective check-outs or discharges to prepare work assignments.
- Inventories stock to verify adequate supplies.
- Supports and supervises an effective inspection program for all guestrooms and public space.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property financial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Verifies all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Communicates areas that need attention to staff and follows up to verify understanding.
- Supervises daily Housekeeping shift operations and verifies compliance with all housekeeping policies, standards and procedures.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Uses all available on the job training tools to train new room attendants and provide follow-up training as necessary.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and verifies employees do the same with them.
- Schedules employees to business demands and for tracks employee time and attendance.
- Verifies employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Verifies property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process, where applicable.
- Supervises staffing levels to verify that guest service, operational needs, and financial objectives are met.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Verifies employee recognition is taking place on all shifts.
- Participates in an on-going employee recognition program.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy, and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
- Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans to improve guest satisfaction.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Strives to improve service performance.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Accountable for the quality, consistency and production of the restaurant kitchen. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Coordinates menus, purchasing, staffing and food preparation for the propertys restaurant. Works with team to improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved. Develops and trains team to improve results.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met for Restaurant
- Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions for restaurant.
- Supervises restaurant kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
- Maintains food preparation handling and correct storage standards.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Plans and manages food quantities and plating requirements for the restaurant.
- Communications production needs to key personnel.
- Assists in developing daily and seasonal menu items for the restaurant.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations regulations.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Estimates daily restaurant production needs.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
Leading Kitchen Team
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Leads shift teams while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Supervises and manages restaurant kitchen employees. Managing all day-to-day operations. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensuring and maintaining the productivity level of employees.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Establishing and Maintaining Restaurant Kitchen Goals
- Sets and supports achievement of kitchen goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
- Developing specific guidance and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish daily kitchen operations work.
- Understands the impact of kitchen operation on the overall property financial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Effectively investigates, reports and follows-up on employee accidents.
- Knows and implements company safety standards.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Participates in training restaurant staff on menu items including ingredients, preparation methods and unique tastes.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with appropriate skills.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Job Summary
Position: Project Coordinator - Project SAMBAL
Location: Bhatapara, Chattisgarh
Reporting To: State Programme Manager (in State) Senior Programme Manager - Livelihoods (Head Office)
Project Duration: As per project period (annual contract, renewable based on performance and availability of funds)
This role supports and coordinates field-level implementation of the project by mobilising rural elderly, strengthening Elder Self-Help Groups (eSHGs), promoting financial inclusion and livelihoods, and facilitating access to government entitlements. The role also includes monitoring project progress, maintaining records, and reporting outcomes to the Head Office.


Key Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day implementation of project activities at the field/project level.
Mobilise rural elderly and facilitate the formation and strengthening of Elder Self-Help Groups (eSHGs).
Supervise regular group meetings, savings, internal lending and maintenance of group records with support of mobiliser/ESHG leaders.
Support livelihood activities, financial literacy and access to government entitlements and social security schemes.
Coordinate with local government functionaries, banks and other stakeholders for project activities and service linkages.
Undertake regular field visits and provide support to ESHGs and community members.
Maintain project records, update MIS and submit periodic progress reports to the Head Office.


Requirements
Graduate in any discipline, preferably in Social Sciences or related fields.
2-3 years of relevant experience in rural development, community mobilisation, SHG promotion or livelihood programmes.
Preference will be given to candidates having experience in SHG formation, management and working with community-based institutions.
Basic understanding of rural livelihoods, financial inclusion and government welfare schemes.
Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with rural communities.
Basic computer knowledge, particularly MS Office and data entry.
Willingness to undertake regular field visits and proficiency in the local language.

SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.
