Function Summary IRDA Regulation on IMF was released, where companies which are LLP / Pvt limited / cooperative societies were allowed to distribute financial products. IMFs are allowed to deal in Insurance of 6 companies (2LI, 2GI, 2HI), mutual funds, banking products, post etc. Max life spotted this opportunity to attract established financial distributors from the market to engage and distribute max life products - PEARL ACQUISITION. A dedicated team of 50 CDMs were recruited in two phases and trained to hire farm these relationships. Currently we have 95 licensed IMFs on board and expected to touch 150 which are work in progress. The pool of IMF s primarily comprises of top Agents in Insurance, Wealth Managers, Loan DSA, CA, Ex - employees from financial services with an existing customer base customer base. Present IMF carries avg. 2500 customers and big turnover book. As a later part of Pearl acquisition strategy, Insurance Managers is a career option provided to establish financial distributors who are not able to meet the requirements of forming an IMF. This has also proven to be an exciting opportunity. Insurance Manager is part time employee model which provides a platform to the pearl to associate with MLI and improve their earnings, flexible working hours and better choices to their customers. IM will be different from an ADM/APC as he will not be recruiting and mentoring Agents and will only source business by penetrating into his existing client base. Avg book size with them is also 750 customers.


Key Responsibilities
Understand the IM acquisition and IMF regulation, value proposition registration process
Acquisition of 6 - 7 IMs in a year independently.
Independently managing a pool of Insurance Managers mapped to them from existing pool in the beginning only.
Post successful completion of 1 year, the next level is CDM wherein the focus will be on IMF journey
Manage performance of IMs
Develop understanding of products coach IM staff on product USP s
Implement performance management and rewards system in IMs
Provide marketing, training and operational support to IMs
Manage attrition of IMs through revival or replacement
Drive quality of business sourced from IMs
Ensure right product mix and control key quality measures such as leakage and persistency.


Measures of Success
Minimum 6-8 IM Acquisition in a year
Achieving sales target through team of IMs
IM Activity Retention
Quality of Business
Create pipeline for IMF s


Qualifications and Experience
Educational Background: Minimum a graduate
Work Experience: At least 1-3 years of experience in recruiting business partners / Agents and achieving sales target through them.
Good communication skill.


Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
Excellent Written, presentation communication skills
Exceptional consultative interpersonal skills
Stakeholder management
Influencing without authority
Full understanding / experience of handling entire life cycle of a deal from initiation to successful completion

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Role & responsibilities

Develop short-term and long-term mine plans, bench sequencing, and overburden (OB) stripping strategy using mine planning software (e.g., Minex, AutoCAD, Deswik).
Execute surface miner deployment planning, bench height/width dimensions, and haul road gradient design suited to local geo-mining conditions.
Plan infrastructure layouts including sumps, drainage diversions, check dams, haul roads, and monsoon preparedness measures.
2. Statutory Clearances & Regulatory Compliance
Prepare documentation and support technical liaisoning for stage-wise Forest Clearance (FC-1 & FC-2), Environmental Clearance (EC), and Mining Lease execution.
Assist in obtaining statutory permissions from the Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS), Coal Controllers Organisation (CCO), State Pollution Control Board (SPCB), and Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA).
Coordinate pre-mining geotechnical studies, baseline monitoring, and public hearing procedures for project approval.
3. Land Acquisition & Pre-Mining Infrastructure Support
Collaborate with the Land, Liaison & External Affairs teams on DGPS boundary demarcation, surface feature surveys, and cadastral mapping.
Assist in identifying Compensatory Afforestation (CA) land, preparing land schedules, and conducting sample tree enumeration for statutory clearances.
Coordinate boundary pillaring and NOC clearances for infrastructure/utility diversions (powerlines, roads, water channels).
4. Operational Oversight & Safety Management
Supervise drilling, blasting design, and surface excavation, maintaining fragmentation control, powder factor efficiency, and vibration mitigation within statutory limits.
Implement the mine Safety Management System (SMS) in strict compliance with the Mines Act 1952, Coal Mines Regulations (CMR), and DGMS directives.
Conduct risk assessments, job safety analyses, toolbox talks, and regular safety audits across the project area.
5. Quality Control & Contractor Management
Monitor coal seam correlation, sampling, and coal quality grade assurance (GCV & Proximate analysis) to meet captive requirements.
Scrutinize technical tender specifications, monitor Mine Developer-cum-Operator (MDO) / OB contractor performance, and verify volume measurements.

Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations, including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.

Benefits

Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):

Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

As a professionally trained Lady Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. Job Introduction:
Job Title: Security Supervisor
Location: Pune, Maharashtra
Job Type: Full-time (Rotational Shifts)
Experience Level: 1 year of experience in corporate, industrial, or residential security
Job Purpose
The Security Supervisor will be responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment across the premises. This role focuses on executing daily security protocols, monitoring surveillance systems, and handling gate management. It is an individual contributor role with no direct team leadership responsibilities, reporting directly to the Security Manager/Head.
Key Responsibilities
Access Gate Control: Manage entry and exit points for employees, visitors, vendors, and vehicles. Ensure thorough checking and logging of all materials and assets entering or leaving the premises.
Surveillance Monitoring: Actively monitor CCTV cameras, fire alarm panels, and biometric access control systems to detect any unauthorized activity or safety hazards.
Patrolling: Conduct regular physical rounds of the assigned facility (buildings, parking areas, and perimeters) to ensure doors are locked, hazards are cleared, and the area is secure.
Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate physical and digital logs (Visitor Registers, Material Inward/Outward, Shift Handover logs). Report any unusual incidents or maintenance issues immediately to the management.
Emergency Support: Assist senior management during emergencies (fire drills, medical situations, or breaches) by following established evacuation and safety protocols.
Requirements Qualifications
Education: Minimum 10th or 12th pass (Higher Secondary).
Experience: Exactly 1 year of experience working as a security guard, gate keeper, or security assistant in a structured corporate or industrial environment.
Language Skills: Ability to speak and understand Marathi and Hindi to communicate with local staff. Basic reading and writing skills in English are required for register entry and system logging.
Technical Skills: Basic knowledge of operating computers or smartphone-based visitor management apps (e.g., MyGate, GatePass). Knowledge of operating basic CCTV monitors is a plus.
Physical Fitness: Excellent physical health and stamina, as the role requires standing for long periods and active patrolling.
Key Competencies
Highly alert, observant, and detail-oriented.
Punctual, disciplined, and able to follow strict rules and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Polite yet firm communication skills for handling visitors and staff at the gates.

Description:
Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for
month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries
4. Drive overall engage merchant base
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Job description

Job Specification:-
Position:-Sales Officer
Location :-Baramula
Experience :- 1 years +
Industry:- Nutraceutical
Channel:- General Trade/Modern Trade

Job Description:- General Trade.
1. Sales Target Achievement: Daily market visit and cover 20-25 retailers daily basis as per monthly travel plan. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in General Trade by expanding the distributor and retailer base.
2. Distributor Management: Build strong relationships with distributors, ensuring product availability and maintaining optimum stock levels.
3. Retailer Engagement: Conduct regular market visits to assess retailer performance, manage relationships, and ensure visibility of the brand in outlets.
4. Route Planning: Plan and execute the sales route for daily market visits to maximize coverage and improve product penetration.
5. Market Feedback: Gather feedback from retailers and distributors on pricing, promotions, competitor activity, and product acceptance.

Modern Trade (MT):
Store Management: Work closely with key accounts, supermarkets, and hypermarkets to drive sales and ensure product visibility.
Planogram Compliance: Ensure the brands products are displayed according to planogram guidelines and that promotional displays are set up correctly.
Stock Management: Monitor stock levels in stores, coordinating with supply chain and merchandising teams to avoid out-of-stock situations.
Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and category managers to ensure smooth operations.
Promotions & Activations: Implement promotional campaigns, in-store activations, and other initiatives to boost sales and brand awareness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.
Improvement in product visibility and brand presence in both GT and MT.
Effective distributor and store relationship management.
Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Role & responsibilities

Merchant Acquisition & Lifecycle: Drive merchant onboarding, engagement, and lifecycle management for Mobile & Large Appliances (LA).
Target Achievement: Monitor daily sales KPIs, identify performance gaps, and ensure the team meets or exceeds monthly, quarterly, and annual sales quotas.
Merchant Experience: Drive merchant-level communication for new initiatives and maintain high Merchant NPS and productivity.

Preferred candidate profile

Industry Experience: Strong working knowledge of the consumer electronics, telecom, or retail distribution sectors.
Local Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the local market geography, local business culture, and native language fluency ("Son of the Soil" preferred).
Tech-Savvy: Comfortable utilizing mobile apps, CRM, and digital platforms to manage field operations and track analytics.
Core Competencies: Proven skills in concept selling, problem-solving, field team mentoring, and a strong result-oriented mindset.
AboutCompany:
JioMart Digital is your neighbourhood mobile & consumer electronics store that offers a wide range of products across all electronics categories including Smartphones, TV & Audio, Air-Conditioners, Refrigerators, Washing Machines, Microwave Ovens, Small Domestic Appliances, Laptops & Tablets, Audio Enhancements, Storage, Wearables, Power & other accessories.

JioMart Digital has over 100K+ retail partner stores across both urban and rural India. Its retail network is expanding rapidly to cover all major districts & talukas across the country. JioMart Digital offers Reliance Retails assurance, assortment, great prices, offers, finance options, door-step delivery & all post purchase services including service and maintenance to the consumers.

JioMart Digital Partner Stores provide the perfect amalgamation of retailer trust & online ease of product discovery, comparison and offers to its consumers. The partner stores are enabled with an Assisted Selling Product Catalogue through which consumers can evaluate, compare and order the complete range of electronic products from the store. The store guides the consumer in making the correct product selection with great price, offers and finance options. The products ordered are delivered directly at the consumer’s home. Installation services, after sales service support and extended warranty are also provided via Reliance ResQ.

JioMart Digital Partner Stores extend the Reliance trust factor and always leave a smile on the faces of the consumers.

Functions as the strategic business leader of property operations and acts as General Manager in his/her absence.
Areas of responsibility include Front Office, , Retail/Gift Shops, Recreation/Fitness Center, Housekeeping, Security/Loss Prevention, Engineering/Maintece, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Event Management, where applicable.
Position works with direct reports (Executive Committee members and department heads) to develop and implement the operations strategy and ensuring implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
The position ensuring operations meet the brand s target customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes ficial performance.
As a member of the Executive Committee, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Profitability and Departmental Budgets
- Keeps operations team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Ensures that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
- Reviews ficial reports and statements to determine how Operations is performing against budget.
- Ensures capital expenditure funds are being used to address the priorities outlined in the service strategy.
- Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establishing ways to improve the departments ficial performance.
- Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
- Identifies and analyzes operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
- Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.
- Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holds team accountable for results.
- Develops an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand s business strategy and leads its execution.
- Makes and executes key decisions to keep property moving forward towards achievement of goals.
Managing Property Operations
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding operational goals to produce desired results on a continuous basis.
- Ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
- Ensures core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
Leading Property Operations Teams
- Establishes a vision for product and service delivery on property.
- Champions the brand s service vision for product and service delivery and ensuring alignment amongst the property leadership team.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Hires operations management team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
- Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
- Utilizes an open door policy and reviewing employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Stays knowledgeable of leadership talent in the property.
- Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Key Interactions
Networking with internal and external stake holders

A Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent is required
Education and Experience
0 to 8 years of experience in a factory in Mechanical in Maintenance domain
Competencies
Communication Skills
Computer knowledge especially in AutoCAD
Certification / Software
MS Office
Oracle

CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4

20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Key Responsibilities
PLC, SCADA & Automation Systems

Ensure smooth operation, maintenance, and reliability of PLC, SCADA, HMI, BMS, EMS, and automation systems across manufacturing and utility areas.

Description:
Group Company: Indorama India Pvt Ltd
Business Unit: Spandex
Office Location: Baddi
Department: Filament Spinning
Designation: Filament Spinning Engineer
Reporting to: Filament Spinning Engineer
Job Brief: To handle the Filament Spinning processes and related activities at the Indorama plant under the supervision of HOD in order to meet quality standards and deliverables within defined organisational standards and procedures.
Responsibilities:
Core Responsibilities:
1.Responsible for shift-based manpower distribution, operator overtime tracking, and planning of the next 24 hours' scheduled or unscheduled activities.
2.To perform 24-hour quality gradation analysis and daily entry of breaks, waste, and quality details on board.
3.To do a 24-hour packing memo analysis, identify repeating endpoints, and take corrective action.
4.Monitoring safety incidents and PPE (Personal Protective Equipment), and filling up the event form and sharing it within 24 hours of any safety incident.
5.To oversee the identification of poor positions in the winder and to take corrective action based on the daily breakage report.
6.To oversee the monitoring of winder change, winder PM, winder tripping, and the updating of comoli data.
7.To oversee the segregation of downgraded bobbins based on lab results and to undertake the necessary corrective actions.
8.Oversee the preparation of waste and mixing reports each shift, as well as processing of technical data updates in the process folder.
9.To oversee the audit of the empty tube and bobbin weight and to confirm the findings with the superior.
10.To look after bobbin mixing based on breaks entry and perform analysis to take corrective action.
11.Taking care of Comoli data updates and comoli parameter changes in response to lab results.
12.To enter information on 24-hour breakages and analyse it, as well as to take care of SOC and trash updates.
13.Take care of the new product Trial follow up and compilation of the report.
14.Monitoring product performance on a regular basis and discussing it in the daily track up meeting.
15.Tracking of recurrent mechanical, instrumentation, engineering jobs, as well as scheduling pack changes, candle filter changes, and following up with quality for lab result confirmation.
16.Oversee production changes, bottom filter, bottom perforated plate change plan, oil change follow up, and department inventory maintenance.
17.Responsible for the daily tracking and issuance of paper tubes, sticker rolls, and ribbon, as well as handling dirty and broken bobbins (due to human error), as well as their name declaration and operator training.
18.Provide training to contract labourers and keep track of the availability of shift-based packs and candles.

Key Interactions: Networking with Internal Stakeholders
Education and Experience: A Graduate Degree Textile Engineering or equivalent is preferred
Competencies:
Production process knowledge
Computer knowledge
Communication skills

Skills: MS Office
Certification / Software: MS Office
Performance Measures:
Gradation % age
Machine availability loss time
Waste percentage
Safety incidents

Language: English,Hindi

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job description

Job Specification:-
Position:-Sales Officer
Location :-Una/Hamirpur-Himachal
Experience :- 1 years +
Industry:- Nutraceutical
Channel:- General Trade/Modern Trade

Job Description:- General Trade.
1. Sales Target Achievement: Daily market visit and cover 20-25 retailers daily basis as per monthly travel plan. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in General Trade by expanding the distributor and retailer base.
2. Distributor Management: Build strong relationships with distributors, ensuring product availability and maintaining optimum stock levels.
3. Retailer Engagement: Conduct regular market visits to assess retailer performance, manage relationships, and ensure visibility of the brand in outlets.
4. Route Planning: Plan and execute the sales route for daily market visits to maximize coverage and improve product penetration.
5. Market Feedback: Gather feedback from retailers and distributors on pricing, promotions, competitor activity, and product acceptance.

Modern Trade (MT):
Store Management: Work closely with key accounts, supermarkets, and hypermarkets to drive sales and ensure product visibility.
Planogram Compliance: Ensure the brands products are displayed according to planogram guidelines and that promotional displays are set up correctly.
Stock Management: Monitor stock levels in stores, coordinating with supply chain and merchandising teams to avoid out-of-stock situations.
Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and category managers to ensure smooth operations.
Promotions & Activations: Implement promotional campaigns, in-store activations, and other initiatives to boost sales and brand awareness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.
Improvement in product visibility and brand presence in both GT and MT.
Effective distributor and store relationship management.
Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

Description:
Role Purpose
Lead development, industrialization, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production tools, molds, dies, jigs, fixtures, and gauges. Ensure tooling readiness, reliability, quality, productivity, cost competitiveness, and minimum production downtime at the Gagret plant.

Key Responsibilities
Own tooling strategy and execution for NPI, capacity expansion, localization, and continuous improvement.
Lead design, development, trials, validation, and production release of injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and assembly/welding/testing fixtures.
Apply DFM/DFA, GD&T, DFMEA/PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, MSA, and SPC during tooling development and industrialization.
Establish preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance covering tool-life monitoring, refurbishment, calibration, critical spares, and replacement planning.
Reduce defects, breakdowns, changeover time, and tooling-related downtime using RCA, TPM, Lean, and Kaizen.
Coordinate with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Industrial Engineering, Purchase, and Supply Chain for pilot builds, ramp-up, and stable production.
Develop toolmakers and machining/fixture vendors; manage RFQs, technical evaluation, trials, acceptance, cost, delivery, and localization.
Lead tooling engineers, designers, tool-room technicians, and external partners with safety, quality, delivery, and cost accountability.

Candidate Requirements

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, or Tool Engineering. PG Diploma/M.Tech in Tool Design or Manufacturing preferred.
12-18 years in tooling design/development, industrialization, and high-volume plant support.
At least 8 years leading tooling/tool-room teams and cross-functional projects.
Exposure in Injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tooling, jigs, fixtures, gauges, assembly/welding fixtures, and tool validation.
Desirable hands-on responsibility for preventive/predictive maintenance, refurbishment, spares planning, tool-life improvement, and downtime reduction.
Exposure in Battery, inverter/UPS, energy storage, automotive components, electrical/electronics, or comparable high-volume manufacturing.
GD&T, DFM/DFA, PFMEA, APQP/PPAP, MSA/SPC, RCA, Lean, TPM, and vendor development.
Working knowledge of SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, NX, or AutoCAD.

Position- Lab Technician
Location- Shimla

Qualification Required- DMLT, BMLT
Experience- 1- 5 years

Role & responsibilities

To perform assigned analytical testing procedures in an accurate, precise, and timely manner in the assigned lab.
To perform routine and non-routine activities pertaining to laboratory testing and reporting and maintaining external and Internal Quality control.
Maintain required records and documentation.
Follow the laboratory's procedures for specimen handling and processing, test analyses, reporting and maintaining records of patient test result.
Analyze specimens using approved testing procedures as per SOP's, review and release test results.
Adhere to the laboratory's quality control policies, instrument and procedural calibrations and follow safety guidelines as per established organization protocols.

Qualification: DMLT, BMLT

Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a motivated and dynamic Associate Sales Manager for our Branch Banking division. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth by managing a team of sales executives, building strong relationships with clients, and ensuring exceptional customer service. The role includes identifying new business opportunities, promoting insurance products, and achieving sales targets while maintaining compliance with company policies and industry regulations.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage a team of sales executives to achieve sales objectives and targets.
- Develop and implement effective sales strategies to expand the customer base.
- Cultivate and maintain relationships with existing clients to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
- Conduct training and mentoring sessions for team members to enhance their sales skills and product knowledge.
- Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth.
- Prepare reports and presentations on sales performance for upper management.
- Collaborate with other departments to ensure smooth operations and consistency in service delivery.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong leadership and team management skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Sales-oriented mindset with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
- Ability to analyze financial data and market trends.
- Familiarity with insurance products and services.
- Proficient in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications:
- A Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
- Previous experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services industry.
- Relevant certifications in insurance sales would be an added advantage.

Join Axis Max Life Insurance and be a part of a dynamic team that values excellence, innovation, and professional growth.

Job Description: Assistant Manager MIS & Business Analytics (Finance)

Role Objective:
We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented professional to lead MIS reporting, financial data analysis, dashboard development, and business performance tracking. The primary responsibility will be to transform raw financial and operational data into meaningful insights that enable management to make informed business decisions.

Key Responsibilities:
1. MIS Reporting & Management Dashboards
Develop, manage, and enhance daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management.
Design interactive dashboards to track business performance, profitability, revenue, expenses, and other key performance indicators.
Consolidate data from multiple sources and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting.
Develop customised reports and dashboards based on management requirements.
Automate repetitive reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

2. Business Insights & Data Analytics
Analyse large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, patterns, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Develop new reports, analytical models, and performance metrics to provide deeper visibility into business performance.
Identify the reasons behind revenue fluctuations, cost increases, margin changes, and deviations from targets.

3. MIS Automation & Process Improvement
Build advanced Excel-based reports and dashboards using Pivot Tables, Power Query, advanced formulas, and data models.
Develop Power BI dashboards and automated reporting solutions wherever applicable.
Improve data collection, validation, reporting formats, and analytical processes.
Establish standardised KPI definitions and reporting practices across departments.
Ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and reliability of management information.

Job Summary:

The Head Corporate Accounts will lead the corporate accounts function and oversee financial reporting, management information systems (MIS), consolidation of accounts and audit-related activities. The role will be responsible for ensuring accuracy, consistency and timeliness of corporate financial information and strengthening accounting controls and reporting processes.
Key Responsibilities:

Accounting & Financial Reporting

Oversee corporate accounting activities and ensure accurate and timely maintenance of books of accounts across group entities.
Lead the preparation and review of periodic standalone financial statements under Ind AS and IGAAP, as applicable to each entity.
Ensure correct application of Accounting Standards and Ind AS, including revenue recognition (Ind AS 115), inventory, borrowing cost and project-cost accounting relevant to real estate.
Review account reconciliations, schedules and supporting documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy.

MIS & Monthly Closure

Drive monthly book closure within defined timelines, including monthly PAT and cash flow reporting.
Oversee preparation of MIS reports and provide meaningful financial insights to management, including variance analysis against budget.

Consolidation

Manage consolidation of accounts and ensure consistency of accounting policies and accuracy across subsidiaries, SPVs and joint arrangements.
Ensure timely reconciliation and elimination of inter-company transactions and balances.

Audit

Coordinate and oversee internal and statutory audit processes, including audit schedules, documentation and closure of observations.
Act as the primary point of contact for auditors on accounting and reporting matters.

RERA & Statutory Compliance

Oversee quarterly and annual RERA compliances, including CA certificates for withdrawals from designated project accounts and annual compliance reports, in coordination with project and legal teams.
Monitor accounting policies, internal controls and compliance with applicable accounting and statutory requirements.

Controls, Systems & Process Improvement

Ensure effective use of SAP / ERP for accounting, reporting and closure processes.
Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting systems and control mechanisms, including Internal Financial Controls (IFC).
Coordinate with business and finance stakeholders for timely closure of financial reporting requirements.

Team Leadership

Guide, develop and support the accounts team to ensure effective delivery of the function.
Qualifications & Experience:

Chartered Accountant (CA).
Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in financial reporting, MIS, consolidation of accounts and audit.
Experience in managing corporate accounts and coordinating audits.
Real estate or multi-entity business experience would be an advantage.

Key Competencies:

Sound knowledge of Accounting Standards and Ind AS, with hands-on experience in preparing financial statements under both IGAAP and Ind AS.Sound understanding of MIS, consolidation and audit processes.
Leadership, team management and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical ability and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple reporting deliverables and deadlines.

You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.

Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.

Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.

Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).

Management Consulting Senior Manager - Industry & Workflow Advisor / Value Architect
Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

Working knowledge of one priority industry's processes and value drivers; applies it to use-case and roadmap work..

Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
