Role Overview
The Librarian will be responsible for the overall management, development, digitisation, and effective utilisation of the University Library and its learning resources. The role goes beyond the traditional management of books and circulation. The Librarian is expected to develop the library as a student-centric Learning Resource Centre that actively supports teaching, research, skill development, employability, innovation, and lifelong learning. The Librarian will ensure that physical and digital resources are easily accessible, appropriately organised, effectively utilised, and continuously aligned with the academic programmes and evolving requirements of Medhavi Skills University.
Key Responsibilities
A. Library Administration & Operations
Manage the day-to-day functioning of the University Library and associated learning/resource facilities.
Develop and implement library policies, SOPs, circulation procedures, membership norms, and operating guidelines.
Ensure systematic acquisition, accessioning, classification, cataloguing, shelving, circulation, and preservation of library resources.
Maintain accurate records of books, journals, periodicals, newspapers, reports, reference materials, and other resources.
Ensure efficient issue, return, renewal, reservation, and recovery of library materials.
Conduct periodic stock verification and reconciliation of library resources.
Maintain appropriate systems for damaged, lost, obsolete, and withdrawn materials.
Ensure appropriate library timings based on student s and academic requirements, including during examinations and other high-demand periods.
B. Digital Library & Technology
Develop and strengthen the University s digital library ecosystem.
Manage e-books, e-journals, research databases, institutional repositories, online learning resources, and other digital subscriptions.
Ensure effective implementation and utilisation of the Library Management System (LMS/ILMS).
Facilitate remote and campus-based access to digital learning resources wherever applicable.
Promote awareness and usage of digital databases and online academic resources among students and faculty.
Explore emerging technologies, including AI-enabled search, research and knowledge management tools, to enhance library services.
Maintain accurate digital catalogues and ensure easy discoverability of resources.
C. Academic & Student Support
Work closely with Heads of Schools, Programme In-Charges, faculty members, and academic teams to understand programme-specific resource requirements.
Ensure availability of textbooks, reference books, journals, case studies, reports, and digital resources required for different programmes.
Conduct library orientation programmes for newly admitted students.
Train students in effective use of catalogues, databases, e-resources, research platforms, and credible online information sources.
Support students in literature searches, assignments, projects, presentations, research, and academic referencing.
Develop initiatives to improve reading habits and library utilisation among students.
Organise book displays, reading campaigns, author interactions, knowledge sessions, quizzes, book reviews, and other library engagement activities.
D. Faculty & Research Support
Assist faculty and researchers in identifying relevant books, journals, databases, reports, and research materials.
Support literature review, reference management, citation practices, and information retrieval.
Facilitate awareness of research databases, open-access resources, institutional repositories, and scholarly publications.
Support the development and maintenance of an institutional repository for research papers, publications, reports, projects, dissertations, and other academic outputs, as applicable.
Coordinate with academic teams for continuous improvement of programme-wise library resources.
E. Acquisition & Resource Development
Prepare annual and periodic plans for acquisition of books, journals, databases, and other learning resources.
Collect recommendations from faculty, Schools, and academic departments.
Evaluate resource requirements based on curriculum, student strength, programme requirements, usage patterns, and applicable regulatory norms.
Coordinate with publishers, vendors, distributors, and service providers for procurement and subscriptions.
Support comparative evaluation and cost-effective procurement of library resources in accordance with University policies.
Monitor subscriptions and ensure timely renewal of essential databases, journals, magazines, and digital resources
F. Compliance, Accreditation & Documentation
Maintain all library documentation required for statutory, regulatory, accreditation, audit and quality-assurance purposes.
Support the University in documentation and data requirements relating to UGC,

Description:
Job Summary
ATREE is seeking an Analyst to work closely with the Policy Lead to review, analyses, study, conduct consultations, and draft recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States.
You will be a key member of a team led by the Director -The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE to external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
Responsibilities
Support the Policy Lead in delivering the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including timely reporting and tracking of success indicators.
Review rangeland, forest, and agroforestry policies and identify opportunities to strengthen mountain-specific approaches across the three landscapes.
Support development and advocacy of state-level policy action plans on restoration and agroecology (Sikkim), OECM/CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Ladakh).
Support the Policy Lead in mapping key stakeholders in policy-making and comparing existing policies to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific needs across the three landscapes, keeping the analysis current.
Conduct FGDs, expert interviews, and workshops on mountain-specific policies, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and supporting equitable participation of women and marginalized groups.
Identify practices or policies detrimental to climate and ecosystem resilience, and develop case studies of successful mountain-specific models or practices.
Support drafting of policy recommendations and briefing papers, and their presentation to a multi-stakeholder panel for review and feedback, delivered on schedule to support the Policy Lead.
Support the advocacy campaign to raise awareness and capacity strengthening activities, including training government officials, policymakers, community leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Be part of the team compiling a comprehensive report and toolkit documenting the process, findings, recommendations, and outcomes for the IHR, and share it with stakeholders.
Support the team in creating the Legal-Institutional Framework and Modules for OECMs/CCA in Arunachal Pradesh, under the guidance of the Policy Lead and external legal counsel where required.
Support collaboration with ATREE s Academy for Conservation Science and Sustainability Studies and contribute to the project s digital knowledge commons, helping capture and curate policy-relevant data, analysis and case studies.
Write reports and support in contributing to the learning and reporting plan, and in coordinating with landscape, thematic, research, MEL and communications teams.
Represent ATREE in national and international forums and apply a proactive, strategic approach within and outside ATREE to deliver measurable policy impact.
Qualifications
Masters in a related field, i.e., environmental science, social sciences, natural science, ecology, natural resources management, public policy, law, or a related interdisciplinary field.
Experience Required
1 to 2 years of overall experience in policy work, with some experience in the mountains.
Strong networking skills and ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders.
Strong understanding of policy processes in government systems.
Understanding of, and commitment to, Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) and ethical community engagement protocols when working with indigenous and local communities in the IHR.
Sensitivity to gender and social inclusion considerations, with the ability to support equitable participation of women and marginalized groups in FGDs, consultations and workshops.
Excellent written and verbal English skills; knowledge of Hindi and/or a Himalayan regional language is an advantage; where not proficient, willingness to work through local translators/facilitators is required.
Proficient in analytical skills, report writing, and documentation.
Willingness to travel extensively across project locations in the Himalaya.
Skills to organize and communicate across levels of an organization and across geographies.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work closely with team members.
Desirable Skills
Familiarity with data collection, coding, and analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Kobo Toolbox, or similar) for organizing consultation and FGD findings.
Prior exposure to national or regional mountain/biodiversity policy frameworks (e.g., National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem, State Biodiversity Action Plans) gained through coursework, internships, or prior roles.
Comfort with digital documentation and knowledge-management platforms for curating and organizing policy-relevant data and case studies.

Description:
Job Summary
Lead - Policy
ATREE is seeking an experienced professional to lead reviews, analyses, studies, consultations, and recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States. The policy vision will be guided by global, regional, national, and state mountain policies from IHR.
You will be a key member of a versatile team led by the Director - The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE with external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
In the Himalaya, ATREE s strategy is to work towards a future where resilient mountain and downstream societies sustainably enjoy the natural endowment of the Indian Himalayan Region (IHR) while protecting and preserving its rich biodiversity. ATREE has developed a 10-year strategy called The Himalaya Initiative (THI), focused on the IHR amid increasing biodiversity loss, environmental degradation, and climate change.
Project AMP-Himalaya is funded by the Rural India Supporting Trust (RIST), co-financed by Conservation International and Global Conservation, within the THI strategy, for a 5-year project period. The project aims to conserve biodiversity, restore landscapes, and foster human well-being in the Indian Himalayan Region. Three key areas prioritized to achieve the goal in the IHR are: 1) Assessment, Monitoring, and Conservation of Biodiversity; 2) Restoration of Multi-functional Landscapes; and 3) Nature-based Rural Livelihoods and Climate Change Resilience. Integral to these priorities are: creating digital knowledge commons to accelerate participatory management and local stewardship; strengthening human resources through training programs for local youth leaders and expanded environmental education opportunities; and creating conditions to develop and implement multi-level, mountain-specific policies that prioritize biodiversity conservation and natural resource management at scale.
The project is being implemented in 3 distinct landscapes located in 3 states and 1 union territory of IHR, namely: the Khangchendzonga Landscape covering the Darjeeling hills of North Bengal and Sikkim state; the Trans-Himalayan Landscape representing a high dependence on rangelands with agro-pastoral and pastoral systems in Ladakh; and Arunachal Pradesh with the largest, greenest, ethnically diverse and most biodiversity-rich landscapes.
Responsibilities
Develop and lead the roadmap and strategy, in collaboration with the THI Director, for the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including annual workplans, timely donor and project reporting, and tracking policy outcomes and success indicators.
Lead and drive the process of reviewing existing policies related to biodiversity, forests, rangelands, agroforestry, restoration, bioresource use, nature-based livelihoods, and climate resilience, including stakeholder mapping to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific policy approaches across the three project landscapes.
Develop and advocate state-level policy action plans across all three landscapes, restoration and agro-ecology (Sikkim), OECM and CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Trans-Himalaya, Ladakh), ensuring balanced policy engagement across landscapes.
Lead in conducting FGDs, expert interviews, and multi-stakeholder workshops, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and ensuring equitable participation of women and marginalized groups; use findings to flag policies/practices harmful to climate and ecosystem resilience and document successful mountain-specific case studies.
Develop and lead a roadmap for presentation of policy recommendations and briefing papers for key stakeholders for validation, and compile a comprehensive IHR policy report and toolkit for dissemination to stakeholders.
Create and lead the development of Legal-Institutional Framework and Modules for OECM/CCA in Arunachal Pradesh, partnering with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE for specialized legal drafting where required.
Develop and lead policy engagement and advocacy campaigns to raise awareness and strengthen capacity, including training government officials, policymakers, community leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with ATREE s Academy for Conservation Science and Sustainability Studies and the project s digital knowledge commons to align policy work with ongoing research, fellowships and knowledge generation.
Contribute to the learning and reporting plan; provide technical guidance to Policy Analysts and Consultants; coordinate with landscape, thematic, research, MEL and communications teams.
Represent ATREE in national and international forums and apply a proactive, strategic approach within and outside ATREE to deliver measurable policy impact.
Qualifications
PhD in a related field, i.e., social sciences, environmental/natural sciences/natural resources management, public policy, law, economics, or a related interdisciplinary field.
A background in law, public policy, or economics is preferred in addition to the environmental/natural sciences; where specialized legal drafting is required (e.g., the Legal-Institutional Framework for OECMs/CCA), this will be carried out in partnership with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE.
Experience Required
5-6 years of professional experience in policy development and analysis, with substantial experience in mountain policy frameworks and a strong focus on the Himalaya.
Strong networking skills and demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders.
Strong understanding of policy processes in government systems.
Demonstrated understanding of, and commitment to, Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) and ethical community engagement protocols when working with indigenous and local communities in the IHR.
Sensitivity to gender and social inclusion considerations, with the ability to help ensure equitable participation of women and marginalized groups in FGDs, consultations and workshops.
Excellent written and verbal English skills; knowledge of Hindi and/or a Himalayan regional language is an advantage; where not proficient, willingness to work through local translators/facilitators is required.
Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated ability to coordinate teams, motivate colleagues and engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Proficient in analytical skills, report writing, and documentation.
Willingness to travel extensively across project locations in the Himalaya.
Experience working with nonprofits in the Conservation / Environment / Sustainability / Biodiversity space highly desirable.
Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating across teams and geographies to deliver on a set of goals.
Strong organizational, interpersonal and leadership skills with the ability to motivate and lead small teams.
Desirable Skills
Working knowledge of international and regional mountain and biodiversity frameworks, including the CBD Global Biodiversity Framework, ICIMOD/Hindu Kush Himalaya frameworks, and UNFCCC/NDC processes.
Experience in grant management, resource mobilization, proposal writing, and donor engagement.
Experience using digital knowledge and communication tools, including data visualization and dashboards, to translate technical findings into accessible briefs and toolkits.

Description:
Sikkim Skill University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing. Key Responsibilities : Property Maintenance : Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks. Ensure the property is clean, well - maintained, and aesthetically pleasing. Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities. Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly. Financial Management : Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance. Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records. Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost - effective services. Security and Safety : Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants. Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary. Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures. Tenant and Guest Relations : Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner. Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively. Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction. Staff Management : Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff. Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Administrative Tasks : Maintain accurate records of property - related activities, contracts, and expenses. Prepare regular reports for property owners or management. Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management. Compliance and Regulations : Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes. Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management. Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation. Project Management : Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property. Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. Qualifications : Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable. Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles. Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast - paced environment. Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Role Overview:
Medhavi Skills University is seeking a dynamic Senior Manager Placements to lead the university s corporate engagement and student placement strategy at the Sikkim campus. This leadership role will be responsible for building strong industry partnerships, managing the placement team, and ensuring high-quality placement opportunities for students through strategic recruiter engagement. He will be responsible for getting all eligible
students placed.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage the Campus Placement & Corporate Relations team to achieve placement goals.
Define KPIs, performance targets and accountability structures for the placement team.
Monitor team performance through regular reviews and ensure timely achievement of placement milestones.
Mentor team members and strengthen internal systems for effective placement management.
2. Industry Partnerships & Corporate Outreach for Placements
Develop and expand long-term partnerships with corporates, recruiters and industry bodies across sectors.
Identify and establish new recruitment partnerships for internships and final placements by frequent visits to Companies, Organizations PAN India.
Actively engage with industry leaders to position the university as a preferred talent sourcing partner.
Maintain strong relationships with existing recruiters to ensure recurring hiring engagements.
3. Placement Strategy & Performance Monitoring
Develop and implement the annual placement strategy for the campus.
Monitor placement progress across programs and ensure achievement of placement targets and quality benchmarks.
Establish systems for data-driven monitoring of placement performance, including placement dashboards and reports.
Provide periodic insights and updates to university leadership on placement outcomes.
4. Stakeholder Management
Work closely with academic leadership and faculty to align student skills with industry requirements.
Coordinate with internal teams to strengthen student employability and career readiness initiatives.
Ensure effective communication between students, recruiters, faculty, and the placement team.
5. Employer Branding & Institutional Representation
Represent the university in corporate meetings, industry forums, and networking platforms.
Promote the university s talent pool to attract high-quality recruiters and hiring partners.
Strengthen the university s reputation as an industry-aligned institution with strong placement outcomes.
Qualifications & Skills Required:
Master s degree in Management, HR or related field.
8-12 years of experience in placements, corporate relations or industry partnerships.
Mandatory: Prior experience managing placements in universities or higher education institutions at least 3-5 years.
Proven experience in building corporate partnerships and managing recruitment engagements.
Candidates should be proficient in: Corporate relationship management
Team leadership and performance monitoring
Strategic planning and execution
Stakeholder management
Strong networking and negotiation skills
Data-driven monitoring and reporting

What We Offer
Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.
Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
A collaborative, mission-driven environment.
The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

Description:
AWS Full Stack Developer Manager (Job Description)
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced AWS Full Stack Developer to lead full-stack application development on AWS, driving architecture decisions, CI/CD automation, and team delivery across frontend and backend workloads.
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in full-stack application development on AWS, with proven ability to lead development teams, drive architectural decisions across frontend (React/Angular with Amplify) and backend (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB/RDS) layers, and establish CI/CD standards.
Key Responsibilities
Lead full-stack application development using React/Angular (with Amplify and Next.js/Nuxt), Java/Python/Node.js, and AWS serverless services.
Architect end-to-end solutions including frontend (CloudFront CDN distribution), backend (Lambda, Lambda MicroVMs, Lambda Managed Instances), API (API Gateway, AppSync for GraphQL), and database layers (DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache).
Design scalable REST and GraphQL API architectures using API Gateway and AppSync with advanced patterns (caching, WebSocket, request/response transformations).
Lead database design and optimization for DynamoDB (single-table design, GSI/LSI) and RDS/Aurora workloads.
Establish CI/CD pipeline standards using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and Amplify Hosting with managed CI/CD.
Implement AWS security best practices including Cognito, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, WAF, and Shield.
Develop IaC using Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
Lead and mentor development teams on modern frameworks, TypeScript full-stack patterns, and AWS best practices.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, QA, and business teams for delivery excellence.
Use CloudWatch, X-Ray, CloudTrail, and CloudWatch Logs Insights for observability and performance optimization.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of experience in software engineering.
5+ years of hands-on AWS experience.
Deep proficiency in frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Next.js) and backend technologies (Java, Python, Node.js/TypeScript).
Extensive experience designing REST and GraphQL APIs with API Gateway, AppSync, and serverless patterns.
Hands-on experience with AWS services including Lambda (Functions, MicroVMs), S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, API Gateway, CloudFront, Cognito, IAM.
Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines at scale using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and Amplify.
Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK).
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS, Fargate).
Strong understanding of application security (Cognito, IAM, KMS, WAF) and cloud governance.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Knowledge of Agile Methodology and Practices.
Prior experience with microservices architecture and event-driven design.
Nice to Have
AWS Professional or Associate certifications.
Experience with AI tools in development lifecycles (GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, Amazon Q Developer) and brought in efficiencies.
DevOps experience (CI/CD pipelines using CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
Experience with AWS migration tools (DMS, SCT, Migration Hub, AWS Transform).
Experience with GraphQL at scale using AppSync.Role & responsibilities

Job Description
Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.
The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects-ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Civil BIM Designer with 5 to 15 years of Substation experience with Revit to join our Bangalore office. This role involves working on single and multi-disciplinary Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), focusing on delivering high-quality BIM and CAD outputs that meet international standards. The role spans Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewables, Infrastructure, and Nuclear domains.

Your Role
Lead drawing and modelling production as a BIM coordinator for Electrical/Civil systems.
Prepare SLDs, control schemes, layouts, 3D models, and hazardous area classifications.
Develop substation layouts and infrastructure drawings including power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.

About You
Multidisciplinary exposure across Electrical, Civil, Structural, and Mechanical domains.
Proven leadership skills and the ability to mentor junior staff and manage teams effectively.
A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
Hands-on experience in Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), including project setup in Revit, layout preparation, support structure modelling, concrete structures reinforcement detailing, power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Familiarity with National Grid standards is a significant advantage.
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo, and other BIM-related tools.
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC) and experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Technical Competencies
Essential
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo.
Strong understanding of CAD/BIM standards and drawing protocols.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings.
Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
Experience with EDMS and drawing control protocols.
Capable of implementing GDC BMS QSE procedures.
Knowledge of project programming and resource utilization.
Desirable
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
Experience with 3D modelling and BIM standards.
Familiarity with BEP and Xrefs.
Behavioural Competencies
Strong communication and report-writing skills.
Team-oriented with leadership potential.
Detail-oriented and quality-focused.
Capable of giving and receiving clear instructions.
Proactive in career development and team contribution.
Assertive and responsive to client requirements.
Able to manage and motivate teams effectively.

Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Job Description
Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization.
The Protection Control (PC) Design team plays a critical role in ensuring the safe operation, monitoring, automation, and protection of power system assets. The team develops engineering designs for 11kV,33kV,132kV,275Kv and 400kV substations, including protection schemes, control systems. Opportunities include working on complex international projects, developing detailed engineering deliverables, supporting multidisciplinary coordination, and driving design excellence through digital engineering tools and industry best practices. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about substation protection and control engineering, electrical system reliability, digital transformation, and delivering innovative solutions for the evolving energy sector.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with 5-10 years of substation design experience and strong proficiency in AutoCAD to join our Bangalore office. This role involves supporting the delivery of Protection Control engineering and CAD deliverables for 132 kV to 400 kV AIS and GIS substations, covering both greenfield and brownfield projects across domestic and international markets.
The successful candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality PC design outputs, including protection schematics, control and relay panel drawings, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams, AC/DC schematics, cable schedules, and Substation documentation. Working closely with Protection Engineers and multidisciplinary project teams, the role requires ensuring compliance with international standards, client specifications, and project quality requirements.
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to complex projects across Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewable Energy and nuclear sectors, while supporting the digital transformation of substations through modern engineering practices and innovative design solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical understanding of substation protection and control systems, excellent drafting skills, and a commitment to delivering engineering excellence.


Your role
Key Responsibilities
Prepare Protection Control (PC) deliverables for 132 kV to 400 kV AIS/GIS substations
Develop SLDs, KLDs, AC/DC schematics, LVAC/LVDC diagrams, tripping schemes, relay wiring diagrams, panel layouts and cable schedules.
Prepare interface/interconnection diagrams, terminal block drawings, SCADA/SCS drawings, communication drawings and As-Built documentation.
Develop transformer, feeder and busbar protection drawings in accordance with project requirements.
Develop Control Protection Bay Control Drawings, Relay Panel Drawings, DC Distribution Schemes, AC Auxiliary Schemes, RTU/SCADA Drawings, SCS Drawings, LAN/Fiber Network Drawings, Cable Routing Termination Drawings, As-Built Documentation.
Develop and maintain engineering drawings using AutoCAD and other approved CAD tools in accordance with project and client standards.
Coordinate with Protection, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to support project delivery.
Support design reviews, drawing updates, revisions, and preparation of As-Built documentation.
Perform self-checks and quality reviews to ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of engineering documentation.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are seeking an experienced Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with:
Proven experience in 132kV to 400kV AIS/GIS Substation Protection Control design for both Greenfield and Brownfield projects.
Strong knowledge of protection schemes, control systems, SCADA, SAS, and IEC 61850-based substations.
Proficiency in AutoCAD and Raster Design; exposure to MicroStation, Revit, or other engineering design tools is advantageous and experience in preparing protection schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, interconnection diagrams, and cable schedules.
Good understanding of IEC, IEEE, utility, and client-specific standards related to substation design.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Protection Engineers, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary project teams.
Experience in preparing, checking, and reviewing PC drawings while ensuring quality, accuracy, and compliance with project requirements.

Familiarity with National Grid (UK) standards is a significant advantage.

We are hiring for a leading MNC for the position of Data Privacy & Compliance Consultant.
Job Details

Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Job Description
Overview
The project management opportunities we have are varied in size and responsibility levels, from delivering our consultancy services, to working for the client organisation delivering their projects and programmes.
You'll have exceptional stakeholder communication and people management skills and thrive on working within a dynamic and diverse project delivery environment.
Your Role
Working within our Nuclear business sector in our Bangalore or Gurgaon office, you will lead the delivery of AtkinsRealis technical design and engineering projects or work directly for our key clients.
You must be able to appreciate complex practical, technical, and commercial issues and to work constructively with a broad range of stakeholders; leading project teams that are either local to you or distributed across multiple sites.
The opportunities we have are varied in size and nature, and particularly suit an agile project management style, where the work is particularly discovery in nature. To help us grow the future of our business we are particularly keen to speak to individuals who are building a career as a professional project manager, who are delivery focused, and enjoy being customer focused.
Other aspects of the role will include supporting the growth of our capabilities through building a reputation for excellence, mentoring others, supporting business development and bidding activities.
About You
You'll have excellent communication, listening, stakeholder management and influencing skills. You'll be able to manage client relationships, engage constructively with multiple stakeholders and lead delivery teams. Through your work you will also help support and shape the development of future business.
You'll enjoy turning your hand to new challenges and will be keen to learn, whilst also wanting to support others within our diverse multi-disciplinary teams. You must also be able to successfully manage the commercial and quality performance of projects and proactively deploy a range of techniques to control delivery, cost, manage risk and change.
Your experience in working collaboratively with teams spread across multiple geographical locations.
Engineering professional with 20 or more years of experience
Direct and demonstrable experience of successfully managing one or more of the following types of projects to agreed time, cost and quality requirements:
Consultancy services supplying engineering advice, or
Engineering design
Must be an Engineering Professional
Experience of leading and directing teams and resources. Able to motivate self and teams, deal with conflict and create a collaborative team culture to meet client requirements
A strong element of client relationship management and people leadership. Excellent communication skills.
Willingness to travel as necessary.
Willing to work flexibly with occasional out of hours work to accommodate project and client requirements.
Nuclear industry experience. Applications from candidates from other high hazard, or highly regulated industries such as process, Oil and Gas, Defense, and Aerospace would be welcomed.
Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis
We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Job Description


Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.
The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects-ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical BIM Designer with 8 to 15 years of Substation experience with Revit to join our Bangalore office. This role involves working on single and multi-disciplinary Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), focusing on delivering high-quality BIM and CAD outputs that meet international standards. The role spans Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewables, Infrastructure, and Nuclear domains.


Your role
Key Responsibilities
Lead drawing and modelling production as a BIM coordinator for Electrical/Civil systems.
Prepare SLDs, control schemes, layouts, 3D models, and hazardous area classifications.
Develop substation layouts and infrastructure drawings including power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are seeking a highly experienced CAD/BIM professional with:
Multidisciplinary exposure across Electrical, Civil, Structural, and Mechanical domains.
Proven leadership skills and the ability to mentor junior staff and manage teams effectively.
A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
Hands-on experience in Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), including project setup in Revit, layout preparation, support structure modelling, concrete structures reinforcement detailing, power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Familiarity with National Grid standards is a significant advantage.
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo, and other BIM-related tools.
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC) and experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.


About you
Technical Competencies
Essential
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo.
Strong understanding of CAD/BIM standards and drawing protocols.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings.
Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
Experience with EDMS and drawing control protocols.
Capable of implementing GDC BMS QSE procedures.
Knowledge of project programming and resource utilization.
Desirable
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
Experience with 3D modelling and BIM standards.
Familiarity with BEP and Xrefs.
Behavioural Competencies
Strong communication and report-writing skills.
Team-oriented with leadership potential.
Detail-oriented and quality-focused.
Capable of giving and receiving clear instructions.
Proactive in career development and team contribution.
Assertive and responsive to client requirements.
Able to manage and motivate teams effectively.


Rewards benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage
Medical insurance for you and your dependents
Annual leave balance in accordance with local labour law
Flexible and hybrid work solutions
Opportunity for local and global internal transfers
Company gratuity scheme
Discretionary bonus program
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Work in a team performing analytical procedures on accounting and financial data to support transaction value assessments, and visualising insights using Excel and AI tools (training will be provided on these tools); Interpret and critically review transaction legal documentation and evaluate completion accounts and locked box mechanisms, identifying areas of value leakage or risk; Identify areas which may warrant further investigation / give rise to potential adjustments to price; Proactively work with team leaders and team members to manage a workload of multiple projects with competing priorities based on relative importance and urgency; Communicating confidently with engagement teams to understand scope and expectations, and present project deliverables once they have been completed; Supporting engagement setup from initiation through to completion, understanding workflow management tools, relevant application of AI tools, and ensuring accurate documentation of work performed; Participate in a wide range of projects and collaborate across multiple workstreams or teams; consistently demonstrating creative thinking, individual initiative and timely completion of assigned work; and Consistently demonstrate teamwork dynamics by working as a team member: understand personal and team roles; contribute to a positive working environment by building solid relationships with team members; and proactively seek guidance, clarification and feedback.

Overview
The Technical Manager role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and leading and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.
Your Role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes.
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures.
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.

Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.
Hands-on experience of industry standard Rail BIM Platforms such as OpenBuildings Designer, MicroStation Connect (3D).
Proven experience of a range of CAD and BIM industry standards including an understanding of UK BIM Level 2 requirements.
Understanding of BIM Standards such as BS1192 and PAS1192 Part 2 is also desirable.
I-Twin or Bentley Cloud Services with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models.
Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models.

Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues.
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards

Job Description


Overview
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) Transporation Business is looking to appoint a number of Technical Manager s to support the delivery of complex civil engineering and multidisciplinary designs across a range of major projects.Drawing upon a diverse skill set and a proven track record of delivery, AtkinsRalis GTC's Transporation business is playing an integral role in some of the most challenging and exciting engineering projects in the Transportation realm. We pride ourselves in offering a truly multi-disciplinary capability and bring exciting opportunities to influence major projects from beginning to end. Our vision is to be the world's best Infrastructure Consultancy by leveraging BIM and embracing the digital future to bring about transformational benefits for the Transportation Engineering industry.This key post will be based out of Bangalore/ Gurgaon where we have thriving AtkinsRalis office, which deliver to all AtkinsRalis regions across the world. Our portfolio of work continues to grow, and we will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience, and problem-solving skills.


Your Role
Responsibilities
Leading the team and Produce AutoCAD and MicroStation 2D drawings and other deliverables.
Actively contribute to project design development by contributing to internal coordination.
Produce all types of Highways discipline 2D Drawings and other deliverables.
Perform self-assurance of all Highways discipline drawing and model deliverables.
Provide quality control for compliance to company/project standards of deliverables.
Maintain a high level of competency of all BIM software tools used at AtkinsRalis


About You
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 15 to 20 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
Must be an advanced user or expert user in Autodesk AutoCAD, Civil3D, and Bentley MicroStation with a minimum of 10 to 15 years.AutoCAD experience must, detailed understanding of the CAD user interface and all its features to perform.
MicroStation experience must, detailed understanding of the MicroStation user interface and all its features to perform.
Technical proficiency in the use of the latest common CDE systems: Bentley ProjectWise and Autodesk Vault.
Must be well versed in best practices for use of Autodesk AutoCAD, and Bentley MicroStation and other industry standard BIM platforms.
Track record in BIM design and coordination including multidisciplinary projects and ideally demonstrable experience within a Civil Engineering Design environment particularly the Highways domain.Technical awareness/knowledge of engineering design issues including awareness of health and safety risks.
Qualifications and Attributes
Excellent time management skills.Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 15 to 20 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivationAbility to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues.
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment.
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customersHighly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.


Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.


About AtkinsRalis
We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Description:
Job Summary
Location: Bengaluru
Team: Splash
Reports to: Software Engineering Manager, Splash
Splash is Cvent's event marketing platform. We are standing up a new engineering team in Bengaluru with a single charter: build the AI-powered features that will define the next generation of Splash. The team works as a peer to the established Splash engineering and product teams in Bangalore, North America, and Spain, who own adjacent parts of the platform and with whom we plan, design, and ship. This is an AI-first team in two senses: we ship AI into the product, and we build software with AI - agentic coding tools, spec-driven development, and disciplined review of AI-generated output are the default way of working here, not an experiment.
Responsibilities
Lead delivery of AI features for Splash
Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of full-stack AI features - from problem framing with Product and Design through architecture, implementation, evaluation, release, and operation - for a product area owned by the team.
Drive architectural decisions across the team's Java and Spring Boot microservices, event-driven integrations on AWS, GraphQL APIs, and React and Next.js front ends, so that they form a cohesive, maintainable platform for AI features.
Design the AI components of features - retrieval, agent and tool-use patterns, structured generation, prompt and model lifecycle - with explicit attention to evaluation, cost, latency, and failure modes.
Break ambiguous requirements into clear, sequenced engineering plans; coordinate dependencies with Splash teams in other regions; and communicate progress and trade-offs to stakeholders honestly.
Set the engineering bar
Be a quality gate for the team: review designs, AI-generated code, tests, and evaluations for correctness, security, scalability, and maintainability, and teach the Senior Engineers to do the same.
Own non-functional requirements - security, scalability, resiliency, accessibility, performance - and responsible-AI expectations for what the team ships.
Lead incident response and post-incident learning for the teams services, and drive the improvements that come out of it.
Lead the AI-native way of working
Together with the Engineering Manager, define how the team works with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development: what a good spec looks like, when to delegate to an agent, and what must be verified by a human.
Model that way of working in your own code and reviews, keep the teams tooling and practices current as the AI development landscape changes, and share what works with the wider Splash organisation.
Grow people
Mentor and technically guide engineers on the team through pairing, design reviews, and direct, timely feedback, elevating code quality and design thinking.
Contribute to hiring: interview candidates, help calibrate the bar, and help new engineers become productive quickly.
Here's What You Need
Primary Skills:
8+ years of professional software development experience, including leading the design and delivery of significant features or systems with other engineers.
Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot for distributed microservices, and strong experience with React or Next.js with TypeScript - you are credible and hands-on across the full stack.
Experience designing and operating event-driven microservices on AWS (e.g. ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, RDS or DynamoDB) and with GraphQL and REST API design.
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including schema design and performance tuning.
Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development - you use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot agents in your own work: writing specs an agent can execute, reviewing and correcting its output, and knowing where these tools fail. This must be lived experience, not familiarity with the concepts.
Experience taking AI-driven functionality to production and owning its quality - LLM-powered features such as retrieval, agents, or structured generation - including evaluation, prompt and model lifecycle, cost, latency, and failure modes.

Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.

Assess new Databricks capabilities (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Serverless, Photon, Mosaic AI, Databricks SQL) and lead their adoption.
Drive platform cost optimization (FinOps), workspace strategy, and capacity planning.
Act as the primary technical liaison with Databricks and cloud vendor partners.

Standardize Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code practices across environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
Integrate DABs with DevOps tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Terraform.
Build reusable bundle templates, deployment patterns, and automated testing and validation pipelines.
Ensure version control, environment promotion, and release governance across all Databricks workloads.
3. Governance Implementation
Lead the design and rollout of data governance using Unity Catalog, covering access controls, data lineage, auditing, and data discovery.
Implement data security, privacy, and compliance controls (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA, as applicable).
Define data quality frameworks, metadata management standards, and data ownership and stewardship models.
Work with InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance teams to enforce policies such as row/column-level security, data masking, and fine-grained permissions.
Set up monitoring, observability, and audit mechanisms across the data platform.

Design scalable data models that support analytics, BI, ML/AI, and real-time use cases.
Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and on-prem platforms to the Databricks Lakehouse.
Ensure performance tuning, storage optimization (Z-Ordering, Liquid Clustering, partitioning), and high availability.
Enable data sharing through Delta Sharing and support data mesh and data product approaches where relevant.

Define networking, identity, and security architecture, including VNet/VPC injection, Private Link, and SSO/SCIM.
Drive disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region strategies.

Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF).

Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, testing standards, modular design, and documentation.
Enable real-time and near-real-time data processing for critical business use cases.

Build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Drive hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Mandatory Skills
1. Advanced Prompt Engineering.
Experience with structured outputs (JSON mode, function/tool calling) and system prompt design.
Ability to systematically test, version, and optimize prompts for quality and token efficiency.
Knowledge of prompt injection risks and mitigation techniques.
2. LLM Architecture Design
Strong understanding of transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, tokenization, and context windows.
Ability to design scalable LLM system architectures, including agents, memory, tool use, and orchestration layers.
Experience making trade-off decisions on model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.
3. RAG System Implementation
Hands-on experience building production RAG systems end-to-end.
Proficiency with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, Milvus, Qdrant, or pgvector.
Knowledge of embedding models, chunking strategies, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), re-ranking, and query transformation.
Experience evaluating RAG pipelines using tools like RAGAS, TruLens, or custom metrics.
4. Fine-tuning Strategy
Ability to determine when fine-tuning is the right approach compared with prompting or RAG.
Hands-on experience with PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, and alignment methods (RLHF, DPO).
Experience with dataset curation, cleaning, and preparation for fine-tuning.
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Axolotl, or Unsloth.
5. LangChain / LlamaIndex (Advanced)
Deep, hands-on experience building complex chains, agents, and multi-step workflows.
Proficiency with LangGraph, LCEL, custom tools, retrievers, memory modules, and callbacks.
Experience with LlamaIndex indexing strategies, query engines, and data connectors.
Ability to extend frameworks with custom components when needed.
6. Multi-model Integration
Experience integrating and orchestrating multiple LLM providers and open-source models.
Ability to implement model routing, fallback mechanisms, load balancing, and cost optimization.
Exposure to multimodal models (text, image, audio, vision-language).
Familiarity with gateways and abstraction tools such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or similar.
7. Production Deployment

Core Finance Change Delivery
Key Responsibilities
Avaloq - Monthly Goca Maintenance
Support the maintenance and updates of the Chart of Accounts of the Private Bank entities using the Avaloq Core Banking System - Swiss, Luxembourg, Guernsey, UK, Hong Kong, Singapore - by ensuring this is following the Groups FTP Chart of Account
Analyse demands regarding Grca, FTP and Goca changes, and provide clear guidance and conclusion in the usage of these figures for each Private Bank entities using the Avaloq Core Banking System.
Avaloq Changes
Support in designing solutions and in implementing each demand (Jira's), by analysing the technical requirements, by liaising with concerned stakeholders (Finance and IT), and by performing needed tests in the change workflow (DEV, SIT, UAT) into Avaloq.
Avaloq Implementations
Perform all testing regarding latest implementation of Avaloq, as per accounting perspective
=>Testing Balancing Rules lifecycle for each Product
=>Testing Booking rules lifecycle for each Product - analysing the usage of the Bookind in Avaloq

Data Controls
Organize and perform controls on important amount of data, highlight the inconsistencies that might appear, understand the reasons of these, and liaise with concerned stakeholders to implement needed changes.

Product Owner Administration
Follow up on Product Owner subjects (jiras).

Customers / Stakeholders
Build strong relationships within GPB Finance teams, and IT teams
Be accountable to present clear solutions within changes and implementation for new requirements

Leadership & Teamwork
Collaborative behaviours, actively share ideas / approaches with the rest of the GPB Finance teams
Utilise fully the onshore / offshore operating model

Operational Effectiveness & Control
Ensure all work is completed in accordance with appropriate Group Standard and practices
Provide assurance that any process risks identified are highlighted and managed as appropriate
Support all regulatory and compliance matters and the management of operational risk

Major Challenges
Be able to cover a wide range of financial matters and products from accounting perspective
Partner with the Finance teams to achieve a strong and accurate maintenance of the Avaloq Chart of Account

Management of Risk
Ensure all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring
Addressing any areas of concern in conjunction with line management and/or the appropriate department

Observation of Internal Controls
Maintains internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
Understands, follows and demonstrates compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved, specifically Internal Controls and any Compliance policy including, inter alia, the Group Compliance policy

Requirements
Knowledge of IFRSs and awareness of banking/finance concepts
Strong working knowledge in MS Office tools
Being able to handle simple source systems with no guidance and complex source systems with limited guidance
Proven evidence of strong communication skills used to successfully lead, coordinate and conclude business discussion sessions
Ability to initiate and drive discussions with key stakeholders to effective conclusion
Capable of organizing and managing day to day activities/initiatives for self & team independently
Good team player with proven ability of working with colleagues within & outside of own functional area/team
Ability to multi-task on activities within & outside of the immediate functional area/team
Demonstrate capability to learn and improve self & team's performance on an on-going basis
Proven team working and change management skills
Mind set of continuous improvement and aiming for excellence
Consistently demonstrate integrity, fairness and professional conduct

What additional skills will be good to have?
Knowledge of FTP Chart of Account, GRCA and FTP Global mappings

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Associate

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:12 - Associate

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.
