About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
-Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
-Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
-Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
-Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
-Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
-80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
-0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
-Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
-Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
-Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
-Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Description:
Job Purpose
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan - Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.
Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities - Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications:
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Advt. Ref. No. NABCONS/CO-HR/25/PBCS/2026-27 Dated: 13 November, 2026
Requires Experienced Junior Technical Supervisors /Engineers (Civil) for Head Office and Regional Offices/Training Establishments for Ground-level Monitoring for Premises related Projects of National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development

Location: Itanagar,Pune,Chennai,Dehradun,Mumbai

Primary Duties and Key Responsibilities:
i. Implementation, monitoring, co-ordination and supervision of civil construction/renovation/redevelopment works of building related infrastructural system and other related jobs in office buildings and residential colonies of Bank.
ii. Identification of civil/interior repair/ maintenance works required in the office buildings/residential colonies and preparation of concept, detailed estimates, preparation of tenders/quotation document, preparation of financial estimate/BOQ as per Bank's approved/market rates for these works to receive necessary approval.
iii. Ground level monitoring and supervision of repair and maintenance work of office buildings. NABARD has its office buildings in all state capitals of the country, either owned or rented.
iv. Ground level monitoring and supervision of repair and maintenance works ongoing in staff quarters to ensure the quality standards and timely completion of works. They will have responsibility to undertake regular maintenance, repair and renovation of staff quarters located in various cities of the country, as per Bank's guidelines.
v. Repair and maintenance of Visiting Officers flats (VoFs), Single Room Accommodations (SRAs) located at various premises all over the country, as per Banks guidelines.
vi. Supervision and monitoring of Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) works such as housekeeping, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, pest control, gardening, VOF management, deadstock maintenance etc.
vii. Taking measurements of completed works related to construction/ renovation/redevelopment/repair/maintenance and ensuring the proper completion of works.
viii. Certification of bills as per onsite measurement and recommendations for payment by competent authority.
ix. Conducting visual structural audit and implementation of recommendations of detailed audit done by expert, in NABARD official and residential buildings.
x. Regular liaison with engineers and officers of state or municipal bodies for local level approvals regarding maintenance, repair, renovation or property related matters.
xi. Verification of dead stock articles provided in office and colonies to ensure that these are in good working condition. To recommend for repair, replacement etc. in case of non-functional items.xii. Ensuring quality, timely completion and compliance in all the works.
Educational Qualification:
Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institute or University with minimum60% marks
Required Experience:
Minimum 03 years experience of working in residential/ office buildings/ commercial buildings projects (maintenance/construction)
Other skills and competencies:
Good knowledge of MS office, Google tools, including advanced Excel features for day-to-day operations. Experience in Zoho projects or any other project management software shall be preferred. Knowledge of relevant Engineering Software will be preferred.Excellent written & oral communication and presentation skills in English and local languageThe ability to coordinate and prepare technical and financial proposals in response to EOIs and bids will be preferred.
Age: Maximum Age as on date of application: 35 Years
Contract Period
The Junior Technical Supervisors (PBCS) would be hired on contract for a period of 11 months with further periodic extensions based on the performance and NABARD discretion.
Termination
NABCONS may terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason thereof. However, in normal course, NABCONS may terminate the engagement by giving one (01) month notice in advance within the contract period.
How to Apply
Interested candidates may apply online in the prescribed format within 07 days from 13 November 2026 to 19 November 2026 by clicking links and filling the details therein:
Link to apply: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/gkPpaeWiCa
Instructions
Before applying, candidates should read all the instructions carefully and ensure that they fulfil all the eligibility criteria for the post. NABCONS would admit candidates on the basis of the information furnished in the ON-LINE application and shall verify their eligibility at the stage of interview/ joining. If, at any stage it is found that any information furnished in the ON-LINE application is false/incorrect or if according to the NABCONS, the candidate does not satisfy the eligibility criteria for the post, his/her candidature will be cancelled and he/she will not be allowed to appear for the interview/joining not allowed to continue, if joined.
Candidates are requested to apply only ON-ONLINE through NABCONS website (www.nabcons.com). No other mode of submission of application will be accepted.
Important Dates/ Timelines
Last date for submission of online applications: 19 November 2026 (Midnight)
NABCONS reserves the right to make change in the dates indicated above.

We are urgently hiring a Consultant Gynecologist for a hospital in Roing, Arunachal Pradesh, to support its women's healthcare services. The role involves evaluating gynecological and obstetric patients, managing related conditions, and providing suitable treatment in coordination with the hospital's clinical team.
Designation
Consultant Gynecologist
Location

Employment type
Full-Time

0 8 Years

Open

Conduct gynecology and obstetrics OPD consultations and oversee inpatient treatment.
Provide antenatal, intrapartum, and postnatal care, including management of normal and high-risk pregnancies.

Guide patients on family planning, nutrition, preventive care, and reproductive health.
Position Overview
We are recruiting a Consultant Gynecologist for a hospital in Roing, Arunachal Pradesh.
The role includes gynecology and obstetric consultations, inpatient management, and surgical procedures.
The selected doctor will coordinate with other departments for appropriate referrals and integrated treatment.
Both freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.
This position offers an opportunity to contribute to women's healthcare services within an established hospital setup.

B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institution.
Proficiency in computer-aided design tools, project management software (MS Project/Primavera), and technical documentation.
Experience Overview
Minimum 8 years of total post-qualification experience in execution, site supervision, and quality control of major infrastructure projects, with a strong preference for Hydro Electric Projects (HEP), Tunneling/Underground works, or Dam/Powerhouse construction.
Key Responsibilities
Site Execution & Supervision: Act as the primary on-site engineering representative to oversee daily civil construction activities, including surface/underground excavation, slope stabilization, tunneling, concreting, and structural works.
Quality Assurance & Control (QA/QC): Ensure all construction materials (cement, steel, aggregates) and workmanship rigorously comply with national standards, project technical specifications, and design drawings.
Progress Monitoring: Track daily site progress against baseline construction schedules, report bottlenecks, and assist senior management in developing recovery plans for delayed activities.
Technical Compliance & Drawings: Review construction drawings, method statements, bar-bending schedules, and technical submittals at the site level, flagging discrepancies proactively.
Contract Administration Support: Maintain meticulous daily site records, measurement books (MB), joint measurements, and documentation required for tracking variations and contractor billing.
Safety & Health Compliance: Strictly enforce site safety rules, health guidelines, and environmental protocols, working closely with the HSE team, particularly given the challenging Himalayan terrain of Arunachal Pradesh.
Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate smoothly with contractors, testing laboratories, and multidisciplinary project teams to resolve technical issues swiftly on-site.

Description:
PROJECT MANAGER - PM Ekta Mall, Aizawl (EPC Project)

Company: Mayasheel Ventures Limited
Location: Aizawl, Mizoram (site-based)
Industry: Construction / EPC - Commercial Retail

About the Project:
Mayasheel Ventures Limited is the EPC contractor for PM Ekta Mall, Aizawl, a commercial mall project being executed for HITES (HLL Infra Tech Services, a subsidiary of HLL Lifecare Limited). The project covers full civil and MEP execution - including electrical, HVAC, fire protection, plumbing, lifts and allied services - delivered under detailed technical specifications, approved-makes and a consultant/client approval regime.

Role and Responsibilities:
- Lead overall site execution of the project: plan, coordinate and monitor civil and MEP works to meet project schedule, quality standards and contract specifications.
- Act as the primary point of contact with the client (HITES) and consultants: obtain approvals on shop drawings, materials/makes, deviations, and technical submissions in line with the contract's approved-makes and specification regime.
- Manage procurement and vendor coordination: float enquiries against BOQ, evaluate vendor quotations, follow up on material deliveries, and ensure ordered items match approved makes and specifications.
- Maintain drawing and BOQ discipline on site: work from the latest approved drawings and BOQs, flag mismatches between drawings, BOQ quantities and site conditions, and escalate variations for client approval before execution.
- Review and certify contractor/sub-contractor running bills and measurements; maintain documentation for billing, approvals and correspondence.
- Manage and mentor the site team (engineers, supervisors, surveyor/billing staff); allocate work, review daily progress and resolve site-level technical issues.
- Track project schedule, prepare progress reports, and coordinate sequencing between civil, electrical, HVAC, firefighting and other services to avoid rework.
- Ensure quality checks and safety practices on site in accordance with contract specifications and statutory requirements.
- Handle site logistics and planning in the Aizawl context, including material movement on hill roads, monsoon-impacted scheduling and remote-site resource planning.

Preferred Candidate Profile:
- B.E./B.Tech in Civil or Electrical/Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institute.
- 10+ years of experience in execution of commercial building projects (malls, hotels, hospitals or institutional buildings), with at least 3-5 years in a Project Manager or senior site leadership role on EPC projects.
- Strong working knowledge of both civil and MEP execution: electrical distribution, HVAC, fire protection, plumbing and building services coordination.
- Experience working under client/consultant approval systems - shop drawings, material approvals, approved-makes compliance, deviation approvals and specification-driven execution.
- Good command over BOQs, rate analysis, measurement/billing certification and vendor/sub-contractor management.
- Proficient in reading drawings (civil and services), MS Office/Excel; exposure to project scheduling tools preferred.
- Strong communication and coordination skills for client, consultant, vendor and team management.
- Willingness to be based full-time at the Aizawl site; prior experience of working in remote or difficult-terrain project locations will be an advantage.

Perks and Benefits:
- Accommodation provided by the company.
- Fooding (meals) provided by the company.
- Other benefits as per company policy.

The company specializes in the execution of government infrastructure projects on EPC and item-rate basis, with expertise in highways, bridges, electrical works, and other civil construction projects. With experience across multiple states, including the North-Eastern region, the company is committed to quality construction, efficient project execution, and timely delivery.

Description:
Title Counsellor - Opioid Substitution Therapy (OST)
Location: YRG MERF Integrated Care Clinic, Aizawl, Mizoram
Organisation: YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)


Job Summary

Key Responsibilities
A. OST counselling (as per NACO OST guidelines) - Pre-induction counselling: assess readiness, explain OST, its benefits and limits, and obtain informed consent for treatment.
Ongoing counselling on adherence, dose-related concerns, craving, relapse prevention and lifestyle change.
Counselling on take-home doses, safe storage and responsible use, where applicable.
Risk-reduction counselling on HIV, hepatitis B and C, STIs and TB; promote safe injecting practices and overdose prevention.
Referral and follow-up for HIV testing (ICTC), ART, hepatitis care, TB (NTEP), mental health and de-addiction services; confirm that referrals are completed.
Family and partner counselling, and support groups for clients and caregivers, with the clients consent.
Use the monthly irregular / pre-LFU list to follow up clients by phone and through the linked IDU Targeted Intervention; document tracking outcomes.
Maintain counselling records and update registers and SOCH/MIS entries on time.
Uphold confidentiality and the rights of clients under the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017.
Young people on OST - Offer youth-friendly, non-judgemental counselling suited to young adults who are new to treatment.
Address issues common to this group - family conflict, peer pressure, education and livelihood, relationships, sexual health and mental health.
Work with outreach staff and peer educators to bring in and retain young clients.
Open trial functions - Complete Good Clinical Practice (GCP) / Human Subjects Protection training before taking up any study task.
Explain the study to eligible clients in plain Mizo or English and support the informed consent process as set out in the protocol.
Deliver counselling sessions exactly as specified in the study manual; record each session on the fidelity checklist.
Administer study questionnaires and complete case report forms accurately and on schedule.
Support participant retention - appointment reminders, tracing of missed visits and follow-up as per the protocol.
Report adverse events, protocol deviations and client distress to the Medical Officer and Study Coordinator without delay.
Keep study participants data confidential and stored as per the studys data management plan.
Protecting study integrity (no contamination) - Use study materials, messages and tools only with enrolled study participants and only as the protocol allows.
Do not share study content with non-study clients, other staff, peer workers or outside organisations.
Keep study counselling and routine OST counselling clearly separate in records and in practice.
Raise any doubt about what may or may not be shared with the Study Coordinator before acting.
Team and reporting - Take part in daily clinic huddles, weekly case reviews and study team meetings.
Submit monthly counselling and study activity reports.
Carry out any other task assigned by the clinic in-charge in line with the programme.


Requirements
Essential (in line with NACO norms for NACP counsellors) - Either: Postgraduate degree in Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Anthropology, Human Development or Nursing, with at least 1 year of counselling experience in the health sector; Or: Graduate degree in the same disciplines, with at least 3 years of counselling experience in the health sector.
Fluency in Mizo (spoken and written) and working knowledge of English.
Basic computer skills - MS Office, email and data entry.
Desirable - Experience of counselling at an OST centre, IDU Targeted Intervention, de-addiction or harm reduction setting.
Experience of working with young people. Prior experience in a research study; GCP certification. NACO / SACS counsellor training.
Candidates from the community of people who use drugs or people living with HIV who meet the criteria are encouraged to apply.


Personal Attributes
Non-judgemental, empathetic and comfortable working with people who use drugs.
Disciplined in following protocols and keeping accurate records.
Trustworthy with confidential information.
Able to work in a team and with flexible hours when the clinic needs it.

Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

CA/CMA or MBA (Finance)/Master of Finance and Control /M.Com /PGDBM (with specification in Finance).

Description:
Key Responsibilities;-
1. Sales & Market Development
- Achieve monthly and annual sales targets for AAC Blocks in Mizoram.
- Identify and develop new customers (contractors, builders, government departments, and private projects).
- Generate demand by promoting AAC blocks to engineers, architects, and consultants.
- Drive product penetration into government and institutional projects.
2. Channel Expansion & Management
- Appoint and manage dealers/sub-dealers across Aizawl and other districts of Mizoram.
- Support channel partners with schemes, offers, and branding activities.
- Ensure smooth supply, order booking, and timely collections from the market.
3. Customer Relationship & Technical Support
- Build strong relationships with builders, contractors, and government officials.
- Conduct product demonstrations, site visits, and training sessions for masons & contractors.
- Provide after-sales support and resolve customer concerns.
4. Market Intelligence & Reporting
- Track competitor activities (pricing, schemes, dealer network, and projects).
- Submit daily/weekly sales reports and market updates.
- Coordinate with logistics and plant teams for smooth order execution.
Key Skills Required;-
1. Strong communication, presentation & negotiation skills.
2. Experience in sales of building materials (Cement, Steel, Bricks, Tiles, Blocks preferred).
3. Ability to establish dealer networks and institutional business.
4. Willingness to travel extensively across Mizoram.
5. Market knowledge of Mizoram (local language will be an advantage).
Experience 4 - 7 Years

We are looking for an experienced MEP Engineer (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) to oversee and manage MEP works for a government building project under the EPC mode. The candidate will be responsible for planning, execution, coordination, quality control, site supervision, and timely completion of all MEP activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day MEP site activities, including electrical, plumbing, firefighting, HVAC, and other building services.
Review and coordinate MEP drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and installation layouts.
Supervise site engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure proper execution of MEP works.
Coordinate with civil, structural, architectural, and other project teams to avoid clashes and ensure smooth execution.
Liaise with government officials, clients, consultants, and contractors for inspections, approvals, and technical clearances.
Monitor material procurement, consumption, manpower, and resource utilization to ensure cost-effective execution.
Ensure proper installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of all MEP systems.
Maintain quality standards and ensure compliance with applicable codes, safety regulations, and approved project specifications.
Prepare progress reports, measurement sheets, billing documents, and material reconciliation reports.
Identify and resolve technical issues and ensure timely completion of MEP works as per the project schedule.

Candidate Requirements
B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in building construction.
Experience in government projects and EPC execution preferred.
Good knowledge of MEP drawings, BOQs, billing, and site execution.
Strong coordination, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in hill-area or sloping terrain projects will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate
A hands-on professional capable of independently managing MEP site operations, coordinating with multiple teams, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring timely project delivery.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service

20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
Senior Software Engineer (C# .NET Azure)
With a global team of around 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our locations have earned #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.

Digitalization. Simply delivered.
Were very excited to see the positive impact of our work but also recognize the potential is much larger. This is why we need you!
#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #JobLocations #Indore #Chennai # Bangalore

Grow together.
We operate in an agile/DevSecOps manner, with product-oriented teams holding end-to-end responsibility for product success. Our work follows Scrum practices, including stand-ups, reviews, and iterative deployment. While not strictly by the book, we embrace agile principles, learning from failures and getting better every day.

About the IoT team
We are a supportive, quality-driven group of tech enthusiasts who strive to improve daily and are eager to assist you on your journey with us! Our global team includes members from India and Germany, collaborating via Microsoft Teams, Jira, and Confluence. We are aiming to provide a platform that accelerates IoT adoption for operational excellence, customer experience, and employee safety. We built a global platform that processes data from millions of connected devices across DHL and are developing modular use cases for real-time shipment monitoring (e.g. for life science and healthcare shipments) and actionable insights.

Tech stack
Our IoT platform is built on Microsoft Azure, featuring a micro-services architecture and Azure DevOps for continuous integration and delivery, utilizing Docker and Kubernetes. We primarily use .NET Core, C#, and Angular for coding.

Ready to embark on the journey? Heres what we are looking for:
Were looking for a Software Engineer in our IoT team who does both product development (we also do something with AI) where you will have an opportunity to directly impact customer experience in DHL as well as support existing IoT use case implementations.

What do we expect from you?
Proven experience as a Software Engineer with a strong portfolio of projects
Excellent problem-solving skills
Individual with positive energy and can-do attitude
A desire to grow and continuously improve in a fast-paced environment
Strong knowledge in .NET Core and C#
Strong code-reading skills and knack for writing clean, testable, easily maintainable code
Experience with Microsoft Azure Cloud PaaS services
Extensive knowledge in Entity Framework Core
Experience in MS SQL Server
Very good written and spoken English
Willingness to work in the UK shift

Good to have:
Experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Kubernetes Service
Thorough understanding of the responsibilities of the platform, database, API, caching layer, proxies, and other web services used in the syste
Job Locations: Bangalore, Chennai and Indore
An array of benefits for you:
Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Fiori Developer with ABAP CDS Experience
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated SAP S/4HANA Fiori UI5 Developer (About 4 to 7 years of experience) with expertise in ABAP and CDS. As a member of our dynamic team, you will be responsible for developing and enhancing SAP Fiori applications using Fiori Elements \ UI5 framework, ensuring a seamless user experience and efficient utilization of SAP S/4HANA capabilities.
Responsibilities:
Develop and customize SAP Fiori/UI5 applications using SAP UI5 framework, adhering to Fiori design principles and guidelines.
Design, develop, and implement custom Fiori/UI5 applications based on business requirements, ensuring high performance, responsiveness, and scalability.
Collaborate with functional consultants, business analysts, and end-users to understand business requirements and translate them into technical designs and solutions.
Enhance existing SAP Fiori/UI5 applications by adding new features, optimizing performance, and improving user experience.
Work closely with the ABAP team to develop backend logic and integrate UI5 applications with SAP S/4HANA backend systems using ABAP programming and CDS views.
Develop and maintain SAP Gateway services (OData services) to expose backend data for consumption by Fiori/UI5 applications.
Perform unit testing, troubleshooting, and bug fixing of Fiori/UI5 applications to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Follow best practices and coding standards for SAP Fiori/UI5 development, ensuring compliance with security and data privacy guidelines.
Stay updated with the latest SAP technologies, tools, and frameworks related to Fiori/UI5 development, and proactively apply them to improve application development processes.
Required Skills:
Solid understanding of the Fiori framework and capability to develop custom apps
Experience with SAP Gateway for service creation and OData for data provisioning
Proficiency in integrating SAP back-end systems using OData services
Familiarity with Business Application Studio (BAS) for deploying and managing Fiori applications

Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.

Professional references from previous SAP implementations

Lead and manage digital marketing and social media promotions for advertiser campaigns,

impressions, CTR, engagement, and conversions.
Prepare weekly and campaign-level performance reports with insights and improvement
recommendations.
Support sales teams with digital campaign ideas, proposals, and presentations for key
advertisers.
Coordinating with Digital / Social media agencies for routine promotions, review and
payments.

Paid media campaigns
Digital growth strategies
Influencer ecosystem
Lead generation campaigns

Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any deficiencies. Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc. Inspect storage areas for organization, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete work orders for maintenance repairs.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a hands-on Full Stack Java Developer to build, test and support enterprise applications. In this role, you will bring strong Java, Spring Boot, REST API and SQL skills together with exposure to modern frontend technologies to deliver high-quality, secure software solutions.
Day to day, you will design, develop and maintain enterprise applications, build and integrate RESTful APIs, microservices and database components, and support user-interface development. You will work closely with business analysts, QA and engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum environment, taking part in code reviews, CI/CD processes, deployments and production support.
This role also requires an AI-tool-ready mindset: you will use approved AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, refactoring, testing, debugging and documentation activities, while critically validating all AI-generated output for correctness, security and maintainability.
Essential Job Functions
Design, develop, test and maintain enterprise applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Build and integrate RESTful APIs, microservices and database components.
Develop or support user-interface components using Angular, React, JavaScript or TypeScript.
Write clean, maintainable code with appropriate unit and integration tests.
Troubleshoot application, API, integration and data issues, and perform root-cause analysis.
Participate in code reviews, CI/CD, deployments and production support.
Collaborate with business analysts, QA and engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Use approved AI-assisted development tools for coding, refactoring, testing and documentation, validating all generated output for correctness, security and maintainability.
Basic Qualifications
4-6 years of hands-on software development experience.
Strong Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring Framework and Spring Data JPA experience.
RESTful API development and service integration.
SQL and relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.
JPA/Hibernate or an equivalent ORM framework.
JUnit and Mockito; unit and integration testing practices.
Git and Maven or Gradle.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design principles, debugging and coding standards.
Ability to independently deliver low-to-medium complexity application changes.
Comfort using or rapidly adopting GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q Developer, Microsoft Copilot or similar GenAI engineering assistants.
Ability to use AI for code generation, code understanding, refactoring, unit-test creation, debugging, SQL assistance and technical documentation.
Ability to critically review AI-generated code and follow enterprise security, privacy and source-code handling standards.
Other Qualifications
Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS or Microsoft Azure.
CI/CD using Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman or REST Assured.
Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, batch processing or high-volume data processing.
Data migration and reconciliation experience.
Insurance, banking or financial-services domain exposure.

Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process. Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Supervises and manages employees. Managing all day-to-day operations. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Ensures employee recognition is taking place on all shifts.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Collaborates with the Front Office Manager on ways to continually improve departmental service.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Office goals to produce desired results.
- Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans based on review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Displays outstanding hospitality skills.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Interacts with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Handles guest problems and complaints effectively.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Ensures compliance with all Front Office policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Functions in place of the Front Office Manager in his/her absence.
- Communicates critical information from pre- and post-convention meetings to the Front Office staff.
- Participates in department meetings.

Description:
Assists in the management of the daily functions of the department to ensure protection of property assets, employees, guests and property. Maintains logs, certifications and documents required by law and Standard Operating Procedures. Assists in the training of staff in established emergency procedures and implements accident and fire prevention procedures. Position focuses on ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while achieving the operating budget.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Criminal Justice or related major; 1 year experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Security/Loss Prevention Operations
- Assists the Director of Engineering in administering fire prevention programs and emergency preparedness.
- Assists in conducting hazard and risk assessments at the property to include quarterly OSHA/SAFETY audits, incident tracking, and the hazard abatement process.
- Assists in the development of detailed "shut down" procedures for the property to ensure that all areas are secured at the appropriate times.
- Complies with applicable federal, state and local law and safety regulations.
- Follows proper key control guidelines in loss prevention and in the property.
- Develops a monthly checklist for all cctv equipment, alarmed doors, and duress alarms to ensure that they are fully functional.
- Incorporates into patrols, which encompass all areas of the propertys interior and exterior, an inspection tour of recording system.
- Follows Duty of Care process for the protection of guests and employees.
- Follows up on all unusual activities in and around the property that would impair the well being of guests and employees.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Implements action plans to monitor and control risk.
- Monitors all unusual activities in and around the property that would impair the well being of guests and employees.
- Oversees all loss prevention operations to include but not limited to patrol process, emergency response, investigations (initial follow up) for all guest and employee related incidents, shipping and receiving process (makes recommendations for improvement), electronic key system and manager on duties responsibilities.
- Oversees and guides the efforts of the Accident Prevention Committee.
- Oversees first aid program for guests and employees.
- Oversees the claims process and protects company assets by closely monitoring the General Liability and Workers Compensation cases.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Meet quality standards and customer expectations on a daily basis.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, developing formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaching or instructing others.
- Inspects and critiques the performance of the loss prevention department to establish and maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Additional Responsibilities
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Develops liaison with local law enforcement and emergency services.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

POSITION SUMMARY
Assess individuals current exercise program and level of fitness to develop personalized exercise programs and provide fitness counseling. Provide advice to individuals on the correct method of exercising with fitness equipment. Provide information, register, and schedule guests for recreation activities. Promote the rules and regulations of the recreation facility intended for the safety and welfare of guests and members.

Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others. Process payments for rental equipment, recreation activities, facility rentals, or retail sales. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational quality. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

License or Certification: CPR Certification
First Aid Certification
Fitness Equipment
Any certification or training required by local and state agencies.

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Relationship Associate to join our team in Axis Max Life Insurance Limited. The ideal candidate will have 1-6 years of experience driving business growth by managing branch relationships and collaborating with Axis Bank sellers.


Roles and Responsibility
Manage and maintain strong relationships with existing clients to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to capitalize on them.
Collaborate with Axis Bank sales teams to achieve business objectives.
Develop and implement effective lead conversion plans to drive sales growth.
Provide exceptional customer service and support to resolve client queries and concerns.
Analyze market trends and competitor activity to stay ahead in the industry.


Job Requirements
Minimum 1 year of experience in a related field, preferably in insurance or banking.
Strong understanding of the life insurance industry and its products.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build strong relationships.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet sales targets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify new business opportunities.
Experience working with Axis Bank or similar institutions is an advantage.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.

Job Title: Team Leader Contract Management – GPS

Organization: EY LLP India – Forensic & Integrity Services
Location: Bhopal (Full-time, On-site)
Reports to: Forensics Engagement Lead / Program Manager

Total vacancies: 1

About the Role
EY's Forensic & Integrity Services helps organizations strengthen trust by improving compliance and supporting effective governance. The Contract Management Team Lead will provide end-to-end legal and contractual support for the procurement of services, including comprehensive legal review of procurement documents, drafting and reviewing contracts, negotiating terms, and supporting contract execution and ongoing management.
The role requires a professional with an MBA/PGDM in Public Procurement, Materials Management, Healthcare Management, Public Health, Policy or Law, or a Master's degree in a relevant discipline, with at least 10 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years in Government/PSU health procurement or healthcare consulting. Relevant experience in contract management, procurement-related legal review and negotiation is required. The selected candidate will work with procurement teams, business stakeholders, government authorities where applicable, and service providers to identify legal risks, support compliant procurement processes and safeguard the organization's contractual interests.

Key Responsibilities
Provide end-to-end legal and contract management support for procurement services, from procurement planning and tender documentation through negotiation, execution, administration and closure.
Conduct comprehensive legal review of requests for proposals (RFPs), tender documents, bid conditions, procurement terms, service agreements, statements of work, purchase orders and related documents.
Draft, review and revise service procurement contracts, confidentiality agreements, amendments, addenda, extensions and renewals to ensure clarity, consistency and appropriate legal safeguards.
Lead or support negotiations with service providers and counterparties on legal and commercial terms, in coordination with procurement, finance and business teams.
Assess contractual provisions covering scope of services, deliverables, service levels, acceptance criteria, payment terms, performance security, warranties, indemnities, liability, confidentiality, data protection, intellectual property, termination and dispute resolution.
Review procurement documents and proposed contractual arrangements for compliance with applicable laws, procurement rules, government guidelines where relevant, internal policies and approval requirements.
Identify legal and contractual risks, prepare review notes and risk assessments, recommend mitigation measures, and escalate material deviations for appropriate approvals.
Coordinate stakeholder reviews, resolve contractual queries, document negotiated positions and support completion of approvals and execution formalities.
Maintain contract repositories, obligation trackers and records of approvals, amendments, key milestones, notice periods and renewals to support ongoing compliance and audit readiness.
Provide legal support on contract interpretation, changes in scope, service delivery issues, contractual notices, claims, disputes, termination and closure, coordinating with the legal team or external counsel where required.
Develop and improve procurement contract templates, clause libraries, review checklists and guidance materials, and prepare periodic reports on contract status, risks and outstanding actions.

Educational Qualifications
Essential: MBA/PGDM in Public Procurement, Materials Management, Healthcare Management, Public Health, Policy or Law, or a Master's degree in a relevant discipline from a recognized university/institution.
Desirable: Additional training or certification in contract management, public procurement or commercial law.

Experience Requirements
At least 10 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years in Government/PSU health procurement or healthcare consulting, with relevant experience in contract management, procurement-related legal review, drafting and negotiation of service contracts.
Demonstrated experience conducting comprehensive legal reviews of procurement documentation and negotiating service agreements, including identifying and resolving legal and commercial risks.
Experience managing the contract lifecycle, including approvals, execution, amendments, renewals, obligation tracking and contract closure.
Experience in government procurement or government contracts, including service procurement for government departments, public sector undertakings or government-funded projects, is preferred.

Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of contract law, commercial agreements and legal principles relevant to procurement of services.
Ability to interpret and apply procurement policies, tender conditions and government procurement requirements where applicable.
Excellent legal drafting, contract review and negotiation skills.
Sound legal judgment, analytical thinking and the ability to recommend practical risk mitigation measures.
Attention to detail when reviewing complex procurement documents, contractual obligations and cross-document consistency.
Ability to manage multiple contracts, prioritize time-sensitive reviews and meet procurement timelines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain legal issues clearly to non-legal stakeholders.
Effective stakeholder coordination, professional integrity and discretion in handling confidential procurement and contractual information.
Proficiency in contract documentation, redlining, report preparation and use of contract repositories or contract management tools.

Preferred Experience
Hands-on experience reviewing government tenders, RFPs and service procurement contracts, and coordinating with government departments or public sector entities.
Experience supporting procurement of consulting, professional, technology, outsourced or other services, including review of service levels and performance obligations.
Exposure to procurement governance, legal due diligence, contract compliance reviews and audit support within government or regulated environments.

Strong communication and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period preferred.

Position: Cluster Human Resource

Eligibility Parameters:
3-4 years of experience in Human Resource generalist role.

Education Qualification
Minimum : MBA/ PGBDA (HR) (regular course)

Position Reports to : AHR /Zonal HR
Reportees : HR Intern (Wherever applicable)

Required Competencies
Technical Expertise
Communication & Presentation skills
Planning & Organising
Counselling & Coaching
Teamwork & networking
Problem Solving

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
The most important end-results for which an incumbent would be held responsible at the end of the year.

Manpower Budgeting
Involved in proposing the manpower budgets after taking into account various projections & projected manpower numbers for the coming year.
Allocates the staff in various sub-departments considering various factors like Strengths & weaknesses of each member, GMROL, level of intervention required with the customer (A/B/C), MPA along with DMs & UM
Ensures availability of that manpower as per budgets and checks that budgets are not exceeded beyond permissible limits.
Does availability study periodically, gives feedback to DMs & Supervisors and arrives at solutions for problem areas.

Recruitment, Selection & Induction
Ties up with consultants to meet manpower requirements. Negotiate with them for least possible service fees.
Follows up with consultants for filling up vacancy as soon as possible
Maintains database of applications, rejects
Liases with institutes and colleges for CCA applications
Prepares for and conducts assessment centre for selection
Conducts interviews with UH for selection for all store level positions upto Department Managers.
Evaluates need for placing of advertisements & gets required approvals
Ensures induction schedule is prepared for new joinees, induction goes as per plan, adequate inputs are given and employees are equipped enough before they are on the job.

Training & Development
Prepares training calendar after collating data from PA forms & discussions with concerned Supervisors & DMs.
Does module development on certain training areas
Ensures all infrastructure is in place for internal training programs
Liases with external consultants for specific training needs which cannot be catered to internally & negotiates for best quality at best rate and gets necessary approvals for external trainings.
Ensures smooth execution of trainings.
Ensures training evaluation is done for each program conducted
Liases with Brands/ SO for product/ brand training
Delivers training programs

Payroll Activities
Ensure error-free & timely updation of employee data on system.
Ensures all payroll inputs to be closed as per given timelines with the central payroll team.

Employee Communication & Policy implementation
Communicates employee related policies and ensures adherence to the same
Clarifies queries related to policies and gives feedback on the same to the SO

Welfare Activities
Handles employee grievances at all levels by coaching & counselling
Ensures tie-ups for employees with other institutions like computer institutes, libraries etc.
Ensures execution of employee engagement activities as per annual calaneder.
Activates unit led awards to keep motivation levels high

Statutory Compliances
Liases with consultants to ensure statutory compliances & timely filing of returns.
Ensures statutory compliances are met wrt brand staff, concessionaires etc.

Performance Appraisal
Communicates to the staff the appraisal schedules & process to be followed which are sent be SO
Conducts PA workshops for assessors to throw light on process & common appraisal errors
Ensures regular follow ups to ensure appraisals are done as per time lines
Goes through appraisal forms to oversee the quality of the feedback & comments & evaluate objectivity
Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings
Sends collated data to SO
Counsels employees if dissatisfaction arises post increments showing them the organization perspective & the way ahead

Experience: 5-10 Years
Department: Customer Experience / CRM /
Location: Indore

Role Summary
Responsible for managing end-to-end unit handover, snagging, de-snagging, quality inspections, and possession processes for residential and commercial real estate projects. The role ensures timely closure of defects, seamless customer handover, and enhanced customer satisfaction while coordinating with Project, Construction, Sales, CRM, and Facilities teams.

Key Responsibilities
Manage complete handover and possession activities for residential/commercial projects.
Conduct pre-possession unit inspections and identify snag points related to civil, architectural, electrical, plumbing, and finishing works.
Prepare and track snag lists, coordinate with contractors/vendors, and ensure timely de-snagging closure.
Monitor quality standards and ensure units are handed over as per approved specifications.
Coordinate with Construction, MEP, Facilities, and CRM teams for handover readiness.
Schedule and conduct customer walkthroughs and pre-handover inspections.
Address customer observations and ensure closure before possession.
Ensure all statutory approvals, NOCs, documentation, and payment clearances are completed before handover.
Facilitate possession formalities, key handover, and customer onboarding.
Maintain handover MIS, snag/de-snag trackers, possession reports, and customer feedback records.
Drive customer satisfaction and resolve escalations during possession.

Required Skills
Strong experience in snagging, de-snagging, handover, and possession management.
Knowledge of civil finishing, MEP systems, quality control, and defect rectification.
Exposure to residential high-rise and township projects.
Expertise in customer handling and stakeholder management.
Proficiency in MS Excel, CRM systems, and project tracking tools.
Strong problem-solving, coordination, and communication skills.

Qualification
5-10 years of experience in real estate handover, quality inspections, snagging, and possession management.

Location: Hyderabad/Indore- India
Duration: Full time

Job Description :

Summary
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.

Position Summary
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Requirements / Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
5-8 years of professional work experience with at least 3 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, and Azure Analysis Services (AAS)
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Having experience with Snowflake and Snowpro certification is a bonus.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the company's business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan; coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.
Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities - Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales
Department: PSD
Function: Institutional Sales
Designation: Product Sales Executive (PSE)
Reporting To: ABM/ Regional Manager
Experience: 3 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location - Mumbai, Kolkata, Patna, Bihar


Job Purpose
The Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales will be responsible for driving product
sales and business growth through institutional customers. The role involves identifying new
business opportunities, developing relationships with key institutional clients, generating
enquiries, preparing quotations, negotiating commercial terms, and ensuring achievement of assigned sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and develop new institutional customers and business opportunities.
- Manage relationships with existing institutional clients and ensure repeat business.
- Conduct regular customer visits and understand product requirements.
- Generate leads through market visits, references, networking and other business development activities.
- Present and demonstrate products to institutional customers as required.
- Prepare and submit quotations, proposals and commercial offers.
- Coordinate with internal teams for pricing, product availability, dispatch and delivery.
- Follow up on enquiries, quotations and orders to ensure timely conversion.
- Negotiate with customers within approved company guidelines.
- Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
- Maintain an updated database of institutional customers, prospects and sales activities.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer requirements.
- Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments in coordination with the finance team.
- Handle customer queries and coordinate for resolution of complaints.
- Maintain regular sales reports, visit reports and pipeline updates.
- Support the organization in developing new territories, accounts and product opportunities.

Key Accountabilities / KPIs
- Achievement of assigned sales targets.
- New institutional customer acquisition.
- Revenue and product-wise sales growth.
- Enquiry-to-order conversion.
- Number and quality of customer visits.
- Development of active sales pipeline.
- Customer retention and repeat orders.
- Timely payment/collection follow-up.
- Gross margin as per company guidelines.
- Accuracy and timely submission of sales reports.

Target Customer Segments
The candidate may be responsible for developing business from:
- Corporates and large organizations
- Educational institutions
- Hospitals and healthcare institutions
- Government/semi-government institutions
- Hotels and hospitality organizations
- Dealers/distributors and institutional buyers
- NGOs and other bulk purchasers
- Other B2B/institutional customers relevant to the company's product portfolio

Candidate Profile
Qualification:
- Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

Experience:
- 3 years of experience in B2B, institutional sales, corporate sales or field sales.
- Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude may also be considered.
Skills Required:
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills.
- Ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
- Target-oriented and self-motivated approach.
- Good presentation and convincing skills.
- Basic knowledge of MS Office/Excel and CRM systems.
- Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings.
- Ability to work independently.

Desired Competencies
- Business development
- Customer relationship management
- Sales planning and execution
- Negotiation skills
- Market intelligence
- Follow-up and closing skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Time management
- Result orientation

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the company's business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications
Requirements
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage
