Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We re committed to building a better future - from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us - change the world, love your job!
Are you looking for a career at one of the leading semiconductor companies in the world Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for a Digital Design Verification Engineer to join the team of enthusiastic engineers who develops highly complex mixed signal devices for audio applications with industry leading performance.
These audio products are truly mixed-signal devices with highly integrated digital circuits such as a DSP core for digital filters and audio signal processing blocks, hardware processing blocks, analog controllers, various serial interfaces (Audio serial interfaces, I2C, SPI) and other digital blocks like clock-generation, registers map, Interrupts etc.
This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that s continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics, industrial and automotive markets.
Position : Digital Design Verification Engineer
Domain : Consumer Audio Amplifiers and Haptics
Location : Bangalore
What can you expect to learn in this role/Opportunity
To work with the best experts in the industry.
To develop capability to work effectively in a technically challenging fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
To innovate on core technology in verification methodologies influence decisions that have wide business impact across many products teams.
To work on cutting edge industry leading products.
To learn overall product development Process and directly influence the features, differentiation quality of the product.
To learn and develop business insights, drive open discussions with business technology leaders and drive decisions impacting product technology execution.
To build strong, influential relationships with domain experts.
To develop good communication, interpersonal skills while interacting with worldwide cross functional experts.
To learn identifying risks across domains and adapt to support changing priorities.
To present analysis and conclusions to internal customers and business leaders in a comprehensive and effective manner.
To work closely with cross-domain experts other engineers and interns.
Primary Responsibilities:
Responsible to develop detailed coverage driven Verification plan working closing with System and Application team and design team.
Owning part of digital verification of the sub-system and full-chip by working closely with other verification team members, leads including outside services.
Develop/Enhance SV/UVM based testbenches and tests and simulations at all phases (RTL, GLS),
Understanding spec and coming up with testplan. Writing TB components, testcases, checkers, assertions, enhancing with randomization and coverage-feedbacks.
RTL and GLS regression and follow-up with tracking of the various activities. Run coverage and meet the defined coverage(coverage functional) goals.
Good interaction with Digital Design team, Firmware developers, Analog Designers, and rest of the team.
Excellent teamwork, adapting to situations and ability to guide, help DV members Communication of DV status, issues, and concerns.
Innovate drive new and improved design verification methodologies where needed, work with the EDA team to upgrade tools and flows.
Interacting with Test/Silicon Validation/Application Engineering team to ensure successful use of products and support customer applications debug/analysis.
Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.
Basic Qualifications: Bachelors/Masters Degree in EE/ECE
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering.
3 years of Digital design verification experience.
Basic Requirement:
Strong digital design fundamentals basic Electrical engineering
Experience with Verilog, System Verilog languages with UVM methodology.
Experience on randomization and coverage driven digital verification.
Experience in working with VIPs, creating TB components, agents, monitors, scoreboards and other ways to automate verification.
Hand on experience in RTL and Gate level simulations of complex ASIC at block and top level
Expert in using simulation tools (preferably Cadence, Xcelium/Ncsim).
Basic scripting knowledge using shell/python/perl.
Excellent debugging and problem-solving skill.
Excellent in Coverage driven verification with code coverage, functional coverage
Experience in Formal verification (using Jasper Gold) is good to have
Good communication, presentation skills and teamwork.

Preferred Qualifications:
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication skills to interact with all stakeholders.
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions.
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
Ability to take the initiative and drive for results.
Ability to build strong, influential relationships with cross-functional teams.
Added Advantage :
Experience in silicon debug along with design and silicon validation team.
Experience in audio signal processing and understanding of audio systems/applications.
Hands-on exp on I2C, SPI, ASI protocols.
Hand on experience on Cadence tools
Preferred Skills/ Experience
3-5 years of relevant experience

Description:
Job Purpose:
We are looking for a skilled Fabrication Supervisor to lead and oversee day-to-day fabrication and manufacturing activities. The role involves managing sheet metal fabrication, MIG welding, press brake operations, manpower utilization, quality compliance, machine efficiency, and workplace safety to ensure production targets are achieved on time and within quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

Production & Fabrication Management
Supervise sheet metal fabrication processes including cutting, bending, forming, welding, and assembly.
Ensure smooth operation of MIG welding equipment, press brake machines, and other fabrication tools.
Plan and allocate daily production targets and manpower based on manufacturing priorities.
Monitor production progress and ensure timely completion of work orders.
Interpret engineering drawings, fabrication specifications, and dimensional requirements.
Coordinate with Production Planning, Quality, and Maintenance teams to ensure uninterrupted workflow.

Team & Workforce Management
Assign tasks to welders, fabricators, machine operators, and support staff.
Train and mentor shop-floor personnel to improve productivity, quality, and workmanship.
Monitor attendance, discipline, performance, and manpower utilization.
Resolve daily operational challenges and ensure adequate workforce availability.
Foster teamwork, accountability, and adherence to production schedules.

Machine Operations & Maintenance
Ensure safe and efficient operation of MIG welding machines, press brake machines, and fabrication equipment.
Monitor machine performance, tooling conditions, and process parameters.
Coordinate preventive maintenance activities and report equipment breakdowns promptly.
Support proper machine setup, tool selection, and process optimization.
Minimize equipment downtime and maintain production continuity.

Quality Assurance
Ensure fabricated components meet engineering drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
Conduct routine inspections of weld quality, bends, dimensions, and finished products.
Identify and troubleshoot fabrication defects, dimensional deviations, and welding issues.
Collaborate with the Quality team on inspections and corrective actions.
Drive initiatives to reduce rework, rejection, and material wastage.

Safety & 5S Compliance
Enforce safety regulations and ensure proper use of PPE across the fabrication shop.
Promote safe operation of welding equipment, press brakes, and material handling systems.
Maintain workplace cleanliness through effective 5S and housekeeping practices.
Identify unsafe conditions and implement corrective and preventive measures.
Ensure compliance with company safety standards and statutory requirements.

Desired Candidate Profile

Education:
Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

Experience:
2 to 4 years of experience in sheet metal fabrication, welding, and manufacturing operations.
Experience in supervising fabrication teams in a production environment.
Hands-on exposure to MIG welding, press brake operations, and metal fabrication processes.
Prior experience as a Fabrication Supervisor, Production Supervisor, Shop Floor Supervisor, or Team Leader will be an advantage.

Key Skills:
Sheet Metal Fabrication
MIG Welding
Press Brake Machine Operations
Production Supervision
Engineering Drawing Interpretation
Weld Quality Inspection
Production Planning & Scheduling
Manpower Management
Manufacturing Operations
Quality Control & Defect Reduction
Preventive Maintenance Coordination
Safety & 5S Implementation
MS Excel & Production Reporting
Problem Solving & Team Leadership

POSITION SUMMARY
Prepare special meals or substitute items. Regulate temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Pull food from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portion, arrangement, and food garnish. Maintain food logs. Monitor the quality and quantity of food that is prepared. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods. Inform Chef of excess food items for use in daily specials. Inform Food Beverage service staff of menu specials and out of stock menu items. Ensure the quality of the food items. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests service needs. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.
Related Work Experience: At least 3 years of related work experience.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Complete inventory of uniforms and linens. Conduct monthly inventory of laundry supplies. Report faulty equipment, maintenance needs, and safety hazards to manager/supervisor. Train employees on all laundry procedures, including safety procedures and equipment operation. Verify that laundry requests are completed for each department as needed. Operate and monitor washing, dry cleaning, and drying machinery. Inspect linens and terry for damage.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. . Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.

Description:
Job Description:

Manipal Hospitals is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Pharmacist to join our healthcare team. The Pharmacist will be responsible for preparing and dispensing medications, providing drug information to healthcare professionals and patients, and ensuring the safe and effective use of pharmaceuticals. The successful candidate will play a critical role in patient care by collaborating with healthcare providers and maintaining accurate medication records.

Key Responsibilities:

- Dispense medications according to prescriptions and ensure proper labeling and storage.
- Counsel patients on medication usage, side effects, and potential interactions.
- Collaborate with doctors and other healthcare personnel to optimize medication therapy.
- Perform medication reconciliation and review patient medication histories for accuracy.
- Monitor patient outcomes and adjust medications as necessary in consultation with healthcare providers.
- Engage in inventory management, including ordering, receiving, and managing stock levels.
- Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements related to pharmacy practice.
- Participate in patient education programs and health promotion activities.

Skills and Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy or PharmD from an accredited institution.
- Valid pharmacist license to practice in the relevant state or country.
- Strong knowledge of pharmacology, therapeutics, and pharmaceutical care.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective patient counseling.
- Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary healthcare team.
- Proficient in using pharmacy management software and electronic health records.

Tools and Technologies:

- Pharmacy management systems (e.g., Meditech, Pyxis, or similar).
- Electronic health records (EHR) systems.
- Drug information databases and research tools.
- Compounding equipment and tools for medication preparation.
- Medication dispensing systems and automated pharmacy technologies.

If you are passionate about medication management and committed to providing high-quality patient care, we encourage you to apply for this rewarding opportunity at Manipal Hospitals.
Roles and Responsibilities
About the Role:
The Pharmacist at Manipal Hospitals plays a critical role in ensuring the safe and effective use of medications. You will be responsible for dispensing medications accurately and providing patient counseling on their proper use. This role requires collaboration with healthcare professionals to optimize pharmacotherapy and enhance patient outcomes.

About the Team:
You will be part of a dynamic healthcare team including doctors, nurses, and other allied health professionals. The pharmacy team values collaboration, communication, and a patient-centered approach to care. You will have opportunities for professional development and contribute to a supportive work environment focused on excellence in patient care.

You are Responsible for:
- Accurately dispensing prescriptions and managing the medication supply chain.
- Providing medication counseling and information to patients and healthcare professionals.
- Monitoring patient medications for efficacy, safety, and adherence.
- Maintaining accurate records of medication usage and inventory management.
- Staying updated with the latest pharmacological research and best practices.

To succeed in this role – you should have the following:
- A degree in Pharmacy from a recognized institution and a valid pharmacy license.
- Strong knowledge of pharmacology, drug interactions, and therapeutic guidelines.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with patients and healthcare teams.
- Attention to detail and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
- A commitment to continuous professional development and patient care excellence.
AboutCompany:
About the company

Manipal Hospitals is one of Indias leading integrated healthcare providers serving ~ 8 million patients annually, focussed on providing accessible, high-quality healthcare services. Manipals integrated network today has a pan-India footprint of 50 hospitals with over 13,400 licensed beds across 14 States & Union Territories. The network is India’s largest multispecialty hospital network by bed capacity, supported by a talented pool of 11,000+ doctors and an employee strength of over 25,000.
With a commitment to provide patient-centric care, Manipal Hospitals combines clinical expertise with advanced technology, research and innovation to serve a multitude of patients across the globe. Its continued focus on clinical quality and operational excellence is reflected in its NABH accreditation, with several of its hospitals also accredited by NABL and recognised for its excellence in nursing and emergency care.

Adherence to Process

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Associate Agency Development Manager to join our team at Axis Max Life Insurance Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in agency development and management, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


Roles and Responsibility
Develop and implement effective agency development strategies to drive business growth.
Build and maintain strong relationships with agents, brokers, and other stakeholders.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide feedback to agents to improve their sales skills.
Identify new business opportunities and develop plans to capitalize on them.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.
Analyze market trends and competitor activity to stay ahead of the competition.


Job Requirements

The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service need b)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects-Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms

Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same

Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion
Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.


Measures of Success
Achievement of business plan GPA
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent


Requirements / Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience, At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Communication skills

Function SummaryThe agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service needb)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Job Summary
Responsible for - Agent Quality Recruitment- Agent Development- Meeting WFYP Business targets- Conducting Career Seminars for Agents - Communicating Agent RnR regularly


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line. -Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring -Conduct Career Seminar of prospects-Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms

Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion -Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty -Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need -Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success:-Achievement of business plan GPA-Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.-Number MTD Active-Persistency as per grid-Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience , At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Job Description
Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner

Description:
As an Admission officer, you are expected to:
1. Generate admissions by maintaining a continuous influx of data by conducting Above The Line” (ATL) & “Below The Line” (BTL) marketing activities such as- seminars in schools, open seminars in town & residential spots within a specified territory.
2. Contribute towards set targets by doing school visits for meeting principals, coordinators and management personals for business development.
3. Ensure a delightful customer experience while going for home visits to counsel students and parents and close admissions resulting in enrolling the students.
4. Capitalize on business opportunities by liaising with local tuition teachers.
5. Ensure adherence to internal processes and compliances.
To be successful in the Admission Officer role you are required to have:
1. Ability to handle customers in a calm, empathic & patient manner, along with strong sales persuasion skills.
2. Excellent networking and presentation skills to conduct seminars.
3. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and writing emails, & comfortable while working on software related to Sales & Services.
4. Fluency in communication of English and Regional Language.
5. Comfortable for traveling and public speaking.
Must Attitude:
1. Customer Orientation
2. Sense of Ownership and Accountability.
3. Result orientation
4. Emotional intelligence for working in a team.
Qualification:
1. Must have bachelor’s degree.
2. Preferred BTech / MBA /Masters in Psychology, Education etc.
Experience:
1. Previous experience in counselling in education or careers counselling.
2. Previous experience of Business to Customer (B2C) Sales across industries.
Key Interactions:
External
Students, Parents & Schools.
Partners and Vendors for Above The line (ATL) and Below The line (BTL) activities.
Internal
Branch’s Academic & Non-Academic teams.
Regional Student Support Centre.
Regional Sales & Operations Team.

Company Description
Heritage Foods Ltd. is one of India's largest and reputable FMCG companies, founded in 1992 by Mr. Nara Chandrababu Naidu. The company has two divisions - Dairy and Renewable Energy, under its flagship Company Heritage Foods Limited. Heritage's milk and milk products have a market presence in multiple states across PAN India.

Role Description
This is a full-time on-site role for a Trade Marketing Executive located in Bangalore & Vijayawada. Trade Marketing Executive will be responsible for Execute trade marketing strategies to boost brand visibility, drive sales, and enhance retailer engagement. This role involves understanding regional market trends, implementing trade programs, and working with sales and marketing teams to support business growth. market planning, utilizing analytical skills, Sales Promotions, and implementing sales & marketing initiatives on a regional level.

Trade Marketing Strategy Execution Implement and drive regional trade marketing plans effectively to support business growth.

Retailer & Distributor Engagement Strengthen relationships with trade partners to improve brand presence and trade participation.
Merchandising & POSM Deployment Ensure proper placement and utilization of POS materials to maximize impact.
Market Analysis & Competitive Insights Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and consumer preferences to refine strategies.
Budget Utilization & ROI Optimize trade marketing spend and assess the return on investment for promotional activities.
Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with sales, marketing, and distribution teams to align trade initiatives with business goals.
Compliance & Process Adherence – Ensure all trade marketing activities adhere to company policies and regulatory guidelines.

Qualifications
3-8 years of experience in trade marketing, sales, or retail marketing, preferably in the FMCG or dairy industry.
MBA or PGDM in Marketing
28-35 years Old
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Willingness to travel frequently within the assigned region.

Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

Any Graduate from a recognized university.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.

Job DescriptionA self-driven target oriented individual role with a mix of both Direct and Channel sourcing, involved in building and setting up a network of Channel partners. Key roles and responsibilities Daily visits to and follow-up with the Educational Institutions falling within the target segment, desirous of seeking a loan.
1. Building a healthy pipeline of logins and sanctions w.r.t the assigned sales target for both Direct and Channel Sourcing.

8. Active involvement in fulfilment of the required documents by the Credit and Operations team during the login, approval and disbursement / post disbursement process.
9. Scouting and onboarding potential Channel partners to source business for Credila.
10.Maintaining the portfolio quality at all times by sourcing quality logins as per the defined product and credit policy and ensuring customers regularly pay the EMI dues in time.
11. Active involvement in collection of overdue EMIs from the customers.
12.Building a healthy relationship with all the Customers in the mapped portfolio to fulfill their future loan requirements and prevent them from going to the competition i.e. retention.
13. Deliver quality Customer Service and generate referrals from existing customers.
14. Cross-selling of Insurance & other allied products

Job Purpose:
The role is responsible forleading branch operations and driving business growth for home loan andmortgage products

It involves achieving sales targets through team management,market development, and strategic partnerships

The position focuses on expandingcustomer acquisition, ensuring compliance, maintaining portfolio quality, anddelivering a superior customer experience across all branch activities

Manageoverall branch sales operations, including business development, customerservice, and compliance

Drivehome loan business growth through direct sourcing, DSA and open-market channels

Buildand maintain strong customer and builder relationships to maximize businessvalue and cross-sell opportunities

Developand implement strategies to achieve branch sales targets

Monitorbranch portfolio performance and implement corrective measures

Ensureadherence to regulatory guidelines, internal policies, and audit requirements

Collaboratewith Operations and Risk teams to streamline loan processes, maintain portfolioquality, and control NPAs

Provenability to lead sales teams and manage branch-level PL

Strongbusiness development, networking, negotiation, and influencing skills

Excellentinterpersonal, communication, and problem-solving abilities

Highmotivation, self-starter attitude, and bias for action in a high-performanceenvironment

Stronganalytical skills to track performance and drive profitability

Workingknowledge of Excel and sales MIS tools
Educational Qualifications and Experience:
25years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within BFSI/NBFC; exposureto Loans Against Property preferred

Priorexperience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales; strong localmarket knowledge and established regional network

Minimum Graduate

Job Title: Loan Officer Gold Loan Sales
Company: Keertana Finserv Limited
Industry: NBFC / Financial Services
Department: Sales & Business Development
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.
AboutCompany: Keertana is a fast growing Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) operating in JLG , Gold & MSME Loans Lending. As part of the business activities, the company is predominantly focused into Asset Financing and Lending business.
CompanyAddress: 2, PLOT 31 32, RAMKY SELENIUM TOWERS Nanakramgud a Main Road, Hyderabad, Rangareddy , Hyderabad, Telangana, India

Job Description Assistant Manager / Manager O&M
Location: Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager / Manager O&M to manage plant operations, production, manpower, safety and maintenance coordination. Candidates must have hands-on experience with Crusher and Screener operations, preferably in mining, steel, metals or heavy engineering industries.
Key Responsibilities
Manage daily plant operations, production, dispatch and shift execution.
Oversee Crusher, Screener and related plant machinery operations.
Coordinate preventive and breakdown maintenance with technical teams.
Manage manpower deployment, attendance, productivity and discipline.
Ensure safety protocols, SOP compliance and regular safety briefings.
Monitor machine availability, diesel consumption, spare usage and operational costs.
Handle client coordination and operational reviews.
Verify daily and monthly operational reports before submission to HO.
Lead onsite teams and ensure smooth plant execution.


Requirements
Minimum 10 years of experience in O&M / Plant Operations.
Mandatory hands-on experience with Crusher and Screener operations.
Experience in Steel, Metals, Mining, Engineering, Construction, Infrastructure or Heavy Machinery industries.
Strong expertise in manpower management, maintenance coordination and industrial safety.
Prior experience as Team Lead / Site In-Charge / Plant Supervisor preferred.
Knowledge of HEMM, plant machinery and industrial safety.
NEBOSH / IOSH / Safety Training will be an added advantage.
Good communication, client-handling and onsite execution skills.
Candidates must be willing to work in Visakhapatnam.

Description:
We re always looking for new ways to raise the bar. So we re searching for a Sales Director with a track record of driving sales and smashing targets to help us fill our rooms, meeting suites and banquet halls.

A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you ll mostly be:
Managing daily sales activities and coaching your team to deliver to their full potential
Hitting all personal and team sales goals to help us maximise profitability
Creating and implementing sales plans that drive measurable incremental occupancy, increase average rates, increase volume, food and beverage and banquet sales
Producing and reviewing monthly reports to monitor performance
Developing and maintaining relationships with key clients and outside contacts

What We need from you:
Bachelor s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in marketing or related field

Strong knowledge of local businesses and business trends required

Other languages preferred

IHG Hotels Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing

Promote awareness of brand image internally and externally. Use sales techniques that maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott. Communicate with potential owners via telephone to set up preview package sales/tours. Encourage guests or callers to purchase or schedule preview package sales/tours.

Explain details and requirements related to attending a sales presentation to potential owners. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.

Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

Attention to detail and compliance orientation

13 years in credit appraisal/underwriting; experiencein digital/fintech lending preferred

Description:
Job Description
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants learning their business understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates

Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Google sheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance

- Strong leadership and team-building skills.

- Ability to analyze data and market trends effectively.
- Proficient in sales strategies and customer relationship management.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Proven track record in sales and business development in the insurance sector.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho CRM).
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Data analysis tools for sales tracking and performance monitoring.
- Online training platforms for agent development.
- Communication tools (e.g., email, video conferencing software).

Company: Keertana Finserv Limited
Industry: NBFC / Financial Services
Department: Sales & Business Development
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Description
Keertana Finserv Limited, a Gold Loan Company, is looking for enthusiastic and motivated candidates for the position of Loan Officer across various locations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.

Candidates should be graduates with a strong interest in Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management. Freshers and experienced candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities :
1. Customer Acquisition
Identify potential customers and generate leads through local contacts, referrals, networking and direct marketing.
Convert prospective leads into Gold Loan customers.
2. Field Marketing
Conduct regular field visits and meet prospective customers and local referral sources.
Promote Keertana Gold Loan products, services and schemes.
3. Sales & Business Development
Explain Gold Loan products, basic processes and services to customers.
Generate branch walk-ins, follow up with leads and support loan conversions.
4. Customer Relationship Management
Maintain regular contact with prospective and existing customers.
Develop strong local relationships and generate repeat and referral business.
5. Target Achievement
Work towards assigned daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Focus on lead generation, customer visits, follow-ups, new customer acquisition and business volume.
6. Local Market Development
Identify new customer segments and referral networks.
Participate in branch-level promotional and customer-acquisition activities.
7. Branch Coordination
Coordinate with the branch team for customer handling, loan applications, follow-ups and smooth processing of business generated through field activities.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate from a recognized university.
Must have a genuine interest in Sales and Business Development.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to travel locally and conduct field activities.
Ability to build customer relationships and work towards sales targets.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Compensation & Benefits
Attractive monthly salary.
Additional performance-based incentives based on business achievements.
Opportunity to grow in the NBFC and Gold Loan industry.
Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to apply.
AboutCompany: Keertana is a fast growing Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) operating in JLG , Gold & MSME Loans Lending. As part of the business activities, the company is predominantly focused into Asset Financing and Lending business.

Description:
Muthoot Finance is hiring Field Sales Officers LAP for Vijayawada, Nandigama, Guntur, Eluru, And Kalidindi Locations.
This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for freshers looking to start their career in Sales and Financial Services. Prior LAP or financial-services sales experience is NOT required. Training will be provided.

Generate LAP business through field visits, local market sourcing and customer acquisition.
Identify and approach potential customers for Loan Against Property (LAP) products.
Conduct customer visits and understand their loan requirements.
Explain LAP product features, eligibility criteria and documentation requirements.
Build and maintain relationships with customers, connectors and local market contacts.
Collect and verify customer documents required for loan processing.
Coordinate with internal teams for application processing, approval and disbursement.
Follow up with customers throughout the loan process.
Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions and sales activities.
Achieve assigned sales and business targets while following company policies and compliance requirements.

Candidate Eligibility
Freshers are welcome to apply.
LAP experience is NOT required.
Candidates who have completed Intermediate, Graduation or Post Graduation can apply.
Age: Up to 26 years.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to work in a field sales role and interact with customers.
Interest in sales, business development and customer acquisition.
Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
Male candidates only.

Compensation & Job Details

CTC: 2.30 LPA
Location: Vijayawada
Experience: 01 Years (Freshers Welcome to apply)
Employment Type: Full Time
Industry: Banking / Financial Services

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate each day s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area. Test, troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items. Program TVs and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers. Display basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Adhere to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Some experience in general maintenance, exterior and interior surface preparation and painting.
Experience in hotel engineering or maintenance a plus.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
License or Certification: Driver s License

Description:
Field HR Associate JD
Role Summary:
The Field HR Associate will support and execute human resources activities at the ground
level across logistics sites such as warehouses, fulfillment centers, and delivery hubs. The role
involves blue-collar hiring, attendance and payroll support, engagement activities, labor
compliance tracking, and issue resolution for site-based workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruitment & Onboarding
Coordinate daily/weekly hiring of warehouse associates, loaders, delivery staff, etc.
through vendors and local channels.
Manage candidate screening, document collection, and induction processes.
Maintain trackers for manpower deployment and contractor rotation.
Attendance, Payroll & HR Ops
Monitor daily attendance through biometric/manual systems.
Collate and validate attendance data for payroll input in coordination with central HR
ops.
Assist in issuing ID cards, onboarding kits, and HR documentation at the site.
Compliance & Labor Law Support
Support contract labor compliance (e.g., ESI/PF records, CLRA documentation).
Coordinate with compliance teams and vendors to ensure audit readiness at the site.
Maintain updated personnel records as per labor law norms.
Employee Engagement & Grievance Handling



Conduct engagement activities (e.g., weekly briefings, rewards, celebrations).
Act as the first point of contact for associate grievances related to wages, safety, shift
timings, etc.
Escalate unresolved issues to regional HR.
HR Reporting & Coordination
Maintain HR MIS, hiring status, attrition reports, and daily dashboards.
Coordinate between warehouse operations, vendors, and HR leadership.
Support audits, safety drills, and training rollouts.
Qualifications:
Graduate in any discipline; PG Diploma in HR preferred
13 years of experience in field HR roles (logistics, manufacturing, retail, or facility
management)
Freshers with relevant internship experience may be considered
Language: Local language fluency + basic English required
Comfortable with fieldwork and managing blue-collar workforce
Key Skills:
People-centric and proactive
Basic knowledge of labor laws and HR documentation
Strong coordination and reporting ability
Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance software



High integrity, discipline, and site ownership mindset

Description:
Key Accountabilities
Own the programme Non-Functional Test Approach, defining the scope, objectives and delivery approach across applicable NFR areas.
Analyse and validate non-functional requirements (NFRs) and acceptance criteria.
Lead Non-Functional testing including performance, resilience, security, accessibility, operability, compatibility, scalability and recoverability.
Own the integrated non-functional test plan, aligning specialist activities with programme releases, environments and deployment milestones.
Coordinate delivery across specialist test leads, engineers, technology teams, Guidewire and third-party suppliers.
Define non-functional entry, exit and assurance criteria, ensuring results are supported by appropriate evidence.
Identify, manage and escalate non-functional testing risks, issues, dependencies, constraints and coverage gaps.
Desirable Professional Qualifications
ISTQB Advanced Test Manager or relevant specialist testing certification.
Performance testing qualifications or practical expertise using tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad or k6.
Security testing knowledge aligned with OWASP or relevant CREST practices. Accessibility knowledge aligned with WCAG 2.2.
Cloud certification such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or relevant Guidewire Cloud training.
Project Test Delivery Management Certifications e.g. PRINCE2 Practitioner/ Association of Project Management (APM)/ Agile Project Management (APMG)
Organisation Level
Workstream Leadership
Essential Skills Experience Lead and own non-functional testing
NFR Strategy and Planning: Proven experience developing and implementing non-functional test approaches for complex enterprise programmes.
Coverage and Prioritisation: Ability to translate business, technical and operational risks into a proportionate NFR test scope.
Specialist Leadership Experience: Proven experience coordinating performance, security, resilience, accessibility and operational-readiness disciplines through specialists leads and engineers.
Drive non-functional testing excellence
Innovation and Best Practices: Experience in fostering a culture of testing innovation and adopting industry best practices.
Specialist Knowledge: Strong understanding of performance, resilience, security, accessibility, operability and compatibility testing.
Shift-left Approach: Ability to embed early non-functional testing into programme lifecycle.
Problem Solving: Strong problem-solving skills to address testing challenges and provide effective solutions.
Assure requirements and deliverables
NFR Assurance Experience: Experience establishing traceability between NFRs, technical risks, test coverage, evidence and acceptance.
Test Risk Management: Ability to identify and mitigate testing risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Test Review and Standards: Experience in conducting test reviews and ensuring adherence to standards and guidelines.
Readiness Assurance: Experience assessing specialist test approaches, environments, tooling, test data, monitoring and execution prerequisites.
Support and Test Readiness
NFR Readiness: Ensure NFRs, acceptance criteria and test scope are sufficiently defined before test execution.
Environment Tooling Readiness: Coordinate readiness of environments, tooling, monitoring and observability required across NFR disciplines.
Test Data Dependencies: Ensure required test data, interfaces, integrations and external dependencies are identified and available.
Readiness Assessment: Identify and escalate readiness gaps, risks and constraints that could impact NFR delivery or release milestones.
Collaborate and communicate
Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex technical findings into clear business impacts, risks and decision points.
Clear Communication: Strong communication skills to articulate testing concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Accountability and Governance: Proven ability to establish ownership boundaries across specialist leads, engineers, delivery teams and suppliers.
NFR Assurance and Reporting
Performance Monitoring: Proficiency in defining, tracking, and reporting on key test performance indicators (KPIs).
Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to analyse testing metrics and make informed decisions based on data.
Progress Reporting: Experience in providing regular updates on test progress, challenges, and solutions to senior management and stakeholders.
NFR Test Report: Own the consolidated Non-Functional Test Report, summarising test outcomes, risks, residual issues and overall NFR quality assessment.

Description:
Key Accountabilities
Lead performance testing across the programme, aligned to the overall Non-Functional Test Approach.
Own the approach for load, stress, endurance, scalability, volume and capacity testing.
Define realistic workload models covering user volumes, transaction mix, concurrency, peak periods and batch processing.
Lead scripting, execution, monitoring, analysis and investigation across performance test cycles.
Identify performance bottlenecks across applications, APIs, integrations, databases and infrastructure, working with engineering teams to drive resolution.
Ensure performance environments, tooling, test data, monitoring and dependencies are ready for execution.
Own the Performance Test Report, providing clear assessment against NFRs and highlighting defects, constraints and residual risks.
Desirable Professional Qualifications
ISTQB Certified Tester Performance Testing (CT-PT) or equivalent.
Relevant LoadRunner, JMeter, k6/Grafana or performance engineering certification/training.
Microsoft Azure or equivalent cloud certification.
Relevant Guidewire Cloud / Guidewire platform training or experience.
Performance Test Expertise
Extensive experience in performance, load, stress, endurance and scalability testing for complex enterprise solutions.
Strong expertise in performance testing tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter or equivalent.
Strong knowledge of workload modelling, concurrency, throughput, response-time analysis and capacity modelling.
Proven experience diagnosing performance bottlenecks and scalability constraints across complex distributed systems.
Experience interpreting production volumes and usage patterns to develop realistic performance models.
Good understanding of capacity, scalability, resilience and cloud-performance engineering principles.
Leadership Experience
Performance Leadership: Proven experience leading performance testing and engineering within large transformation programmes.
Team Leadership: Strong collaboration, technical-direction and mentoring experience across performance engineering teams.
Cross-Team Delivery: Extensive experience working with engineering, architecture, infrastructure, database, cloud and supplier teams.
Technical Expertise
Strong understanding of web applications, APIs, microservices, databases, integrations and cloud-based architectures.
Experience using APM and observability tools to correlate application, infrastructure and database performance.
Strong diagnostic skills across CPU, memory, network, database, application runtime and cloud-resource utilisation.
Guidewire Experience: Guidewire Cloud performance-testing experience is highly desirable.
Communication Analytical Skills
Excellent communication skills to effectively communicate with stakeholders and articulate test reporting and risk.
Proven ability to communicate performance findings, defects and risks clearly.
Strong analytical capability to interpret complex performance results and identify root causes.
Ability to translate technical performance findings into service impact, risk and actionable recommendations.
Experience presenting performance evidence and recommendations to stakeholders.
Problem Solving
Diagnostic Analysis: Strong experience isolating performance bottlenecks across application, database, integration, network and infrastructure layers.
Root-Cause Investigation: Ability to correlate load-test results with APM, logs and infrastructure metrics.
Decision-Making: Demonstrable ability to recommend proportionate remediation and risk-treatment options under delivery pressure.

Description:
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
- Own the technical data test approach, covering data migration, transformation, reconciliation and downstream data flows.
- Lead data testing across Data Migration, Policy Migration, Pricing, DataHub/InfoCenter, Cloud Data Access and SDP.
- Coordinate SQL/database-level validation/reconciliation, ETLs, interface/file validation and automated data comparison where appropriate.
- Own technical data risks, defects and exceptions, ensuring material discrepancies are quantified, resolved or formally accepted.
- Identifying environments, test data, resources, business SMEs and cross-workstream dependencies and related risks and mitigations.
- Provide consolidated technical data assurance to support migration readiness and go-live decisions.
DESIRABLE PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
- ISTQB Advanced Test Manager or relevant specialist testing certification.
- Project Test Delivery Management Certifications e.g. PRINCE2 Practitioner / APM / APMG.
- Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals or equivalent cloud-data qualification.
- Relevant SQL, database or data-engineering certification.
ORGANISATION LEVEL
- Workstream Leadership
- Client Confidential
ESSENTIAL SKILLS EXPERIENCE
Lead and own testing activities
- Data Test Leadership: Proven experience defining and implementing technical data test approaches for complex migration and transformation programmes.
- Data Test Planning: Experience of leading and coordinating data test cycles through programme milestones.
- Technical Data Testing: Extensive hands-on experience of complex data migration testing, ETL/ELT validation, SQL, source-to-target reconciliation and data-quality assurance.
Drive Testing Excellence
- Data Quality: Establish consistent validation across completeness, accuracy, integrity, consistency, uniqueness and referential integrity.
- Automation: Drive automated data comparison and reconciliation where this provides repeatability, scale and earlier feedback.
- Shift Left: Engage early with data mapping, transformation rules and migration design to identify defects before formal migration test cycles.
Assure test deliverables
- Test Deliverable Assurance: Assure data test plans, scenarios, reconciliation rules, scripts, expected results and evidence.
- Traceability: Ensure technical data requirements, mappings and key migration risks are traceable to appropriate validation.
- Reconciliation Assurance: Ensure appropriate record-level, aggregate and control-total reconciliation is performed and evidenced.
Support and Test Readiness
- Data Test Readiness: Ensure mappings, transformation rules, data requirements and acceptance criteria are sufficiently defined before execution.
- Environment Tooling: Ensure source/target environments, database access, reconciliation tooling and required test utilities are available.
- Test Data Readiness: Ensure representative datasets, expected results and baseline/reference data are available and controlled.
Collaborate and Communicate
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Excellent collaboration skills to work effectively with stakeholders, including product owners, scrum masters, and other leads.
- Clear Communication: Strong communication skills to articulate testing concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Team Coordination: Experience in coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure cohesive and aligned testing efforts.
Manage and report test metrics
- Data Test Report: Own the consolidated Technical Data Test Report, summarising coverage across source systems, reconciliation outcomes, exceptions, defects and residual data risks.
- Reconciliation: Track migrated, reconciled, rejected, failed and exception records, including reconciliation percentages and agreed tolerances.
- Data Quality: Report trends across completeness, accuracy, integrity, consistency and other applicable data-quality dimensions.
- Defect Risk Management: Lead management and escalation of data quality issues, migration defects, exceptions and residual risks.

- Own the E2E Functional Test Approach and Plan, aligned to the Programme Test Strategy, business processes and programme roadmap.
- Lead the identification, design, prioritisation and execution of critical E2E business and customer journeys.
- Ensure traceability from business processes, requirements, features and risks to E2E scenarios, execution and evidence.
- Lead and coach the E2E test team, promoting consistent risk-based and shift-left testing practices.
- Coordinate environments, test data, resources, business SMEs and cross-workstream dependencies. Raise appropriate risks in a timely manner.
- Support capability improvements across automation, environments, data, tooling and test processes.
- Own the consolidated E2E Functional Test Report, providing an evidence-based view of quality, residual risk and readiness.
Desirable Professional Qualifications
- ISTQB Advanced Test Management/Test Analyst or equivalent.
- Guidewire PolicyCenter / BillingCenter / Guidewire Cloud experience or certification desirable.
- CII insurance qualification advantageous.
- Azure DevOps and Playwright experience advantageous.
Organisation Level
- Workstream Leadership
- Client Confidential
Essential Skills Experience
Test Expertise
- E2E Testing Expertise: Proven experience leading complex E2E functional testing spanning multiple systems, business processes/journeys and delivery teams.
- Insurance Knowledge: Strong understanding of policy, billing, payments, documents and downstream processes.
- Test Assurance: Ability to ensure coverage, traceability, evidence and defects collectively demonstrate that intended business outcomes have been achieved.
Leadership
- E2E Delivery Leadership: Proven experience leading E2E functional testing across multiple workstreams, systems and suppliers.
- Scope Management: Experience defining clear boundaries between Sprint testing, SIT, E2E testing and UAT.
- Team Leadership: Demonstrable experience directing, coaching and developing E2E testers.
Strategic Mindset
- Risk-Based Testing: Strong ability to prioritise journeys using business criticality, customer impact, complexity and change risk.
- Lifecycle Alignment: Experience using Sprint and SIT assurance to focus E2E testing on complete business outcomes.
- Regression Strategy: Experience designing maintainable, risk-based E2E regression coverage.
Communication Skills
- Communication and Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills to effectively communicate with stakeholders and articulate test approaches and risks.
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage business SMEs, Product Owners, Test Leads and delivery teams.
- Dependency Management: Coordinate cross-workstream dependencies, test data and readiness.
- Quality Reporting: Clearly communicate coverage, defects, risks and E2E readiness.
Forward-Thinking
- Problem Solving: Strong experience analysing complex cross-system test issues, coordinating resolution and making evidence-based decisions under pressure.
- Shift Left: Identify critical E2E journeys early in requirements and solution design.
- Automation: Identify stable, high-value journeys suitable for E2E automation.
- Continuous Improvement: Use test outcomes and defects to improve future E2E coverage.

Executive Indirect Taxation (Bhiwadi & Bangalore location)

The Executive Indirect Taxation will support the tax function by ensuring accurate GST compliance, audit readiness, strategic liaison and effective stakeholder communication within a dynamic environment. This role focuses on the timely filing of returns, accurate reconciliation of tax ledgers, data analysis, process Improvement and supporting the teams during statutory audits and assessments.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare, review, and file periodic GST returns ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Conduct GST audit activities, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Interpret and apply GST rules, acts, and notifications to business transactions.
Timely coordinate with internal stakeholders and external tax authorities for dispute resolution and clarifications.
Generate management information system (MIS) reports to aid decisionmaking and highlight compliance risks.
Communicate tax implications and solutions to crossfunctional teams, facilitating problem identification and resolution.

Required Skills & Experience
58 years of handson experience in indirect taxation, predominantly GST, within the manufacturing sector who has handle huge volumes of data.
Proven ability to file GST returns and perform GST audits with minimal supervision.
Strong knowledge of GST Acts, rules, and recent amendments.
Excellent liaisoning and networking skills to interact with tax authorities, auditors, and internal departments.
Proficient in tax compliance software and advanced Excel, Power Point for MIS reporting.
Effective written and verbal communication, have ability to understand and act quickly, hard-working, proactive.

Preferred Qualifications
Professional certification such as B.Com, CMA (Inter) or CA (Inter),
Experience using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) for tax data extraction.

About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Job Purpose

The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.

Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.
Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications:
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage
