Position description: As a Store Manager, you will lead the operations of your business unit while ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers. Your key responsibilities will include:

Primary Responsibilities:
1. Operational Leadership:

? Day-to-Day Management: Oversee the smooth running of the store, maintaining high standards across all operations, and ensuring legal compliance, particularly regarding pricing and product display.

? Procedure Adherence: Execute operational procedures efficiently, ensuring consistency and excellence in areas such as housekeeping, fitting rooms, and checkout processes.

? Quality Control: Monitor product quality, address any issues swiftly, and communicate feedback to the merchandising team to uphold superior product standards.

2. Sales Performance Management:

? Target Achievement: Drive and monitor the achievement of sales goals for your department. You?ll also play a key role in setting realistic yet ambitious targets, with the flexibility to adapt based on performance trends.

? Sales Analysis: Track sales performance continuously, taking timely corrective actions when necessary to meet or exceed sales objectives.

? Team Communication: Regularly share updates on department, store, and regional performance with your team, ensuring transparency and motivating everyone towards common goals.

3. Customer Experience:

? Customer Service Excellence: Lead by example in delivering exceptional customer service, creating a welcoming atmosphere for every visitor.

? Building Relationships: Understand customer needs, cultivate rapport, and establish loyal relationships with key clientele.

? Handling Feedback: Take ownership of customer complaints and queries, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolutions that turn challenges into positive outcomes.

4. Visual Merchandising Store Presentation:

? Merchandising Standards: Ensure that all visual merchandising guidelines are followed to create an attractive and engaging shopping environment.

? Continuous Improvement: Provide constructive feedback to visual merchandisers to enhance the store's visual appeal and product presentation.

5. Shrinkage Inventory Control:

? Loss Prevention: Implement best practices to minimize shrinkage by training staff on merchandise handling and stock protection, safeguarding store assets.

6. Team Development Leadership:

? Training Development: Facilitate on-the-job training, product knowledge sessions, and visual merchandising workshops to equip your team with the skills needed for success.

? Role Clarity Task Delegation: Clearly define roles and responsibilities for each team member, ensuring accountability and efficient task management.

? Constructive Feedback: Regularly provide feedback that helps your team identify strengths and areas for improvement, fostering continuous personal and professional growth.

? Motivation Engagement: Inspire your team to not only meet sales targets but also to follow operational procedures with enthusiasm and dedication.

7. Cashier Support Training:

? Support Supervision: Assist in the training of cashiers and provide ongoing support to ensure smooth operations at checkout, contributing to a positive customer experience.

Job Summary
Function Summary Relationship Associate plays a pivotal role in driving business growth by managing branch relationships and collaborating with Axis Bank sellers. The role involves lead conversion, ensuring process adherence, and supporting operational excellence. The incumbent will be responsible for meeting business targets and maintaining customer satisfaction. This position requires consistent coordination with stakeholders and adherence to company guidelines.
Job Summary Manages branches, collaborates with the objective to support and contribute to Axis Bank strategy, achieve operations excellence, ensure systems are deployed and help build the channel within the company guidelines and the achieve business targets.
Responsibilities
Managing relationship with Axis Branch Sellers and thereby meeting target through Bank s FOS
Responsible for managing the leads generated from Branch and thereby convert into quality business.
Must adhere to the process set and timely coordinate with Cluster Manager and Operations HUB. Ensuring minimal customer complain.
Shall adhere to agreed TATs on first customer contact and follow-ups from the date of the lead being registered.
Ensuring 15month persistency on track and thereby ensure a robust follow up mechanism with the customers.
Coordinating with Cluster Training manager to ensure bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Shall be responsible for making active the branch banking sellers and thereby achieving the activation target
Ensuring LMS usage as Tracking Mechanism on line and follow up Calls
Key Competencies / Skills
Excellent Relationship Skill
Managing Various level of Bank Management
Adherence to Process
Qualifications and Experience
Graduate in Any Discipline from a UGC / AICTE approved College and University.
1 to 2 years of experience in sales, experience in Insurance will be preferred.
Experience in the fields of Life insurance sales management, Retail bank distribution, and Channel Management and/or DSA relationship

Description:
Business Development Manager- Franchise
Immediate Superior: Senior Manager - Real Estate
Experience- 5-7 years of work experience in Franchisee store expansion
Location - Geographical Understanding; Bihar, Orissa, Jharkhand
This job description reflects the general details considered necessary to describe the principle functions of the job identified and shall not be construed as a detailed description of all of the work requirements that may be inherent in the job.
Bata India believes in building a culture of Collaboration, Accountability, Responsibility, Agility Innovation where every employee is proud of making a difference. We are an inclusive workplace and encourage diverse talent, views and competences which contribute towards our innovation journey.
Primary responsibilities:
Real Estate Site Selection and Analysis
To identify and evaluate all real estate opportunities through site visits, site selection metrics and criteria, demographic analysis and research to ensure the best locations for the brand are secured
To manage metrics and criteria for which site selection decisions will be made (research analytics, financial performance, revenue prediction models)
To identify franchise opportunities with multiple and cross border landlords to achieve best possible deal making
To manage external Real Estate resources in locating and evaluating potential sites, especially the cross-border strategic landlords
To work closely with all key stakeholders such as franchisees, retail, sales, store development teams to ensure the right site selection, lease negotiation and finalization.
Identify relocation Opportunities in the region
Renegotiations of Non- Performing stores for Rent reduction or closure terms.
Competitor and Market Analysis
Lease Negotiations
To negotiate letters of intent and key lease deal points to the brands advantage for new stores
To present the Bata retail concepts to prospective landlords
To evaluate existing store portfolio to actively drive rent reductions, recommend lease renewals and terminations and negotiate renewals and extensions where appropriate
Negotiate the extension terms of the store which are near to epiry period along with the Retail Manager
Management of Lease Administration
Liaison with Landlords/Mall Owner/Property dealers.
Complete or review appropriate legal documents and forms related to the rent or lease.
Prepare detailed budgets and financial reports for properties.
Development of vendors for effective real estate management.
Manage the properties in the most efficient and profitable manner possible in the existing market conditions consistent with the goals and objectives of the company
Effectively maintain knowledge of property and competitive Properties practices through consistent evaluation of market conditions and trends
Evaluate and recommend changes on rent/pricing strategies.
Interact regularly with the landlord, developer and property consultants for the region

Job Summary
The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience, especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment - Develop various sources of agent hiring, build a team of agent pipeline.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring.
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects - Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms.

Customer Centricity - Be AMLI brand ambassador, a customer champion.
Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty.
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need.
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.


Measures of Success
Achievement of business plan GPA
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications / Requirements
Sales background
Minimum 2 Years Experience , At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Location: BANGALORE
Work Mode: Work from Office + Field Visits
Experience: Property Sales preferred

Salary -17000 per month fixed

About the Role

We are looking for a Business Development Associate (BDA) who will work closely with property owners and prospective tenants to facilitate property transactions and close deals.

The candidate will receive leads from the company, visit properties with clients, understand owner requirements, identify potential tenants, and drive the deal to closure.

Key Responsibilities
Handle company-generated leads and connect with potential clients/tenants.
Visit properties and show them to prospective tenants/clients.
Travel approximately 3040 km daily for property visits and client meetings.
Understand and manage property owner requirements.
Identify suitable and potential tenants based on property requirements.
Coordinate between property owners and tenants throughout the transaction.
Conduct property visits, explain property details, and address client queries.
Negotiate and follow up with both parties to close the deal.
Maintain regular follow-ups with leads until closure.
Build strong relationships with property owners and clients.
Maintain updated records of leads, property visits, follow-ups, and closures.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Real estate knowledge is preferred.
Good understanding of property types, location, configuration, and surface/built-up/carpet area.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation, and sales skills.
Comfortable with daily field travel of 3040 km.
Ability to understand client and owner requirements and match them effectively.
Target-oriented and strong in follow-ups.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple property/client requirements.
Ideal Candidate

Someone who is sales-driven, confident in client interactions, comfortable with field work, and has a good understanding of the real estate market.

If you enjoy meeting clients, exploring properties, and closing real estate deals, this role is for you!e & responsibilities

Job Summary:
Manage defined workstreams within GBS / GCC and operating model transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high-quality outputs within agreed timelines
Own and lead projects - guiding team, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
Manage client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks, and supporting models for GBS / SSC setup and transformation assignments
Apply a process and operating-model perspective across GBS design, governance, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as Gen AI-enabled processes
Lead business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development
Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends
Roles & Responsibilities:
GBS / GCC Strategy and Setup: Lead analysis of operating model options (centralized, federated, hybrid) and build-operate setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GBS guiding principles, and process taxonomy (L0-L5) design for new and scaling shared services
Operating Model Design: Design integrated operating models for GBS / GCC setups, including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization planning considerations independently
Operating Model: Manage the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of the Operating Model by analyzing processes, roles, governance, and performance metrics to enable efficient service delivery
Cost Analysis and Value Realization: Lead analysis and detailed cost model development covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GBS and transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit and savings delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
Org Design and Sizing: Design organization structures for the GBS / SSC and retained teams - roles, spans and layers, reporting lines, and FTE sizing methodologies
SSC Location Strategy: Lead location assessment and selection studies across cost, talent availability, risk, and scalability dimensions to recommend best-fit delivery locations for shared services
KPI and Performance Frameworks: Design KPI and SLA frameworks for GBS performance management, covering operational, financial, service, and experience metrics; develop dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
Capability Maturity Assessment: Conduct structured maturity assessments across functions and processes against leading-practice benchmarks; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
Governance, RACI and Interaction Model Design: Design governance frameworks (councils, decision rights, escalation paths), RACI matrices, and interaction models defining roles and collaboration patterns between the GBS, retained organization, business units, and third-party providers
Operating Model Design: Design integrated operating models for GBS / GCC setups, including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization planning considerations
Gen AI in Functions: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on Gen AI and intelligent automation use cases across functional processes - such as AP invoice processing, reconciliations, close acceleration, and management reporting


Qualification
Professional & Technical Skills:
12-15 years of total experience in GBS consulting, operating model, functional transformation, or advisory, or in-house shared services; experience at a top-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
Experience leading workstreams in GBS / GCC design, functional operating model, or shared services engagements
Working knowledge of at least 2-3 of the following: GBS / GCC / SSC setup, operating model design, sourcing & location strategy, org design & sizing, process maturity assessment, governance & interaction model design
Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks and GBS transformation contexts
Experience designing KPI and SLA frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches - capability, process, or operating-model maturity - and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
Familiarity with core functional processes and process taxonomy frameworks such as the L0-L5 process hierarchy
Understanding of ERP and digital technologies (e.g. SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) and automation tools such as RPA and process mining
Awareness of Gen AI adoption in one or more functions including intelligent automation use cases and their implications for GBS process and workforce design
Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills
Additional Information:
Opportunity to work on GBS / GCC and operating model programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries
Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client-facing responsibilities as part of high-performing delivery teams
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Description:
SAP CPI Consultant JD

About the Role

We are looking for experienced SAP CPI Consultants to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting integration solutions using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and SAP Integration Suite.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP CPI, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Scripting, OData Services, API integrations, and cloud-based integration scenarios. Experience in implementation, migration, enhancement, and support projects is highly preferred.

Location: Bangalore,Chennai,Mysuru,Noida,Nagpur,Mumbai,Hyderabad,Kolkata,Coimbatore,Thiruvanandhapuram,Mangaluru,etc

Experience: JL4: 2-5 Years | JL5: 5-9 Years

Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, and support integration solutions using SAP CPI and SAP Integration Suite.
Develop and maintain iFlows for cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-on-premise integrations.
Create and enhance integration scenarios using SOAP, REST, IDoc, RFC, and OData services.
Develop custom integration logic using Groovy Scripts.
Configure adapters, mappings, content modifiers, routers, and exception handling mechanisms.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration interfaces.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand business requirements and integration needs.
Perform unit testing, SIT, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare technical specifications and integration documentation.
Participate in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects.
Support SAP S/4HANA integration initiatives.
Ensure adherence to integration best practices, security standards, and governance processes.
Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in SAP CPI/Integration Suite.
B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MBA or any Postgraduate degree.
Mandatory Skills
SAP CPI, SAP Cloud Platform Integration, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Script, OData Services, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Message Mapping, API Integration, SAP Cloud Platform.
Good to Have Skills
SAP PO/PI, Event Mesh, SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA Integration, Cloud Foundry, API Management, Open Connectors, GitHub, CI/CD, Java.

Description:
About the Role:
Hurix Digital is looking for an accomplished business and operations leader to lead the next phase of growth across our Content, Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This is a senior enterprise leadership role with responsibility for business operations, delivery, revenue realization, profitability, customer success, people leadership and organizational capability. The EVP will work closely with the CEO and the leadership team to build a predictable,profitable and scalable operating organizationone that delivers consistently for customers,develops strong leaders and enables sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Business & P&L Leadership
Own operational performance across Content, Technology and AI Data Services.
Drive revenue realization, gross margin, EBITDA, productivity, utilization and cost optimization.
Lead annual operating plans, forecasting, capacity planning and business reviews.
Partner closely with Finance, Sales and business leaders to make informed decisions on growth, investments, costs and profitability.
Ensure that signed business translates into successful, profitable and sustainable delivery. The role should carry genuine business accountability; the earlier EVP framework similarly linked the position directly to growth, profitability, revenue and margin outcomes.

Delivery & Operational Excellence
Build a strong operating rhythm through dashboards, metrics, forecasting, reviews and early-warning mechanisms.
Strengthen delivery governance and establish a high-performing PMO Excellence capability.
Improve predictability across quality, timelines, capacity, productivity and margins.
Build systems and processes that reduce dependence on firefighting and individual heroics.
Drive continuous improvement through technology, automation and AI-enabled workflows.

Customer Leadership
Act as a senior executive sponsor for strategic customers.
Build strong relationships with customer leadership teams and participate actively in QBRs, reviews and critical engagements.
Lead major escalations and ensure strong recovery and closure.
Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales on solutioning, commercials, feasibility and transition of new opportunities.
Identify opportunities for account expansion and deeper customer partnerships.

People & Leadership
Build and develop a strong second line of leaders across operations and delivery.
Assess leadership capability, identify talent risks early and take decisive action where the organization needs stronger talent.
Coach high-potential leaders and create clear succession and development plans.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and high performance.
Be a visible and accessible leader, especially during critical business and delivery situations.
Ensure that business growth is achieved without compromising team health,leadership quality or organizational sustainability.
People and customer outcomes were already explicit components of the prior EVP incentive framework through Client Happiness, Team Happiness and People/Customer/Revenue Impact.

AI Data Services & Technology
Play a key role in scaling Hurixs emerging AI Data Services business.
Bring strong business understanding of data operations, human-in-the-loop models,expert talent ecosystems, quality, throughput, productivity and margin.
Strengthen the Technology business by connecting technology capability with customer needs, solutions and profitable delivery.
Drive practical adoption of AI and automation across operations to improve speed,quality and business economics.

Enterprise Leadership
Operate as a trusted partner to the CEO and leadership team.
Provide clear visibility into business performance, risks, customer concerns and people issues.
Surface problems early, bring data-backed recommendations and take ownership for execution.
Work effectively across Sales, Finance, HR, Solutions and other functions to drive enterprise outcomes.
Act as a strong leadership presence on the ground and help translate strategy into execution.

Experience & Background:
We are looking for a leader with approximately 20+ years of experience, including significant responsibility for large-scale operations, delivery or business-unit leadership.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
Meaningful P&L and business ownership, beyond project or delivery management.
Experience leading large, complex and multi-disciplinary teams.
Strong track record of driving revenue realization, profitability, productivity and operational predictability.
Executive-level customer management and experience handling strategic accounts.
Demonstrated ability to build strong leadership teams and second-line capability.
Strong numerical and analytical orientation with experience using dashboards,forecasting and operating metrics.
Experience in solutioning, pre-sales, commercials and transition from Sales to Delivery.
Exposure to AI/Data Services, technology services, digital services, learning/content services or adjacent knowledge-intensive businesses.
Strong partnership experience with Finance on business planning, revenue, cost and profitability.
Experience working with global customers and distributed teams.
Prior experience in digital learning or content services is valuable but not mandatory.
We are equally interested in leaders from technology, data and digital services who bring the right combination of business, customer, people and operating leadership.

Leadership Traits We Value
We are looking for someone who can combine:
Structure without bureaucracy.
Speed without chaos.
Customer obsession without organizational burnout.
Commercial ambition with delivery discipline.
High standards with strong people leadership.
Data-driven thinking with sound judgement.


Values:
Get stuff done
Move fast with purpose
Win with ideas
Sweat the details
Deliver great customer experiences
Make your teammate successful


Perks:
Health Insurance
Kwench Library (Klib)
Employee Assistance Program (Free Counseling Service)
Hybrid Work Model
Flexi Reimbursement Basket
Paid Time off
Level up your skills with company-based sponsorship.
Tech reimbursement.

Why Join Hurix Digital?
Hurix Digital is building on its established strength in global content and digital learning while expanding its Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This role offers the opportunity to influence not just how work is delivered, but how businesses scale, how leaders are built, how customers experience Hurix and how the operating model evolves in an AI-first environment. For the right leader, this is a high-impact enterprise role with significant autonomy, visibility and the opportunity to shape Hurixs next phase of growth.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.
Location
Bangalore (Hybrid/Onsite/Remote)
Employment Type
Full-time

IKS Health enables the enhanced delivery of exceptional healthcare for todays practicing clinicians, medical
groups and health systems. Supporting healthcare providers through every function of the patient visit, IKS

Revenue Optimizations Services:Our purpose built Revenue Optimization Services reduces administrative

From a Unified Data Platform to Robotic Process Automation and creating bespoke technology solutions

Description:
As a Databricks + Agentic AI Manager you will lead client support work within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice, focused on data engineering solutions that turn raw data into usable insights and support data pipelines, integration, and transformation efforts. As a Manager you will lead teams, coach junior professionals, manage performance, and guide delivery across multiple workstreams while bringing judgment, business knowledge, and a practical approach to technology and innovation. In this role at PwC, you will help shape work around Databricks and agentic AI, coordinate deliverables, support client needs, and contribute to solutions that strengthen data infrastructure and analytics capabilities within PwC Acceleration Center Bangalore.
Responsibilities
- Leading data engineering workstreams that design and build Databricks and Azure-based data pipelines for client solutions
- Managing project planning, prioritization, and delivery across data integration, transformation, and validation efforts
- Guiding teams through development of data lake, data warehouse, and lakehouse architectures that support analytics use cases
- Reviewing solution designs for data modeling, performance tuning, query optimization, and database reliability
- Coaching team members on Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, and Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform implementation methods
- Translating business requirements into scalable data infrastructure and pipeline designs that support AI-enabled workflows
- Coordinating delivery across technical stakeholders to address data quality, security, and operational issues
- Applying analytical thinking to identify dependencies, risks, and opportunities across complex data environments
- Supporting client-facing engagements by communicating technical progress, design choices, and delivery milestones
- Promoting responsible use of agentic AI, automation, and cloud data tooling in modern data engineering solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Mathematical Statistics
- Demonstrating Databricks platform delivery across data modernization initiatives
- Applying Agentic AI concepts to client-facing data engineering solutions
- Managing project planning, budgeting, execution, and delivery
- Mentoring teams through complex data architecture decisions
- Translating business needs into scalable analytics design
- Navigating ambiguity while advancing quality and timelines

Description:
As an AES Guidewire ClaimCenter Business Analyst Senior Associate you will help shape and support Guidewire ClaimCenter work within our Advisory practice, focusing on business analysis, client support, and the delivery of enhancements that improve insurance operations and user experience. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful client relationships, mentor junior team members, and apply critical thinking to navigate ambiguity while strengthening your personal brand and technical skills. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will contribute to Application Evolution Services for Guidewire by gathering requirements, interpreting feedback, evaluating process impacts, and supporting solution development for deployed ClaimCenter environments.
Responsibilities
Demonstrates expert abilities managing ITIL Processes; Tracking SLAs, and contracting;
- Demonstrates advanced abilities providing solution strategy and Application Evolution Services (AES, formerly AMS) delivery as a Guidewire Functional Lead. Employees in the Functional Lead position should think of themselves and be regarded by the client as a trusted advisor and think strategically about how to create value using the Guidewire Suite of products;
- Demonstrates expert abilities with ITIL Incident and Problem management for the Guidewire Suite of applications as it will be critical that Senior Business Analyst in this position are capable of navigating both business processes as well as enterprise solution perspectives at high level and holistic view;
- Demonstrates expert abilities and/or a proven record of success in leading proposal development efforts; Senior Business Analyst in these positions should be capable of delivering Advisory-level work and be able to discuss future enhancements in Guidewire roadmap discussions with the client;
- With a focus on AES, demonstrates expert organization skills and abilities assisting clients in the support of Guidewire Suite solutions and improving business processes; and taking a proactive approach to quality;
- Analyzing Guidewire ClaimCenter business needs and translating them into functional requirements for insurance operations
- Supporting client service workstreams across enhancements, defect resolution, and production support for deployed Guidewire solutions
- Configuring and validating Guidewire ClaimCenter functionality while coordinating with technical teams on integrations and system changes
- Reviewing user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria to clarify scope and identify implementation impacts
- Interpreting business feedback and data points to recommend process improvements and application adjustments
- Mentoring junior team members on Guidewire concepts, delivery methods, and issue resolution approaches
- Collaborating across application, testing, and support teams to track work progress and address dependencies
- Applying problem-solving skills to diagnose system issues, evaluate options, and support timely resolution of incidents and enhancements
- Contributing to continuous improvement efforts by identifying automation, tooling, and process opportunities within application support
What You Must Have
- Expertise in ClaimCenter and working knowledge on Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ContactManager - leading requirement gathering sessions, conduct analysis, develop functional specifications and perform business walkthroughs;
- User story creation/updation, developing process flows, UI mock ups, and developing data mapping in the standard Guidewire recommended user stories;
- Familiarity with Use case, SWOT analysis, Mindmapping, PESTLE analysis; Product Designer
- Usage of Tools JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, Splunk and familiarity with SQL
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4-9 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

Strong knowledge of construction costing, budgeting, and estimation.

Timely and accurate cost estimation.

Job Description: Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer
Experience: 4 to 7 Years

Core Technologies: Google BigQuery (GBQ), dbt, Python, Informatica IICS, SQL
Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer with 47 years of experience in building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data engineering and data warehousing solutions. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Python, Google BigQuery, dbt, and Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS), along with a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL/ELT development.
The candidate will develop robust data pipelines, implement complex transformations, automate data engineering processes using Python, optimize BigQuery workloads, and deliver high-quality, analytics-ready datasets to support business intelligence and analytical use cases.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformation workflows using BigQuery, dbt, Informatica IICS, Python, and SQL.
Develop complex SQL queries and reusable transformation logic to process large volumes of data efficiently.
Build and maintain dbt models, including incremental models, data tests, documentation, and dependency management.
Develop Python scripts and utilities for data processing, pipeline automation, validation, reconciliation, and operational monitoring.
Use Python libraries and APIs to integrate data sources, automate repetitive tasks, and streamline data engineering workflows.
Develop and support ETL/ELT integrations using Informatica IICS, including mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, scheduling, and error handling.
Apply data warehousing principles to design dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions.
Optimize BigQuery query performance and cost through efficient SQL, partitioning, clustering, and execution-plan analysis.
Implement data quality checks, automated validations, reconciliation processes, and exception handling.
Troubleshoot pipeline failures, investigate data discrepancies, and resolve production issues.
Use Git and established CI/CD practices for source control, code reviews, testing, and deployments.
Collaborate with business analysts, BI developers, architects, and other engineering teams to deliver reliable, business-ready data products.
Maintain technical documentation and follow engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, and maintainability.
Required Technical Skills
1. Python
Strong hands-on programming experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
Proficiency in writing reusable, modular, and maintainable Python code, including functions, classes, exception handling, and logging.
Experience with data manipulation and processing using libraries such as Pandas and NumPy.
Ability to develop scripts for data validation, reconciliation, file processing, automation, and operational support.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, CSV, and other common data formats.
Understanding of Python package management, virtual environments, dependency management, and debugging.
Ability to write efficient code, handle large datasets, and implement robust error handling and logging.
2. Google BigQuery (GBQ)
Hands-on experience developing and optimizing complex SQL queries in BigQuery.
Strong understanding of datasets, tables, views, materialized views, and BigQuery architecture.
Experience with partitioning, clustering, query execution analysis, and cost optimization.
Ability to design scalable data models and efficiently process large datasets.
Familiarity with integrating BigQuery workloads with Python-based applications or automation.
3. dbt (Data Build Tool)
Hands-on experience developing and maintaining dbt models using SQL and Jinja.
Understanding of dbt project structure, model dependencies, materializations, and incremental models.
Experience implementing dbt tests, source definitions, documentation, and lineage.
Familiarity with Git integration, automated testing, and CI/CD-based deployments.
4. Informatica IICS
Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services for data integration and transformation.
Experience developing mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and data integration workflows.
Understanding of source-to-target mapping, scheduling, error handling, and operational monitoring.
Ability to troubleshoot and optimize ETL workflows.
5. Data Warehousing and SQL
Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture and ETL/ELT design patterns.
Expertise in dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and SCD Types 1 and 2.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, subqueries, and query optimization.
Understanding of staging, curated, and business-ready data layers, incremental loading, CDC concepts, and data quality management.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Functions.
Experience automating cloud operations and data workflows using Python and APIs.
Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux/Unix environments.
Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Power BI.
Exposure to Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and reusable data products.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using Jira.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4–7 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or ETL/ELT development.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Salesforce LwC, Senior Associate-AES Operate, you will engage with clients to analyze their needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Salesforce applications. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will leverage your broad range of consulting skills to help clients optimize operational efficiency and achieve their strategic objectives. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions while embracing increased ambiguity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will use a broad range of tools, methodologies, and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts. Your ability to interpret data will inform insights and recommendations, reinforcing professional and technical standards. This position offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and contribute to the success of our clients and the firm.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to implement Salesforce solutions that optimize operational efficiency
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Salesforce applications
- Collaborating with clients to understand their strategic objectives and align solutions accordingly
- Utilizing Salesforce Lightning and Salesforce Sales Cloud to enhance client business processes
- Developing and maintaining project architecture and budgeting for Salesforce implementations
- Engaging in business process modeling to improve client workflows and system integration
- Applying analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
- Supporting enterprise integration and technology implementation projects
- Creating and delivering training materials to facilitate client understanding and adoption of new technologies
- Embracing change and emerging technologies to drive innovation in client solutions
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune and Gurugram

Interview mode-Face to face
Locations-Chennai, Bangalore

Role Overview
The role involves assisting shareholders with buying and selling shares in accordance with established procedures and service standards. The candidate will also handle customer queries and provide operational support under appropriate guidance and supervision.

Key Responsibilities
Handle inbound calls and emails from shareholders, addressing their queries within agreed service standards.
Assist shareholders with share purchase and sale transactions over inbound calls.
Resolve basic customer queries and escalate complex issues to senior team members when necessary.
Support the team in completing daily workloads and meeting operational targets.
Continuously develop operational knowledge and skills while identifying opportunities to improve processes and service quality.
Perform additional duties of a similar nature as required.
Follow company policies, procedures, quality standards, and reporting requirements, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory and statutory obligations.
Carry out all responsibilities in accordance with the requirements of the company's regulators.
Adhere to established physical and information security procedures to protect company and customer information.
Ensure all activities comply with the applicable quality management system.
Follow scheduled break timings to maintain operational efficiency and meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Work according to the designated US business holiday calendar.

Required Skills, Experience, and Competencies
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and telephone communication skills, with strong active listening abilities.
Shift Flexibility: Willingness and ability to work in US shifts.
Customer Support Experience: Previous experience in a customer service or customer support role
Target Achievement: Ability to meet targets related to accuracy, quality, productivity, and agreed service levels.
CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and practices.
Data Protection and AML: Basic understanding of data protection principles and Anti-Money Laundering (AML).
Customer Focus: Ability to understand customer needs and adapt communication styles to different personalities.
Time Management: Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and manage time effectively.
Compliance and Process Adherence: Ability to follow established procedures, policies, and regulatory requirements.
Teamwork: Willingness to support team members and contribute beyond assigned responsibilities.

Description:
Join athenahealth as Senior Engineering Manager and lead the teams reimagining how healthcare reaches patients. Based in Bangalore, India, in a hybrid role, you will report to the Director of Engineering, Messaging. Youll drive delivery across multiple teams, run complex projects from plan to production, build and grow a high-performing team, and champion engineering excellence in everything we ship.

Team Summary:

athenahealth’s messaging platform connects thousands of practices with their patients, delivering millions of messages every day across text, voice, email and the patient portal. We are reimagining it as an intelligent, outcome-driven platform. Instead of sending fixed reminders, it decides the best next step for each patient and measures whether each message actually helped. As a Senior Engineering Manager on this team, you will lead engineers who are building the platform at scale, moving today’s experiences onto it, and using AI to make every patient touch count. Your leadership will shape a culture of quality, outcome, ownership and innovation in one of the most patient-facing parts of athenahealth.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

Drive engineering excellence through strong design principles, code quality, automated testing, observability, incident management and clear service ownership.
Build an inclusive, accountable and innovative engineering culture while maintaining a high bar for execution and technical craftsmanship.
Own planning, hiring strategy, talent development, succession planning, performance management and the growth of engineers across multiple teams.
Turn product roadmaps and architecture decisions into delivery plans, keep multiple pods moving in parallel, and make priority and trade-off decisions based on data.
Own the production health of the team’s services, including service levels, on-call, incident reviews, reliability and cost.
Lead adoption of AI-assisted, specification-driven development and automated validation to help teams deliver faster without compromising quality.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

Partner with product management, architecture, quality engineering and domain teams to align technical strategy with business outcomes.
Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed leaders, peers and stakeholders.
Facilitate knowledge sharing and spread best practices across engineering teams.
Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and machine learning, and recommend adopting those that improve outcomes or efficiency.
Represent engineering in program and project planning to align technical strategy with organizational goals.

Expected Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
12+ years of hands-on experience designing and building highly available distributed systems, microservices and data platforms.
Strong hands-on background in Java and Spring Boot, building and running production services on AWS.
At least 3 years of engineering leadership experience managing multiple teams and owning deliverables and outcomes.
Experience leading system design reviews, driving technical discussions and resolving complex engineering escalations.
Ability to make priority and trade-off decisions based on data.
Experience with, or exposure to, building products using AI and machine learning technologies.
Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with geographically distributed leaders, peers and stakeholders.
Excellent communication, leadership and presentation skills.
Experience with high-volume messaging or notification platforms (text, voice, email) is highly desirable.
Experience leading large platform modernizations or migrations is highly desirable.
Familiarity with healthcare regulations, patient consent and communication compliance is a plus.

Our thought leadership and unparalleled experience help clients turn formidable challenges into market advantage across the value chain and around the globe. In addition, consultants also support project lead, work directly with client teams, and facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize and prepare recommendations on client issues, and participate actively in new business development, thought leadership and firm building activities. PRACTICE OVERVIEW: WORKFORCE SOLUTIONS
At PwC, this team of consultants works with their US counterparts to develop both short and long-term Workforce Solutions for our clients. Our practitioners facilitate transformation by conducting strategic change initiatives, assisting transformative leadership initiatives, designing HR processes, developing, and implementing learning interventions that align with the clients business strategy. Some of our key capabilities include: 
HR Strategy & Operations 
NextGen Change  
Organization & Talent  
Rewards & Benefits 
Workforce Technology – Enabling Apps 
POSITION REQUIREMENTS: Key Responsibilities: As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growthAs such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to): Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies: 
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Bloom’s taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery – spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training. 
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 1–3 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements: 
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work. 
Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity. 
Self-motivated with a passion for client work and teamwork. 
Strong project management skills. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels. 
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs. 
Ability to develop and present new, innovative ideas and conceptualize new approaches and solutions. 
Will to learn, adopt and lead new ways of doing things (e.g., personas, journey mapping, gamification, etc.). 
Proficiency in leveraging GenAI tools to enhance productivity, analysis, and delivery quality. 
Ability to work with data to transform information into actionable insights. 
Foster an efficient, innovative, and team-oriented work environment.  
Strong work ethics, proactive, and professional behavior. 
Good-to-have
Effective storytelling and communication skills to various audiences (written and verbal). 
Strategic, creative thinker and problem solver. 
Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to assess training effectiveness. 
Supports engagement managers in delivering engagements by identifying and addressing client needs. 
Exhibits strong ability to work independently as well as in a highly collaborative team environment. 
Demonstrated experience supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring junior team members. 
Hands-on experience utilizing AI tools and capabilities such as prompt engineering, AI-assisted analysis, and creating workforce-specific solutions.

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Position Name-Senior Manager
Position Details
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, the Digital Senior Manager will be responsible for working closely and leading teams with associates, seniors, team leaders, assistant managers, and handling service delivery for an Area/Region/Solution/Sector. The principal objectives will be to ensure that consistent and high-quality service is provided by the team by taking end-to-end project ownership and accomplishing the define goals. The Innovation Manager is responsible for the overall success of implantation of solutions/ideas that can bring more business or can bring efficiencies by digitalize the manual work.
Requirements (including experience, skills and additional qualifications)
Requirement & Qualification
A Bachelor's/ Masters degree (BE/BTech/MCA/MTech & MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.
15-20 years experience (demonstrated competence, depth, and breadth) of operational and project/Program management experience
Strategize and outline goals and objectives of the program
Monitor multiple projects through the entire program cycle, Manage the daytoday detailed aspects of multiple projects, Coordinate and utilize resources for multiple projects in the program
Communicate program objectives, goals, and progress to program directors, executives, upper management, and stakeholders
Experience in independently leading the organization wide Tech Initiatives along with managing the delivery of those initiatives spanning across
Automation Robotics Process Automation, SharePoint/ React, .NET, Web Portal development, Cloud etc.
Transformation Business Process Reengineering, Business Process
Optimization
Data Visualization PowerBI, Spotfire etc.
Knowledge & ability to manage Financial Accounting engagements across domains
Ability to manage tight deadlines and multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously.
Prior experience with agile methodologies and practices
Awareness on cloud technologies is required
The individual will assist the management team in developing and coaching team members as well as ensuring that resources are deployed in the most effective manner
While the individual will be based at our Bangalore office, the role requires the person to travel to other countries on a short or long-term basis for client engagements.
Good to have
PMP Certifications or equivalent certification
Scrum Product Owner or Scrum Master Certifications
Key Responsibilities:
Develop strong relationship with onshore stakeholders (Areas leadership and champion network) and manage their expectations on service delivery
Building Centralized Data storage system
Building Data Strategies for the team
Built good understanding of Sources and Target sources by understanding the GDS Assurance Business.
Responsible for identifying and creating new service offerings/Solutions
Responsible for ensuring high quality consistent and efficient service is provided by the team to the Project teams of different areas/regions
Responsible for managing the operational aspects of Project management such as, resource management, Metrics & Reporting, performance management and elements of risk management
In addition, the Manager will be responsible to build strong relationships with local teams and clients, identifying areas where GDS can improve quality of, and increase the scope of work
Experience in coordinating projects and interdependencies between various projects within the program
Additional skills requirements:
Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility and self-discipline.
Must have demonstrated project management experience.
Knowledge of firms reporting tools and processes.
Proactive, organized and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
Analyses complex or unusual problems and is able to deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What working at EY offers
At EY, were dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way thats right for you
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

Leverage AI tools to enhance problem-solving capabilities
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success
Develop a deeper understanding of business contexts and needs
Engage effectively with stakeholders to gather requirements
Utilize critical thinking for structured problem-solving
Maintain rigorous standards in analytical deliverables
What You Must Have
Bachelor's or Master Degree
4 years of experience in data science or analytics
Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Statistics, or a related field
4+ years of experience in Python for data analysis and machine learning.
Familiarity with AI techniques and prompt engineering
Solid understanding of machine learning techniques and statistical analysis
Exposure to PySpark and large-scale data environments
Curiosity to explore new AI techniques
Ability to think structurally and approach problems clearly
Demonstrating ownership in fast-paced environments
Excelling in collaboration and stakeholder management skills

We are the makers of possible
BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.
Why Join Us?
A career at BD means learning and working alongside inspirational leaders and colleagues who are equally passionate and committed to fostering an inclusive, growth-centered, and rewarding culture. You will have the opportunity to help shape the trajectory of BD while leaving a legacy at the same time.
To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. Become a maker of possible with us!

• Design and implement microservice-based applications using Python and

• Optimize application performance and ensure responsiveness, reliability, and
scalability.
• Implement automated testing, unit testing, and CI/CD pipelines; perform debugging
and code quality improvements.
• Containerize and orchestrate services using Docker and Kubernetes; deploy on
Azure/AWS/GCP (PaaS and IaaS).
• Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists and ML engineers to integrate
models.
• Follow best practices for security and documentation.

• 6+ years as a full stack or backend developer with proficiency in Python; fair to
strong experience with JavaScript frameworks/libraries (Angular, React).
• Strong software development skills across design, development, testing,
deployment, and maintenance of large-scale applications.
• Experience with RESTful APIs, asynchronous request handling, and ORM.
• Ability to build feature rich full stack AI integrated applications.
• Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and data storage solutions; data
processing/manipulation and bulk data operations.
• Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD.
• Working experience deploying to Azure, AWS, or GCP.
• Strong unit testing and debugging skills; strong experience with version control (Git).
• Understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, multimodal
applications, agentic frameworks (fundamental level).
• Experience with data/ML frameworks and tools (PyTorch, LangChain, Autogen).
• Strong in data structures, architecture, and design; familiarity with Python threading
limitations and multi-process architecture.
• Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills; adherence to
security practices.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and cloud-native/serverless patterns (Azure
Functions, AWS Lambda).
• Experience exposing GenAI capabilities via APIs and embedding AI-driven UIs in
Angular/React.
• Experience with observability and basic telemetry for AI applications.
Good To have:
Certifications in AI/ML, Deep Learning and NLP from Learning platforms such as Coursera,
Udemy or equivalent.
Certifications on Cloud Architecture (GCP/Azure/AWS)
Experience building MCP servers or Agent to Agent applications.
Fine tuning LLMs and Hosting LLMs on Premises

Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance expert with solution design experience across the full FI stack, preferably with an accounts and finance background.
Lead a team of Finance specialists; facilitate and guide the implementation and support teams.
Ability to lead and facilitate design workshops, assessments, and planning sessions, demonstrating leadership experience in project management.
Lead dynamic, interactive requirements-gathering sessions with stakeholders throughout the enterprise.
Strong, hands-on expertise across core SAP FI modules:
FI-GL (General Ledger) New GL, document splitting, parallel ledgers/accounting principles, chart of accounts design, financial statement versions, and period-end closing activities.
FI-AR (Accounts Receivable) — customer master data, credit management, dunning, incoming payments, down payments, and customer-side intercompany processes.
FI-AP (Accounts Payable) — vendor master data, payment runs, payment terms, down payments, automatic/electronic payments, and vendor reconciliation.
Asset Accounting (FI-AA) — asset classes, depreciation areas, parallel valuation, asset acquisitions/retirements/transfers, and integration with GL and CO, including regulated utility plant and FERC asset classification where applicable.
Bank Accounting / Treasury integration — bank master data, electronic bank statement processing, cash management, and bank reconciliation.
Taxation — tax procedures, tax codes, withholding tax, and statutory/compliance reporting requirements.
Basic, working knowledge of Controlling — Cost Center Accounting (CO-CCA), Profit Center Accounting (CO-PCA), and Internal Orders — sufficient to support FI-CO integration points and cross-module postings; deep Product Costing or Material Ledger specialization is not required for this role.
Strong knowledge of FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) regulatory reporting for the utilities/energy industry, including FERC Form 1/2/6 preparation, regulatory chart of accounts mapping, and FERC account classification within SAP.
Hands-on experience configuring FERC-compliant Asset Accounting structures — Continuing Property Records (CPR), Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC, both debt and equity components), Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) capitalization, retirement units, and regulatory versus book depreciation.
Understanding of the regulatory ledger/parallel ledger approach (New GL document splitting, or FI-SL) to maintain FERC regulatory books alongside US GAAP/IFRS books, including regulatory asset/liability (ASC 980) accounting.
Exposure to Public Utility industry-specific functionality, Work Order management integration (PM/PS) for capital project accounting, and minor/major retirement processing relevant to utility plant.
Experience supporting FERC audits and regulatory filings, including variance analysis between book and regulatory basis of accounting.
Mentor, coach and manage multiple teams and projects.
Proven experience in configuring, testing and supporting SAP Finance solutions across GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting and Taxation.
Participate in design discussions, providing expertise on the SAP S/4HANA Finance platform.
Work with business users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions across FI processes.
Develop a collaborative and cohesive team, working with a culture of a One Team mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance and accounts, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop and customize solutions, including integration with other modules like MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly how procurement, sales, and production postings flow into FI.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable transactional-level matching in real time.
Understanding of AIF and field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.
Working familiarity with the S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR) tool, as well as a solid accounting and finance background.
Knowledge and experience in implementing SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting is an added advantage.
